Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them. An agent may type a spreadsheet cell by cell when a single line of code would do, or print all two thousand lines of a file through a shell to find one function. Both the interfaces and the knowledge of when to use each are built by hand, which cannot keep pace with new applications, workflows, and models. We argue that interface design should itself be an agent capability. We introduce Agent S4, an autonomous computer-use scientist that builds Evolving Agent Interfaces from task experience. A meta-agent examines task agents’ trajectories on synthetic training tasks, without success labels, and constructs and revises interfaces and usage knowledge in a repository. Population-based evolution then selects which repositories to develop further by their performance on validation tasks the meta-agent never sees, favoring changes that generalize beyond the seen tasks. On OSWorld V2, Agent S4, with Qwen3.8-27B and the evolved repository of interfaces, sets a new state of the art in open-source computer-use agents, reaching 21.3% binary score, 3.8 times the same model with fixed interfaces. This is above both GPT-5.5 (13.0%) and Claude Opus 4.8 (20.6%), at about 4.3% and 1.5% of their respective costs. On ScienceBoard, the evolved interfaces improve the success rate from 41.4% to 58.6% with the same model. These results suggest that useful interfaces can be evolved from experience, making autonomous interface design a source of improvement complementary to advances in models and harnesses. We open-source our code at https://github.com/simular-ai/agent-s
We want AI agents that can discover like we can, not which contain what we have discovered.

Computer-use agents (CUAs) carry out tasks by observing and acting on digital environments. Their interfaces determine what they can observe and which operations they can request. Current computer-use frameworks focus on GUI interaction, supplemented by dedicated tools ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . These interfaces are designed by humans and fixed before task execution. Even though these interfaces are built specifically for agents, they still depend on human judgments about what those agents need.

This practice creates three problems for computer-use. First, it ties progress to manual labor. Computer use is open-ended, and each new family of tasks or model release exposes new failure modes. A human researcher must read trajectories, diagnose failures, and use them to write new primitives, observation formats, or memory mechanisms, and then release the result as a new agent framework with a new preset interface. This loop does not scale with task diversity. Second, a static interface often mismatches the task, and current methods compensate with test-time compute instead of a better interface. For example, an agent may complete a shell task by clicking to open a terminal window, typing commands one character at a time, and reading screenshots of a partly occluded terminal for feedback, when a direct shell interface would be faster and more reliable ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . Additional sampling can raise benchmark scores under such mismatches, but through wasteful and brittle strategies. Third, methods that compose test-time experience into reusable skills or routines inherit the same limit ( Agashe et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . Each skill is a composition of the preset observations and actions. Distillation can reorder what the interface allows, but it cannot extend it. These problems arise because the interface is treated as a design decision that humans make before deployment, and not as an object that can be studied and improved from the agent’s own experience.

Instead, computer-use interfaces should evolve from the agent’s own experience. Therefore, we introduce Agent S4 1 1 1 The name reads as Agent S cientist for (4) Evolving Agent Interfaces an autonomous CUA scientist that studies computer-use agents and builds Evolving Agent Interfaces through population-based evolution. Its output is a repository of mixed interfaces and knowledge about when and how to use them. The task agent’s model and harness remain fixed, with the harness governing model invocation, execution, permissions, and task budgets.

The task agent uses candidate repositories of Evolving Agent Interfaces to attempt synthetic tasks, producing trajectories without ground-truth success labels. A meta-agent studies these trajectories and forms hypotheses about how changes to actions, observations, or usage knowledge could help the task agent. It constructs descendants through mutation of one repository or crossover between two. Descendants can add, revise, or remove interfaces and knowledge, and the population retains alternative designs for further development and recombination.

To limit specialization to the tasks that motivated these changes, Agent S4 separates the evidence used for construction from that used for selection. The meta-agent receives training trajectories, while validation instructions, trajectories, diagnostics, and scores remain hidden from it. Validation performance guides parent selection. We evaluate the final selected repository on the full benchmark. The meta-agent never observes any benchmark task while constructing interfaces, and the validation tasks influence only which repositories are selected during evolution.

We evaluate Agent S4 on OSWorld V2 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) and ScienceBoard ( Sun et al., 2025 ) . On the full 108-task OSWorld V2 set, Qwen3.8-27B with the evolved repository reaches 21.3 % 21.3\% binary success, above both GPT-5.5 ( 13.0 % 13.0\% ) and Claude Opus 4.8 ( 20.6 % 20.6\% ) at about 4.3 % 4.3\% and 1.5 % 1.5\% of their respective costs. In a separate evolution run on ScienceBoard, which covers niche scientific applications, the evolved repository reaches a 58.6 % 58.6\% success rate, compared with 41.4 % 41.4\% for the human-designed interface of Qwen CUA. These results show that agents can evolve their own computer-use interfaces from purely synthetic, verifier-free task experience and outperform human-designed interfaces. We compare our setup against evolutionary baselines such as linear evolution and measure the effect of giving the meta-agent a scratch virtual machine to test its evolved interfaces. Finally, we qualitatively compare agents that act through evolved interfaces with agents that use fixed, human-designed interfaces.

Evolving Agent Interfaces from synthetic, verifier-free experience. We introduce Agent S4, which evolves a repository of interfaces and usage knowledge from synthetic task experience, without success labels or task verifiers, while the task agent’s model and harness stay fixed. Validation tasks the meta-agent never sees decide which repositories to develop further.

Evolving interfaces outperform fixed ones. With a repository of interfaces evolved by Agent S4, Qwen3.8-27B exceeds both GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8 in binary success on OSWorld V2 at a small fraction of their cost, and improves ScienceBoard success over a fixed-interface agent with the same model.

Analysis of evolved interfaces. Repository and trajectory analyses show that evolved interfaces change both what the agent observes and how it acts, across desktop-wide, application-specific, cross-application and task-specific interfaces. We also compare evolution strategies, with and without a scratch environment for the meta-agent.

paragraphs.en: We study how the interfaces of a computer-use agent can be evolved from task experience. An agent updating a spreadsheet through screenshots must identify visible cells, enter values, and inspect the display to check the result. A structured interface can expose the relevant rows and formulas, accept a bulk edit, and return the changed values. Both interfaces can achieve the same subgoal ( Coutaz et al., 1995 ) , but they require different decisions and provide different feedback. Their cost and reliability can also differ. Task experience can reveal which operations are missing, which observations are difficult to use, and where a different interface would help.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了计算机使用智能体的界面如何根据任务经验进行演化。 一个通过屏幕截图更新电子表格的智能体必须识别可见单元格、输入数值，并检查显示结果以验证效果。 结构化界面可以展示相关的行和公式，接受批量编辑，并返回修改后的数值。 这两种界面都能实现相同的子目标（Coutaz 等人，1995），但它们需要不同的决策并提供不同的反馈。 它们的成本和可靠性也可能存在差异。 任务经验可以揭示哪些操作缺失、哪些观察结果难以利用，以及在哪种情况下采用不同的界面会有所帮助。

paragraphs.en: A model M M is a language model that generates responses and requests conditioned on its input context. A harness H H manages model invocation, request execution, task budgets, permissions P H P_{H} , and preparation of the model’s context, including any context compaction. An agent A = ( M , H ) A=(M,H) is the model operating through this harness. The agent initially has access to a base set of interfaces ℐ \mathcal{I} . The harness executes requests through these interfaces and places the resulting observations in the model’s context. For example, the harness can execute a spreadsheet helper under a time limit and permission boundary. The helper defines the requests for reading or editing cell ranges and the values returned to the agent. The harness governs execution, while the interface specifies the available operations and feedback.

paragraphs.en: Interfaces implemented as programs can be revised like any other software. A program can export a material schedule through Blender’s Python API, extract selected rows from a Calc workbook, or return supplier prices gathered through a sequence of browser operations. Each defines its own requests and observations ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2023 ) . Because these interfaces are code, an agent that can read trajectories and write code can redesign them. It can decide which operations to combine, what information to return, and how a result can be checked. We call this process interface evolution . Repeated reconstruction of the same calculation across tasks can motivate a reusable operation, and a repeated inability to verify a change can motivate a new observation. Trajectories with the revised repository then provide evidence for further revision. Section 3 instantiates E E with population-based evolution.

paragraphs.en: Agent S4 builds Evolving Agent Interfaces and usage knowledge through population-based evolution of repositories, keeping the task agent’s model M M and harness H H fixed. Each iteration selects parents from a population, constructs a descendant through mutation or crossover, evaluates it, and adds it to the population while retaining its parents (Figure 3 ). Training experience guides the repository changes, and held-out validation guides subsequent selection. This optimizes Equation 1 for the fixed task agent A A . Algorithm 1 gives the procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体 S4 通过基于种群的仓库演化来构建可演化的智能体接口和使用知识，同时保持任务智能体的模型 M M 和工具 H H 固定不变。 每次迭代都会从种群中选择亲本，通过变异或交叉生成子代，对其进行评估，并将其加入种群，同时保留其亲本（图 3）。 训练经验指导仓库的变化，而预留的验证数据则指导后续的选择过程。 这针对固定的任务智能体 A A 优化了方程 1。 算法 1 描述了具体流程。

paragraphs.en: At each step, an operator schedule chooses mutation or crossover. Mutation requires one parent, and crossover requires two distinct parents. For each parent, binary tournament selection draws two eligible variants uniformly and chooses the one with the higher validation score. A sole eligible candidate is selected directly. For crossover, the first selected parent is excluded from the second selection. The selected repositories and their saved training trajectories provide the starting point for the next descendant.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个步骤中，操作者调度会选择变异或交叉。 变异需要一个亲本，而交叉则需要两个不同的亲本。 对于每个亲本，二进制锦标赛选择会均匀地抽取两个符合条件的变体，并选择验证分数较高的那个。 直接选择一个符合条件的候选者。 对于交叉操作，第一个选中的亲本会被排除在第二次选择之外。 选中的存储库及其保存的训练轨迹为下一个后代提供了起点。

paragraphs.en: The meta-agent A meta = ( M meta , H meta ) A_{\mathrm{meta}}=(M_{\mathrm{meta}},H_{\mathrm{meta}}) constructs descendants using a fixed model and harness. Its computer C meta C_{\mathrm{meta}} holds the selected parent repositories, their training trajectories, and a lineage notebook in its filesystem. It studies the recorded behavior and observations to diagnose apparent failures and inefficiencies and form hypotheses about useful changes. For example, repeated cell-by-cell edits can motivate a bulk spreadsheet interface, while poor use of an existing interface can motivate revised usage knowledge. It implements these hypotheses through file, shell, and code interfaces using one of two operators.
paragraphs.zh: 元智能体 A meta = ( M meta , H meta ) A_{\mathrm{meta}}=(M_{\mathrm{meta}},H_{\mathrm{meta}}) 使用固定模型和工具构建后代智能体。 其计算机 C meta C_{\mathrm{meta}} 在文件系统中存储所选父仓库、它们的训练轨迹以及一个谱系笔记本。 它研究记录的行为和观察结果，以诊断明显的故障和低效之处，并针对有效变更形成假设。 例如，重复的单元格级编辑可能促使采用批量电子表格界面，而对现有界面使用不当则可能促使改进使用知识。 它通过文件、外壳和代码接口，使用两种操作符之一来实现这些假设。

paragraphs.en: We add R ′ R^{\prime} to the population alongside its parents regardless of its validation score. This retains alternative designs for further development and recombination. Parent links form a directed acyclic graph, with one parent per mutation and two per crossover. Optional pruning removes parent eligibility while preserving lineage records. The updated population supplies candidates for the next iteration. After N N steps, we select a member of ℛ N \mathcal{R}_{N} by validation performance, using a benchmark-specific criterion (Section 4 ), and freeze it for evaluation on target tasks 𝒯 test \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{test}} . The meta-agent observes none of these tasks during construction, and validation tasks drawn from the same benchmark affect only selection.
paragraphs.zh: 无论其验证得分如何，我们都会将 R ′ R^{\prime} 与其父本一同加入种群。 这保留了可供进一步开发和重组的替代设计。 父本链接构成一个有向无环图，每次突变对应一个父本，每次交叉对应两个父本。 可选的剪枝操作会移除父本的资格，但保留谱系记录。 更新后的种群为下一轮迭代提供候选者。 经过 N N 步后，我们根据验证表现，使用针对特定基准的标准（第 4 节）从 ℛ N \mathcal{R}_{N} 中选择一个成员，并将其固定用于在目标任务 𝒯 test \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{test}} 上的评估。 元智能体在构建过程中不会观察到这些任务中的任何一项，且从同一基准中抽取的验证任务仅影响选择过程。

sents.en: We add R ′ R^{\prime} to the population alongside its parents regardless of its validation score.
sents.zh: 无论其验证得分如何，我们都会将 R ′ R^{\prime} 与其父本一同加入种群。

sents.en: This retains alternative designs for further development and recombination.
sents.zh: 这保留了可供进一步开发和重组的替代设计。

sents.en: Parent links form a directed acyclic graph, with one parent per mutation and two per crossover.
sents.zh: 父本链接构成一个有向无环图，每次突变对应一个父本，每次交叉对应两个父本。

sents.en: Optional pruning removes parent eligibility while preserving lineage records.
sents.zh: 可选的剪枝操作会移除父本的资格，但保留谱系记录。

sents.en: The updated population supplies candidates for the next iteration.
sents.zh: 更新后的种群为下一轮迭代提供候选者。

sents.en: After N N steps, we select a member of ℛ N \mathcal{R}_{N} by validation performance, using a benchmark-specific criterion (Section 4 ), and freeze it for evaluation on target tasks 𝒯 test \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{test}} .
sents.zh: 经过 N N 步后，我们根据验证表现，使用针对特定基准的标准（第 4 节）从 ℛ N \mathcal{R}_{N} 中选择一个成员，并将其固定用于在目标任务 𝒯 test \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{test}} 上的评估。

sents.en: The meta-agent observes none of these tasks during construction, and validation tasks drawn from the same benchmark affect only selection.
sents.zh: 元智能体在构建过程中不会观察到这些任务中的任何一项，且从同一基准中抽取的验证任务仅影响选择过程。

paragraphs.en: OSWorld V2 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) is our primary benchmark, and ScienceBoard ( Sun et al., 2025 ) tests generalization to niche scientific computer-use applications and workflows. Repository evolution uses 30 synthetic training tasks for OSWorld V2 and 48 for ScienceBoard, plus 15 official validation tasks for each. Synthetic task attempts yield trajectories without ground-truth success labels. The meta-agent receives these training trajectories. Validation scores guide selection, but validation trajectories and evaluators remain outside its evidence. Full-benchmark results cover 108 OSWorld V2 and 169 ScienceBoard tasks, including the 15 validation tasks of each. Benchmark details appear in Appendix A , and synthetic task construction is described below and in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: OSWorld V2（Yuan 等人，2026）是我们的主要基准测试，而 ScienceBoard（Sun 等人，2025）则用于测试模型在特定科学计算机应用和工作流中的泛化能力。 仓库演化部分使用 30 个合成训练任务针对 OSWorld V2，以及 48 个针对 ScienceBoard，此外每个基准测试还包含 15 个官方验证任务。 合成任务的尝试会产生没有真实成功标签的轨迹。 元智能体接收这些训练轨迹。 验证分数用于指导选择，但验证轨迹和评估器仍不包含在其证据中。 完整基准测试结果涵盖了 108 个 OSWorld V2 任务和 169 个 ScienceBoard 任务，包括各自的 15 个验证任务。 基准测试的详细信息见附录 A，合成任务的构建方法则在下文及附录 D 中描述。

paragraphs.en: On both benchmarks, the task agent and meta-agent use Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) in a modified Prime Agent harness ( Karten et al., 2026 ) that executes code in a persistent IPython kernel, with Medium reasoning, a 131,072-token context window, a 32,000-token output limit, and automatic context compaction. The model and harness remain fixed within each search. Appendix A gives the harness version, sampling parameters, and compaction settings; Appendix C gives implementation constraints and builder prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 在两项基准测试中，任务智能体和元智能体均使用 Qwen3.8-27B（Qwen Team，2026），并采用经过修改的 Prime Agent 框架（Karten 等，2026）。该框架在持久的 IPython 内核中执行代码，配置为中度推理、131,072 个标记的上下文窗口、32,000 个标记的输出限制以及自动上下文压缩功能。 每次搜索过程中，模型和框架均保持固定不变。 附录 A 介绍了框架版本、采样参数和压缩设置；附录 C 则说明了实现约束和构建提示。

On ScienceBoard, we compare the seed and evolved repositories with Qwen CUA. Qwen3.8-27B results come from our own evaluations. Results for other models in Figure 2 and Table 2 , including per-task costs, are taken from Table 3 of Yuan et al. (2026) .

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarizes the four evolution baselines, all starting from the same seed repository. Each construction step produces one descendant. Seed evaluation and validation re-evaluations are not construction steps. The OSWorld V2 searches share the same training and validation sets.

paragraphs.en: Population search alternates mutation (one parent) and crossover (two distinct parents), starting with mutation. Binary tournaments choose parents from the eligible population using mean partial validation score on OSWorld V2 and validation success on ScienceBoard. After 10 steps, the five lowest-scoring variants are removed from parent eligibility. Linear evolution mutates the latest descendant at every step, without tournament selection or crossover.
paragraphs.zh: 种群搜索在变异（一个亲本）和交叉（两个不同的亲本）之间交替进行，并以变异开始。 二进制锦标赛从符合条件的种群中选择亲本，依据是其在 OSWorld V2 上的平均部分验证分数以及在 ScienceBoard 上的验证成功率。 经过 10 步后，得分最低的五个变体将被从亲本候选池中移除。 线性演化在每一步都对最新的后代进行变异，且不使用锦标赛选择或交叉操作。

sents.en: Binary tournaments choose parents from the eligible population using mean partial validation score on OSWorld V2 and validation success on ScienceBoard.

sents.zh: 线性演化在每一步都对最新的后代进行变异，且不使用锦标赛选择或交叉操作。

paragraphs.en: A scratch VM with the same AMI as the benchmark tasks lets the meta-agent inspect running applications and try interface code during construction. Without it, the meta-agent works from repository code and saved training trajectories. In all four settings, task agents execute in benchmark VMs. Each meta-agent construction has a two-hour wall-clock budget for OSWorld v2 and 1 hour wall clock budget for ScienceBoard.
paragraphs.zh: 一个与基准任务使用相同 AMI 的 Scratch VM，能让元智能体在构建过程中检查正在运行的应用程序并尝试接口代码。 如果没有它，元智能体将基于仓库代码和保存的训练轨迹进行工作。 在所有四种设置中，任务智能体都在基准 VM 中执行。 每个元智能体的构建过程，在 OSWorld v2 中有两小时的实际运行时间预算，在 ScienceBoard 中则有一小时的实际运行时间预算。

sents.en: A scratch VM with the same AMI as the benchmark tasks lets the meta-agent inspect running applications and try interface code during construction.
sents.zh: 一个与基准任务使用相同 AMI 的 Scratch VM，能让元智能体在构建过程中检查正在运行的应用程序并尝试接口代码。

sents.zh: 在所有四种设置中，任务智能体都在基准 VM 中执行。

paragraphs.en: On OSWorld V2, we select the repository that fully solves the most validation tasks and break ties by mean partial validation score, since binary success is the harder metric to improve. On ScienceBoard, whose evaluator reports only success, we select the repository with the highest validation success rate.
paragraphs.zh: 在 OSWorld V2 中，我们选择能够完全解决最多验证任务的仓库；若出现并列情况，则依据平均部分验证得分进行取舍，因为二元成功指标更难提升。 在 ScienceBoard 中，其评估器仅报告成功与否，因此我们选择验证成功率最高的仓库。

sents.zh: 在 OSWorld V2 中，我们选择能够完全解决最多验证任务的仓库；若出现并列情况，则依据平均部分验证得分进行取舍，因为二元成功指标更难提升。

sents.en: On ScienceBoard, whose evaluator reports only success, we select the repository with the highest validation success rate.
sents.zh: 在 ScienceBoard 中，其评估器仅报告成功与否，因此我们选择验证成功率最高的仓库。

paragraphs.en: In the case of Scienceboard, we also run a Denoise operation after every 5 steps. This picks the top-3 variants in the population and reevaluates them. The repositories validation score is then replaced by the updated running average. We analyze the effect of this denoising step in Section 7.3 . We do not run the denoising step for OSWorld-v2 due to much longer time and cost of evolution and repeated evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Scienceboard，我们也会在每运行 5 步后执行一次去噪操作。 该操作会从种群中选择排名前三的变体，并重新评估它们。 随后，仓库的验证分数将被更新后的运行平均值所取代。 我们在第 7.3 节中分析了这一去噪步骤的效果。 由于 OSWorld-v2 的演化过程和时间成本更长，且需要重复评估，因此我们未对其执行去噪步骤。

paragraphs.en: Prime Agent task rollouts have a 300-step budget on both benchmarks, where a step is one completed assistant response and can contain multiple actions. New OSWorld V2 training and validation rollouts also have a two-hour wall-clock limit. The final evaluation keeps the step budget but has no per-task wall-clock limit. ScienceBoard applies a 60-minute wall-clock limit to training, validation, validation repeats, and full evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: Prime Agent 任务执行在两个基准测试上均有 300 步的预算，其中一步指一次完整的助手响应，可能包含多个动作。 新的 OSWorld V2 训练和验证执行也设有两小时的实际运行时间限制。 最终评估保留了步数预算，但不再对每个任务设置实际运行时间限制。 ScienceBoard 对训练、验证、验证重复以及完整评估均施加了 60 分钟的实际运行时间限制。

sents.en: Prime Agent task rollouts have a 300-step budget on both benchmarks, where a step is one completed assistant response and can contain multiple actions.

paragraphs.en: We report binary success and partial score on OSWorld V2 and success rate on ScienceBoard. OSWorld V2 task-solving costs are estimated from model-token usage at Parasail’s input and output rates, assuming an 80 % 80\% input-cache hit rate, and exclude repository construction and runtime infrastructure. Appendix A lists the rates and remaining runtime settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 OSWorld V2 上报告了二元成功率和部分得分，并在 ScienceBoard 上报告了成功率。 OSWorld V2 的任务解决成本是根据 Parasail 的输入和输出速率下模型令牌的使用量估算的，假设输入缓存命中率为 80%，且不包括仓库构建和运行时基础设施的成本。 附录 A 列出了相关速率以及剩余的运行时设置。

sents.en: We report binary success and partial score on OSWorld V2 and success rate on ScienceBoard.
sents.zh: 我们在 OSWorld V2 上报告了二元成功率和部分得分，并在 ScienceBoard 上报告了成功率。

sents.en: OSWorld V2 task-solving costs are estimated from model-token usage at Parasail’s input and output rates, assuming an 80 % 80\% input-cache hit rate, and exclude repository construction and runtime infrastructure.

paragraphs.en: We constructed 30 synthetic tasks for OSWorld V2 and 50 for ScienceBoard, of which 48 are used (Appendix E ), giving Agent S4 task experience for evolving Agent Interfaces and usage knowledge without ground-truth success labels. Tasks follow each benchmark’s methodology but use independently authored scenarios. For OSWorld V2 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , we studied its task-construction principles and challenge-phenomenon taxonomy, and scaled the reported counts of overlapping phenomena into approximate targets for our 30 tasks. These targets guided the representation of capabilities such as cross-source reasoning, visual-spatial precision, and implicit-state inference. For ScienceBoard ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , we followed a planned distribution across six scientific applications and preserved its compact tasks, usually centered on one application and one meaningful outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为 OSWorld V2 构建了 30 个合成任务，为 ScienceBoard 构建了 50 个合成任务，其中 48 个被用于（附录 E），从而让智能体 S4 获得任务经验，以演化智能体接口和使用知识，而无需依赖真实成功标签。这些任务遵循各基准测试的方法论，但使用了独立编写的场景。对于 OSWorld V2（Yuan 等人，2026），我们研究了其任务构建原则和挑战现象分类法，并将已报告的重复现象数量调整为我们 30 个任务的近似目标。这些目标指导了跨源推理、视觉空间精确性和隐式状态推断等能力的呈现方式。对于 ScienceBoard（Sun 等人，2025），我们遵循了其在六个科学应用领域的规划分布，并保留了其紧凑的任务设计，这些任务通常围绕一个应用和一个有意义的结果展开。

paragraphs.en: Tasks were created agentically by a coordinator (GPT-6 Astra), authors (GPT-5.6-Sol), and independent reviewers (GPT-5.6-Sol). The coordinator tracked accepted tasks against the planned counts and assigned new tasks to phenomena or applications below target. Each author started from a fresh context with application documentation, design requirements, and summaries of accepted synthetic tasks, but without access to official task instances, evaluators, or task-agent trajectories. Authors produced instructions, input artifacts, and environment setup specifications, documenting provenance and capability assumptions.

paragraphs.en: Reviewers checked originality, coherence, feasibility, and appropriate complexity. To ensure that no synthetic task overlaps with an existing benchmark task, they compared each candidate’s purpose, dependencies, operations, and deliverables against official instruction and setup metadata and against the accepted synthetic set. Each claimed challenge had to be supported by the actual materials. The coordinator returned concrete defects for up to two revision rounds, rejected overlapping designs, and kept official comparisons out of author feedback. Automated input and setup checks supplemented these reviews, and only accepted versions entered the training set. No step graded task-agent attempts or produced reference solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 评审员检查了原创性、连贯性、可行性和适当的复杂性。 为确保没有任何合成任务与现有基准任务重叠，他们将每个候选任务的用途、依赖项、操作和交付成果与官方说明及设置元数据以及已接受的合成任务集进行了比较。 每一项声称的挑战都必须有实际材料作为支撑。 协调员最多提供两轮修订的具体缺陷反馈，拒绝重叠的设计，并将官方比较排除在作者反馈之外。 自动化的输入和设置检查辅助了这些评审，只有经过接受的版本才能进入训练集。 没有任何步骤对任务-智能体的尝试进行评分或生成参考解决方案。

paragraphs.en: With a repository of interfaces evolved by Agent S4, a 27B open-source model reaches the highest binary success on open-source models at a small fraction of frontier-model cost. Table 2 compares results on the full OSWorld V2 benchmark. We report the best repositories from population evolution with and without a scratch VM, alongside the Qwen CUA baseline and reported open-source and closed-source results from OSWorld V2, which retain the single-action and batched-action settings of the reference evaluations. Binary success measures complete task execution, partial score measures intermediate progress, and cost covers task-solving model calls. Binary gains are the hardest to obtain on OSWorld V2. Strong agents reach similar partial progress, and what separates them is turning that progress into fully completed tasks ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . With the repository evolved without a scratch VM, Qwen3.8-27B achieves 21.30 % 21.30\% binary success at $1.10 per task, above the 13.00 % 13.00\% of GPT-5.5 and the 20.60 % 20.60\% of Claude Opus 4.8 with batched actions, at 4.3 % 4.3\% and 1.5 % 1.5\% of their $25.50 and $72.40 costs. With the repository evolved with a scratch VM, it reaches a partial score of 51.06 % 51.06\% at $1.27 per task.
paragraphs.zh: 借助由智能体 S4 演化出的接口库，一个 27B 参数的开源模型以远低于前沿模型的成本，实现了开源模型中最高的二元成功率。 表 2 比较了完整 OSWorld V2 基准测试的结果。 我们报告了在有无初始虚拟机（scratch VM）的情况下，通过群体演化得到的最佳接口库，以及 Qwen CUA 基线模型和 OSWorld V2 中已报告的开源与闭源模型结果；这些结果保留了参考评估中的单动作和批量动作设置。 二元成功衡量任务是否完全执行，部分得分衡量中间进展，而成本则涵盖了解决任务所需的模型调用。 在 OSWorld V2 上，实现二元成功是最具挑战性的。 强大的智能体能够达到类似的中间进展水平，而区分它们的关键在于能否将这些进展转化为任务的完整完成（Yuan et al., 2026）。 在没有初始虚拟机的情况下演化出的接口库中，Qwen3.8-27B 实现了 21.30% 的二元成功率，每任务成本为 $1.10，高于 GPT-5.5 的 13.00% 和 Claude Opus 4.8 在批量动作设置下的 20.60%，且其成本仅为后者 $25.50 和 $72.40 的 4.3% 和 1.5%。 在有初始虚拟机的情况下演化出的接口库中，该模型实现了 51.06% 的部分得分，每任务成本为 $1.27。

paragraphs.en: Evolving interfaces improve the same model. Agents with fixed interfaces already seek programmatic access ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Terminal commands account for 24.7 % 24.7\% of their actions, and GPT-5.5 devotes 78 % 78\% of its budget to code, API, or file operations ( Yuan et al., 2026 , Section 4) . Under a fixed interface, each such program is typed through the desktop and its result is read from a screenshot. Acting through agent evolved interfaces removes this indirection, and the evolved repository supplies interfaces for the applications and data that recur across tasks. Compared with the Qwen CUA baseline, which runs the same Qwen3.8-27B model with fixed interfaces, this raises binary success from 5.56 % 5.56\% to 21.30 % 21.30\% and partial score from 20.69 % 20.69\% to 46.90 % 46.90\% , or to 51.06 % 51.06\% with the repository evolved with a scratch VM, while lowering task-solving cost from 1.39 ​ t ​ o 1.39to 1.10 per task.
paragraphs.zh: 不断演化的接口能够改进同一模型。 使用固定接口的智能体已经会寻求程序化访问（Yuan 等，2026）。 终端命令占其行动的 24.7%（24.7\%），而 GPT-5.5 将其预算的 78%（78\%）用于代码、API 或文件操作（Yuan 等，2026，第 4 节）。 在固定接口下，每个此类程序都通过桌面输入，其结果则从截图中读取。 通过智能体演化接口进行操作可消除这种间接性，而演化后的仓库则为跨任务重复出现的应用程序和数据提供接口。 与使用固定接口的相同 Qwen3.8-27B 模型运行的 Qwen CUA 基线相比，这种方法将二进制成功率从 5.56%（5.56\%）提升至 21.30%（21.30\%），部分得分从 20.69%（20.69\%）提升至 46.90%（46.90\%）；若使用通过空虚拟机演化的仓库，则部分得分可达 51.06%（51.06\%），同时任务解决成本从每个任务 1.39 t 降至 1.10 t。

paragraphs.en: We next ask whether Agent S4 carries over to a different domain. ScienceBoard ( Sun et al., 2025 ) contains 169 tasks across six scientific applications. These are Celestia for astronomy, ChimeraX for molecular visualization, GRASS GIS for geographic analysis, KAlgebra for algebra and plotting, Lean for theorem proving and TeXstudio for typesetting. General computer-use interfaces rarely cover these applications, and many of their operations are hard to carry out through clicks alone. We run a fresh evolution with the same task agent, Qwen3.8-27B in Prime Agent, starting from the same seed repository as on OSWorld V2. The meta-agent learns from 48 synthetic training tasks across the six applications (Appendix E ), and 15 validation tasks guide selection over 30 construction steps.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们探讨智能体 S4 能否迁移到不同的领域。 ScienceBoard（Sun 等人，2025）包含六个科学应用领域的 169 项任务。 这些应用包括用于天文学的 Celestia、用于分子可视化的 ChimeraX、用于地理分析的 GRASS GIS、用于代数和作图的 KAlgebra、用于定理证明的 Lean，以及用于排版的 TeXstudio。 通用计算机操作界面很少涵盖这些应用，而且其中许多操作仅通过点击难以完成。 我们使用相同的任务智能体——Prime Agent 中的 Qwen3.8-27B，从与 OSWorld V2 相同的种子仓库开始，运行一次全新的演化过程。 元智能体从六个应用领域的 48 项合成训练任务（附录 E）中学习，并通过 15 项验证任务指导其在 30 个构建步骤中的选择。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports results on the full benchmark. Evolution raises success from 55.03 % 55.03\% with the seed repository to 58.58 % 58.58\% , solving 99 of 169 tasks compared with 93, and reduces the average number of model calls per task from 61.7 to 58.9. The selected repository grows from 15 functions in the seed to 64. The additions include a ChimeraX command interface, GRASS GIS modules that run in the live session and a KAlgebra calculator that evaluates many expressions in one call. The gains are largest on KAlgebra, where success rises from 48 % 48\% to 68 % 68\% . These results show that Agent S4 can evolve useful interfaces for specialized scientific software from synthetic training experience.
paragraphs.zh: 表3报告了完整基准测试的结果。 通过进化，使用种子库的成功率从55.03 % 55.03\%提升至58.58 % 58.58\%，完成的任务数从93个增至169个中的99个，同时每任务的平均模型调用次数从61.7降至58.9。 选定的库函数数量从种子库中的15个增长到64个。 新增内容包括一个ChimeraX命令接口、可在实时会话中运行的GRASS GIS模块，以及能够单次调用评估多个表达式的KAlgebra计算器。 KAlgebra的改进最为显著，其成功率从48 % 48\%提升至68 % 68\%。 这些结果表明，Agent S4能够从合成训练经验中演化出适用于专业科学软件的实用接口。

paragraphs.en: Seed repository and evolution. The first two rows of Table 4 show the task agent with no repository and with the seed repository. The seed raises binary success from 15.74 % 15.74\% to 19.44 % 19.44\% while leaving partial score nearly unchanged ( 44.93 % 44.93\% versus 44.90 % 44.90\% ), and lowers task-solving cost from $1.36 to $1.11 per task. The seed therefore provides a useful starting point, and evolution improves it on binary success and partial score.

sents.en: The seed raises binary success from 15.74 % 15.74\% to 19.44 % 19.44\% while leaving partial score nearly unchanged ( 44.93 % 44.93\% versus 44.90 % 44.90\% ), and lowers task-solving cost from $1.36 to $1.11 per task.
Evolution without a scratch VM then raises binary success to 21.30 % 21.30\% and partial score to 46.90 % 46.90\% at nearly the same cost ($1.10).
sents.zh: 随后，在没有空白虚拟机时的演化将二元成功率提升至 21.30 % 21.30\%，部分得分提升至 46.90 % 46.90\%，而成本几乎保持不变（$1.10）。

sents.en: The seed therefore provides a useful starting point, and evolution improves it on binary success and partial score.
sents.zh: 因此，种子知识库提供了一个有用的起点，而演化则在二元成功率和部分得分方面进一步提升了这一结果。

paragraphs.en: Evolution strategies. We compare three ways of evolving the repository. The first is population-based evolution with a scratch virtual machine (VM), in which the meta-agent can open applications and test interfaces. The second is population-based evolution without the scratch VM. The third is linear evolution with a scratch VM, in which the meta-agent keeps refining each new child repository. With a scratch VM, population-based evolution reaches the same binary success as linear evolution ( 19.44 % 19.44\% ) and a higher partial score ( 51.06 % 51.06\% versus 47.17 % 47.17\% ). Without a scratch VM, population-based evolution reaches the highest binary success ( 21.30 % 21.30\% ) but a lower partial score ( 46.90 % 46.90\% ). The scratch VM therefore improves partial progress, while the best binary success comes from evolution without it.
paragraphs.zh: 演化策略。 我们比较了三种演化仓库的方法。 第一种是基于种群的演化，使用一个 Scratch 虚拟机（VM），其中元智能体可以打开应用程序并测试接口。 第二种是不使用 Scratch VM 的基于种群的演化。 第三种是使用 Scratch VM 的线性演化，其中元智能体持续优化每个新的子仓库。 使用 Scratch VM 时，基于种群的演化达到了与线性演化相同的二进制成功率（19.44% 19.44\%），但部分得分更高（51.06% 51.06\% 对比 47.17% 47.17\%）。 不使用 Scratch VM 时，基于种群的演化实现了最高的二进制成功率（21.30% 21.30\%），但部分得分较低（46.90% 46.90\%）。 因此，Scratch VM 提升了部分进展，而最佳二进制成功率则来自不使用它的演化方法。

paragraphs.en: To compare runs, we label each interface by the part of the computer it covers and the purpose it serves. The four labels can overlap:
paragraphs.zh: 为了比较运行结果，我们根据每个界面所覆盖的计算机部分及其功能来为其命名。 这四种标签可能会重叠：

sents.en: To compare runs, we label each interface by the part of the computer it covers and the purpose it serves.
sents.zh: 为了比较运行结果，我们根据每个界面所覆盖的计算机部分及其功能来为其命名。

sents.en: The four labels can overlap:
sents.zh: 这四种标签可能会重叠：

paragraphs.en: System-wide interfaces cover the desktop and operating system as a whole, such as inspecting windows or launching and monitoring background processes.
paragraphs.zh: 系统级接口涵盖了整个桌面和操作系统，例如检查窗口或启动和监控后台进程。

paragraphs.en: App-specific interfaces expose the objects of one named application, such as spreadsheet ranges in LibreOffice, tracks in a REAPER audio project, or molecules in ChimeraX.
paragraphs.zh: 应用程序专用接口会暴露某个指定应用程序的对象，例如 LibreOffice 中的电子表格区域、REAPER 音频项目中的音轨，或 ChimeraX 中的分子。

paragraphs.en: Cross-App interfaces work on data or platforms shared by many applications, such as reading and rendering PDF files regardless of which application created them, or reading pages on any website.
paragraphs.zh: 跨应用接口基于多个应用程序共享的数据或平台运行，例如，无论 PDF 文件由哪个应用程序创建，它都能读取和渲染这些文件，或者读取任何网站上的页面。

paragraphs.en: Task-specific interfaces package a procedure for a particular goal together with a check of whether it is achieved, such as checking a Lean proof, compiling it, updating the editor and reporting completion.
paragraphs.zh: 任务特定接口将实现某一特定目标的过程与检查该目标是否达成的机制整合在一起，例如检查 Lean 证明、编译证明、更新编辑器并报告完成状态。

paragraphs.en: Interfaces also grow after they are introduced, so we label each added operation separately. For example, the office-document interface is App-specific because it edits documents through LibreOffice itself, but an operation added to it later that edits OpenDocument files directly, without the application, is Cross-App. Figure 4 counts new interfaces and these later extensions separately. Table 7 in Appendix B.3 gives examples of evolved interfaces, with what each lets the agent observe and do.
paragraphs.zh: 接口在引入后也会扩展，因此我们会对每个新增的操作单独标注。 例如，办公文档接口是应用专属的，因为它通过 LibreOffice 本身来编辑文档；但后来添加到该接口中、无需应用程序即可直接编辑 OpenDocument 文件的操作，则是跨应用的。 图 4 将新接口和这些后续扩展分别进行统计。 附录 B.3 中的表 7 提供了演化接口的示例，并说明了每个接口允许智能体观察和执行的哪些操作。

sents.en: Interfaces also grow after they are introduced, so we label each added operation separately.
sents.zh: 接口在引入后也会扩展，因此我们会对每个新增的操作单独标注。

sents.en: For example, the office-document interface is App-specific because it edits documents through LibreOffice itself, but an operation added to it later that edits OpenDocument files directly, without the application, is Cross-App.

sents.en: Figure 4 counts new interfaces and these later extensions separately.
sents.zh: 图 4 将新接口和这些后续扩展分别进行统计。

sents.en: Table 7 in Appendix B.3 gives examples of evolved interfaces, with what each lets the agent observe and do.
sents.zh: 附录 B.3 中的表 7 提供了演化接口的示例，并说明了每个接口允许智能体观察和执行的哪些操作。

paragraphs.en: On OSWorld V2 without a scratch VM, evolution introduces four new interfaces and 127 extensions, including 29 System-wide, 63 App-specific and 40 Cross-App extensions. An interface or extension can carry more than one label, so the counts per label can add up to more than the total. Most of its growth therefore deepens interfaces the agent already has. With a scratch VM, where the meta-agent can open applications and test its code, the population introduces 12 new interfaces and 253 extensions. Nine of the new interfaces are App-specific and nine are Cross-App. Seven carry both labels, such as the interfaces for editing musical scores, audio projects and 3D scenes, which operate one application while reading and writing file formats that other applications share. Cross-App extensions rise to 129. These additional application interfaces are a likely explanation for the higher partial score of the best repository evolved with a scratch VM.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有 scratch VM 的 OSWorld V2 中，演化引入了四个新接口和 127 个扩展，其中包括 29 个系统级扩展、63 个应用专用扩展和 40 个跨应用扩展。 一个接口或扩展可以带有多个标签，因此每个标签的计数总和可能超过总数。 因此，其增长主要深化了智能体已经拥有的接口。 在 scratch VM 中，元智能体可以打开应用程序并测试其代码，此时种群引入了 12 个新接口和 253 个扩展。 这些新接口中有 9 个是应用专用的，另外 9 个是跨应用的。 其中有 7 个同时带有这两个标签，例如用于编辑乐谱、音频项目和 3D 场景的接口，它们在操作一个应用程序的同时，可以读取和写入其他应用程序共享的文件格式。 跨应用扩展的数量增至 129 个。 这些额外的应用程序接口很可能是使用 scratch VM 演化出的最佳代码库获得更高部分得分的原因。

paragraphs.en: Across all three runs, evolved interfaces let the agent observe the desktop, an application’s own objects, data shared across applications, and whether a goal has been met, and act on each of these in a single call. Evolution therefore widens the range of software the agent can operate and raises the level at which it sees, acts and checks its progress.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有三次运行中，演化出的接口使智能体能够在一个调用中观察桌面、应用程序自身的对象、跨应用程序共享的数据以及目标是否达成，并对这些内容分别采取行动。 因此，演化扩大了智能体可操作软件的范畴，并提升了其感知、行动和检查进展的层次。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 follows the information-gathering portion of OSWorld V2 task 008, which requires receipts and corresponding card charges for an expense claim. The fixed-interface Qwen CUA agent opens receipt emails one at a time, handles five browser download warnings, and twice tries to open an invoice before its download has finished. Finding the $500 NeurIPS charge also requires eight scrolls and four clicks on Load more . With the evolved repository, the task agent uses browser.api to retrieve mailbox contents and attachment URLs as structured data. It downloads three PDFs with curl , reads them with pdftotext , and reuses the browser interface to query the bank dashboard and cross-check the charges. The agent combines a reusable browser interface with existing command-line tools to gather evidence across applications, reducing repeated visual navigation and manual download handling.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 展示了 OSWorld V2 任务 008 的信息收集阶段，该任务需要收据和相应的银行卡消费记录以进行费用报销。 固定接口的 Qwen CUA 智能体逐个打开收据邮件，处理了五个浏览器下载警告，并在下载未完成前两次尝试打开发票。 要找到 500 美元的 NeurIPS 消费记录，还需要向下滚动八次并四次点击“加载更多”。 借助进化后的代码库，任务智能体使用 browser.api 将邮箱内容和附件 URL 提取为结构化数据。 它通过 curl 下载三个 PDF 文件，用 pdftotext 读取这些文件，并再次利用浏览器界面查询银行仪表盘以核对消费记录。 该智能体将可重用的浏览器接口与现有的命令行工具相结合，跨应用程序收集证据，从而减少了重复的视觉导航和手动下载处理。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon computer-use tasks show substantial run-to-run variance ( Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2026 ) , so a single validation run can overrate a repository. On ScienceBoard, we therefore re-evaluate the three highest-scoring repositories every five steps and score each by the mean of its evaluations (Section 4 ). Figure 6 shows why this matters. Repositories if-003 and if-004 reach the highest first score, 73.33 % 73.33\% , at steps 3 and 4. A second evaluation lowers their means to 60.00 % 60.00\% and 66.67 % 66.67\% . The selected repository, if-016 , scores 73.33 % 73.33\% , 66.67 % 66.67\% , 73.33 % 73.33\% and 73.33 % 73.33\% across four evaluations, for a mean of 71.67 % 71.67\% . A first score alone would have ranked if-003 among the best repositories even though its mean is 60.00 % 60.00\% .
paragraphs.zh: 长期计算机使用任务在不同运行之间表现出显著差异（Gonzalez-Pumariega 等，2026），因此单次验证运行可能会高估某个知识库。 因此，在 ScienceBoard 上，我们每五个步骤重新评估得分最高的三个知识库，并根据其评估的平均值对每个知识库进行评分（第 4 节）。 图 6 说明了这一点的重要性。 知识库 if-003 和 if-004 在第 3 步和第 4 步时达到了最高的初始得分：73.33% 73.33\%。 第二次评估将其平均值降至 60.00% 60.00\% 和 66.67% 66.67\%。 被选中的知识库 if-016 在四次评估中的得分分别为 73.33% 73.33\%、66.67% 66.67\%、73.33% 73.33\% 和 73.33% 73.33\%，平均得分为 71.67% 71.67\%。 仅凭第一次的得分，if-003 就会被列为最佳知识库之一，尽管其平均得分仅为 60.00% 60.00\%。

paragraphs.en: Computer-use systems differ in how they expose observations and actions, and SWE-agent showed that this agent-computer interface shapes performance ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Agent S and Agent S2 organize planning, perception, and action through engineered agent components ( Agashe et al., 2025a ; Agashe et al., 2025b ) , while UI-TARS learns policies for GUI interaction ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . Other systems add programmatic access beside GUI actions, through application APIs ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , code execution ( Song et al., 2025a ) , or tool calls ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) . Agent S3 and its behavior judge improve task completion by selecting among multiple rollouts ( Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025 ) . In these systems, code and tools, when available, are one action among a predefined set. Agents that act only by writing and running code can outperform agents that choose from predefined actions ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . These interfaces are designed by people or written within a single task. Agent S4 instead evolves them across tasks and retains the resulting operations and usage knowledge in a repository that can be developed beyond the task that motivated a change.
paragraphs.zh: 计算机使用系统在暴露观察结果和行动的方式上存在差异，而 SWE-agent 表明，这种智能体与计算机的接口会影响性能（Yang et al., 2024）。 Agent S 和 Agent S2 通过工程化的智能体组件来组织规划、感知和行动（Agashe et al., 2025a; Agashe et al., 2025b），而 UI-TARS 则学习用于 GUI 交互的策略（Qin et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2025a）。 其他系统在 GUI 行动之外还增加了程序化访问方式，例如通过应用程序 API（Lu et al., 2025; Song et al., 2025b; Zhang et al., 2026a）、代码执行（Song et al., 2025a）或工具调用（Yang et al., 2025; Jia et al., 2026）。 Agent S3 及其行为判断器通过在多个展开方案中进行选择，从而提高了任务完成效率（Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025）。 在这些系统中，如果可用，代码和工具只是预定义集合中的一个行动选项。 仅通过编写和运行代码来执行操作的智能体，其表现可能优于从预定义行动中做出选择的智能体（Wang et al., 2024; Lu et al., 2026）。 这些接口由人类设计，或在单个任务中编写完成。 相比之下，Agent S4 会在不同任务中演化这些接口，并将由此产生的操作和使用知识存储在一个知识库中，该知识库可以在引发变更的任务之外继续发展。

sents.en: Computer-use systems differ in how they expose observations and actions, and SWE-agent showed that this agent-computer interface shapes performance ( Yang et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 计算机使用系统在暴露观察结果和行动的方式上存在差异，而 SWE-agent 表明，这种智能体与计算机的接口会影响性能（Yang et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Agent S and Agent S2 organize planning, perception, and action through engineered agent components ( Agashe et al., 2025a ; Agashe et al., 2025b ) , while UI-TARS learns policies for GUI interaction ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) .
sents.zh: Agent S 和 Agent S2 通过工程化的智能体组件来组织规划、感知和行动（Agashe et al., 2025a; Agashe et al., 2025b），而 UI-TARS 则学习用于 GUI 交互的策略（Qin et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2025a）。

sents.en: Other systems add programmatic access beside GUI actions, through application APIs ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , code execution ( Song et al., 2025a ) , or tool calls ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 其他系统在 GUI 行动之外还增加了程序化访问方式，例如通过应用程序 API（Lu et al., 2025; Song et al., 2025b; Zhang et al., 2026a）、代码执行（Song et al., 2025a）或工具调用（Yang et al., 2025; Jia et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Agent S3 and its behavior judge improve task completion by selecting among multiple rollouts ( Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: Agent S3 及其行为判断器通过在多个展开方案中进行选择，从而提高了任务完成效率（Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025）。

sents.en: In these systems, code and tools, when available, are one action among a predefined set.
sents.zh: 在这些系统中，如果可用，代码和工具只是预定义集合中的一个行动选项。

sents.en: Agents that act only by writing and running code can outperform agents that choose from predefined actions ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 仅通过编写和运行代码来执行操作的智能体，其表现可能优于从预定义行动中做出选择的智能体（Wang et al., 2024; Lu et al., 2026）。

sents.en: These interfaces are designed by people or written within a single task.
sents.zh: 这些接口由人类设计，或在单个任务中编写完成。

sents.en: Agent S4 instead evolves them across tasks and retains the resulting operations and usage knowledge in a repository that can be developed beyond the task that motivated a change.
sents.zh: 相比之下，Agent S4 会在不同任务中演化这些接口，并将由此产生的操作和使用知识存储在一个知识库中，该知识库可以在引发变更的任务之外继续发展。

paragraphs.en: Reflexion stores textual feedback for later attempts ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , and Agent Workflow Memory induces reusable procedures from experience ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . Reuse can also take executable form. LLMs as Tool Makers separates tool construction from subsequent tool use ( Cai et al., 2024 ) , and SkillWeaver discovers and practices web interactions to build APIs that other agents can reuse ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . CUA-Skill instead provides an engineered library of parameterized computer-use skills and composition graphs ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . These methods establish that agents can benefit from persistent knowledge and executable tools. Our search operates over complete repository versions containing interfaces, observation routines, configuration, and usage knowledge. Mutation and crossover can change these components together, with selection based on their combined effect on task-agent performance.

sents.en: Mutation and crossover can change these components together, with selection based on their combined effect on task-agent performance.

paragraphs.en: ADAS searches for agent designs expressed in code ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , and the Darwin Gödel Machine modifies its own coding agent while maintaining an archive of alternatives ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Self-Harness studies execution traces, proposes harness changes, and validates them through regression tests ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . AlphaEvolve and ShinkaEvolve combine model-generated code changes with evolutionary search and executable evaluation ( Novikov et al., 2025 ; Lange et al., 2025 ) , while GEPA uses trajectory reflection to evolve prompts and combine complementary improvements ( Agrawal et al., 2025 ) . Validation-based control of overfitting also predates language-model agents, including evolutionary curtailment in genetic programming ( Fitzgerald and Ryan, 2011 ) . Agent S4 evolves repositories of interfaces and knowledge through population-based search with asymmetric access to evaluation evidence. The meta-agent studies synthetic-task trajectories without ground-truth success labels and implements changes to application-specific operations, capability descriptions, and reusable workflows. The fixed harness retains control of model invocation, execution, permissions, and budgets. Keeping capabilities in the repository makes them available for revision, selection, recombination, and reuse with compatible agents and harnesses. Validation tasks, trajectories, diagnostics, and scores remain with the controller and are hidden from the meta-agent. Held-out performance determines which variants become parents, applying selection pressure beyond the tasks used to construct the software.
paragraphs.zh: ADAS 搜索以代码形式表达的智能体设计（Hu et al., 2025），而 Darwin Gödel Machine 在维持备选方案存档的同时，会修改自身的编码智能体（Zhang et al., 2025）。 Self-Harness 研究执行轨迹，提出 harness 的修改方案，并通过回归测试进行验证（Zhang et al., 2026b）。 AlphaEvolve 和 ShinkaEvolve 将模型生成的代码变更与进化搜索及可执行评估相结合（Novikov et al., 2025；Lange et al., 2025），而 GEPA 则利用轨迹反思来进化提示词并整合互补的改进（Agrawal et al., 2025）。 基于验证的过拟合控制也早于语言模型智能体的出现，包括遗传编程中的进化截断（Fitzgerald and Ryan, 2011）。 Agent S4 通过基于种群的搜索，结合对评估证据的非对称访问，来进化接口和知识库。 该元智能体研究无真实成功标签的合成任务轨迹，并对特定应用的操作、能力描述和可重用工作流实施修改。 固定的 harness 保留对模型调用、执行、权限和预算的控制权。 将能力保留在知识库中，使其可供修订、选择、重组，并与兼容的智能体和 harness 一起重用。 验证任务、轨迹、诊断信息和评分仍由控制器管理，并对元智能体隐藏。 预留的性能数据决定了哪些变体能成为父代，从而在软件构建所用任务之外施加选择压力。

paragraphs.en: We presented Agent S4, which treats interface design as an agent capability: a meta-agent studies computer-use trajectories to construct and evolve reusable interfaces and knowledge about when and how to use them. The experience used for interface construction comes entirely from synthetic tasks, without ground-truth success labels or task verifiers; separate held-out validation guides repository selection. Qwen3.8-27B with a repository of interfaces evolved by Agent S4 reaches 21.3 % 21.3\% binary success on the full 108-task OSWorld V2 benchmark, above both GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8, at about 4.3 % 4.3\% and 1.5 % 1.5\% of their reported task-solving costs. On the full 169-task ScienceBoard benchmark, a separate evolution run reaches 58.58 % 58.58\% success, compared with 41.4 % 41.4\% for Qwen CUA. Repository and trajectory analyses show how evolution constructs application interfaces and refines the operations and observations available to subsequent task agents. These findings support learning interfaces from synthetic experience as a way to improve computer use while keeping the task agent’s model and harness fixed, complementary to advances in both.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Agent S4，它将界面设计视为一种智能体能力：一个元智能体通过研究计算机使用轨迹，构建并演化可重用的界面以及关于何时和如何使用这些界面的知识。 用于界面构建的经验完全来自合成任务，没有真实成功标签或任务验证器；单独保留的验证集则用于指导仓库的选择。 配备由 Agent S4 演化出的界面仓库的 Qwen3.8-27B，在完整的 108 个任务的 OSWorld V2 基准测试中实现了 21.3% 的二元成功率，超过了 GPT-5.5 和 Claude Opus 4.8，且任务解决成本仅为后者的约 4.3% 和 1.5%。 在完整的 169 个任务的 ScienceBoard 基准测试中，一次独立的演化运行实现了 58.58% 的成功率，而 Qwen CUA 的成功率为 41.4%。 仓库和轨迹分析表明，演化过程如何构建应用程序界面，并优化后续任务智能体可用的操作和观察功能。 这些发现支持从合成经验中学习界面的方法，作为提升计算机使用效率的一种方式，同时保持任务智能体的模型和工具不变，这与两者各自的进步形成互补。

paragraphs.en: OSWorld V2. OSWorld V2 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) evaluates computer-use agents on 108 long-horizon workflows spanning everyday and professional activities in real desktop and web applications. Tasks require agents to combine information across sources, track application state, and adapt to changes during execution. The benchmark reports both binary task completion and partial scores, measuring whether agents can complete an entire workflow and how much of its requirements they satisfy. We use it as our primary benchmark for evaluating repository evolution on complex computer-use tasks.
paragraphs.zh: OSWorld V2。 OSWorld V2（Yuan 等人，2026）在真实桌面和网页应用程序中，针对涵盖日常和专业活动的 108 个长期工作流程，对计算机使用智能体进行了评估。 这些任务要求智能体整合来自不同来源的信息、跟踪应用程序状态，并在执行过程中适应变化。 该基准测试报告了任务的二元完成结果和分数，用于衡量智能体是否能够完成整个工作流程，以及满足其要求的程度。 我们将其用作评估复杂计算机使用任务中代码库演化的主要基准测试。

paragraphs.en: ScienceBoard. ScienceBoard ( Sun et al., 2025 ) evaluates autonomous agents in realistic scientific workflows involving professional software. It contains 169 human-curated tasks across scientific domains such as biochemistry, astronomy, and geoinformatics. These tasks combine scientific reasoning with software operation through graphical and command-line interfaces, testing whether agents can translate domain-specific instructions into successful execution in scientific environments. We use ScienceBoard to evaluate whether repository evolution extends to specialized scientific applications.
paragraphs.zh: ScienceBoard。 ScienceBoard（Sun 等人，2025）评估了智能体在涉及专业软件的现实科学工作流程中的表现。 它包含由人类精心设计的 169 项任务，涵盖生物化学、天文学和地理信息学等多个科学领域。 这些任务通过图形用户界面和命令行界面将科学推理与软件操作相结合，检验智能体是否能够将特定领域的指令成功转化为科学环境中的有效执行。 我们使用 ScienceBoard 来评估仓库的演化是否也适用于专业的科学应用。

paragraphs.en: The four evolution runs and their construction budgets are summarized in Table 1 . OSWorld V2 uses all 30 authored synthetic tasks. ScienceBoard uses 48 of the 50 authored tasks: we exclude sb_grassgis_010 , whose initialization fails a region check, and sb_chimerax_006 , whose input file fails to open in ChimeraX. These exclusions concern task initialization, before task-agent execution. Each benchmark uses 15 official tasks for validation. The full reported sets contain 108 OSWorld V2 tasks and 169 ScienceBoard tasks, including those validation tasks.

paragraphs.en: Our Qwen CUA baseline uses the upstream Qwen harness, with structured computer_use actions for mouse, keyboard, and screenshot control translated into PyAutoGUI. Our Prime Agent conditions instead expose persistent IPython execution, supporting Python and shell code for GUI, file, and API operations. We label these interfaces Extensible : programs the agent writes during a task become additional interfaces whose output returns directly to the agent. The seed and evolved conditions add repository interfaces accessible through this same tool, as described below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 Qwen CUA 基线模型使用上游的 Qwen 工具包，其中用于鼠标、键盘和屏幕截图控制的结构化 computer_use 动作已被转换为 PyAutoGUI。 相比之下，我们的 Prime Agent 条件则暴露了持久的 IPython 执行环境，支持使用 Python 和 shell 代码进行 GUI、文件和 API 操作。 我们将这些接口称为“可扩展”接口：智能体在任务过程中编写的程序会成为额外的接口，其输出会直接返回给智能体。 初始条件和演化条件还通过这一工具提供了可访问的仓库接口，具体如下文所述。

sents.zh: 我们的 Qwen CUA 基线模型使用上游的 Qwen 工具包，其中用于鼠标、键盘和屏幕截图控制的结构化 computer_use 动作已被转换为 PyAutoGUI。

paragraphs.en: For our OSWorld V2 and ScienceBoard repository-evolution experiments, we use a modified harness based on Prime Agent version 0.8.0-beta.546.1.a9b5d88 , 4 4 4 https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent/releases an IPython-backed coding agent. The harness prompts are reproduced in Appendix C . The model issues tool calls containing Python code, which the harness executes in a persistent IPython kernel and returns the execution outputs to the model for the next step. Variables, imports, and function definitions persist across calls, allowing the agent to reuse intermediate results and invoke repository interfaces throughout a task. Prime Agent’s native threshold-based context compaction is enabled within the 131,072-token context window. The harness reserves 36,096 tokens for the 32,000-token output budget and a 4,096-token overhead margin. Compaction is triggered when the last observed token usage plus the estimated trailing messages exceeds 94,976 tokens. It summarizes older conversation history while retaining the most recent 20,000 tokens verbatim. Prime Agent also automatically rescales oversized images to fit within 2000 × 2000 2000\times 2000 pixels while preserving aspect ratio, with further compression or downscaling as needed to keep the base64-encoded payload below 4.5 MiB. We disable Prime Agent’s automatic harness refinement. The task agent can still record notes in the harness state during a task, but this state is deleted before every task, so the repository is the only state that carries over between tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在 OSWorld V2 和 ScienceBoard 的仓库演化实验中，我们使用基于 Prime Agent 版本 0.8.0-beta.546.1.a9b5d88 的修改版工具包，这是一个由 IPython 支持的编码智能体。4 4 4 https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent/releases 该工具包的提示词在附录 C 中重现。 模型会发出包含 Python 代码的工具调用，工具包会在一个持久的 IPython 内核中执行这些代码，并将执行结果返回给模型以用于下一步操作。 变量、导入和函数定义会在多次调用之间保留，使智能体能够重复使用中间结果并在整个任务中调用仓库接口。 Prime Agent 的原生基于阈值的上下文压缩功能在 131,072 个标记的上下文窗口内已启用。 该工具包为 32,000 个标记的输出预算预留了 36,096 个标记，并留出了 4,096 个标记的冗余空间。 当最后观测到的标记使用量加上预计的后续消息总量超过 94,976 个标记时，压缩功能会被触发。 该功能会总结较早的对话历史，同时保留最近 20,000 个标记的原样内容。 Prime Agent 还会自动将过大图像重新调整大小，使其适配 2000 × 2000 像素的画幅并保留宽高比；如有需要，会进一步压缩或缩小尺寸，以确保 base64 编码后的数据量不超过 4.5 MiB。 我们禁用了 Prime Agent 的自动工具包优化功能。 任务智能体仍可在任务期间将笔记记录到工具包状态中，但该状态会在每次任务前被删除，因此仓库是唯一在任务间保留的状态。

paragraphs.en: For OSWorld V2, each candidate repository is installed at /home/user/shadow_interface/ . A fixed task-agent prompt supplies this path, directs the agent to inspect the toolkit, and encourages its use as the primary approach. The agent invokes python3 -m shadow_interface through the harness’s IPython tool. The capabilities subcommand lists interfaces with signatures and short descriptions; doc <module>.<function> displays full documentation, and call <module>.<function> [args ...] invokes an interface. The prompt also directs the agent to read the source code when the documentation is insufficient. These files expose the repository’s interfaces and usage knowledge without changing the harness’s tool set.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 OSWorld V2，每个候选仓库都安装在 /home/user/shadow_interface/ 目录下。 一个固定的任务-智能体提示词提供了该路径，指导智能体检查工具集，并鼓励其将其作为主要方法使用。 智能体通过 harness 的 IPython 工具调用 python3 -m shadow_interface。 capabilities 子命令会列出带有签名和简短说明的接口；doc <module>.<function> 会显示完整文档，而 call <module>.<function> [args ...] 则会调用某个接口。 该提示词还指导智能体在文档不足时阅读源代码。 这些文件无需修改 harness 的工具集，即可提供仓库的接口和使用知识。

paragraphs.en: All three evolution runs in this paper, on OSWorld V2 with and without a scratch VM and on ScienceBoard, start from the same seed repository. It has about 550 lines of Python and shell and offers 15 basic interfaces in four modules (Table 5 ). They wrap common desktop tools and the Chrome DevTools endpoint, and none is specific to a benchmark application. A setup script installs the tools these interfaces rely on, and a command-line entry point provides the capabilities , doc and call subcommands described above. Every interface, module and usage note in an evolved repository beyond these was added during evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 本文中的三次演化运行均基于 OSWorld V2（分别使用和不使用 scratch VM）以及 ScienceBoard，且都从同一个种子仓库开始。 该仓库包含约 550 行 Python 和 shell 代码，并提供分布在四个模块中的 15 个基础接口（见表 5）。 这些接口封装了常见的桌面工具和 Chrome DevTools 端点，但没有一个是针对特定基准应用的。 一个设置脚本会安装这些接口所依赖的工具，而一个命令行入口则提供了上述描述的 capabilities、doc 和 call 子命令。 演化后的仓库中，除上述内容之外的每个接口、模块和使用说明都是在演化过程中添加的。

paragraphs.en: We access Qwen3.8-27B through Parasail provider. We set temperature to 1, top- p p to 0.9, and thinking effort to Medium, with a 131,072-token context window and a 32,000-token output limit. The same model is used for the task agent, GUI grounding, and the interface builder. We estimate task-solving costs using Parasail’s rates of $0.24 per million uncached input tokens, $2.20 per million output tokens, and $0.05 per million cached input tokens. The cost estimates assume an 80% input-cache hit rate. The Qwen3.8-27B cost estimates in Table 2 use these rates. These estimates cover task-solving model calls; repository-evolution and runtime infrastructure costs are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 Parasail 提供商访问 Qwen3.8-27B。 我们将温度设为 1，top-p 设为 0.9，思考力度设为中等，并设置 131,072 个标记的上下文窗口和 32,000 个标记的输出限制。 任务智能体、GUI 接地和界面构建器均使用同一模型。 我们根据 Parasail 的费率估算任务解决成本：每百万个未缓存的输入标记为 0.24 美元，每百万个输出标记为 2.20 美元，每百万个已缓存的输入标记为 0.05 美元。 这些成本估算假设输入缓存命中率达到 80%。 表 2 中 Qwen3.8-27B 的成本估算采用了上述费率。 这些估算涵盖了任务解决所需的模型调用；仓库演化和运行时基础设施的成本未包含在内。

paragraphs.en: Our Prime Agent task rollouts use a budget of 300 completed assistant responses per task, with a timeout of 720 seconds for each model API call. A response may invoke code that performs multiple GUI or application actions. New OSWorld V2 training and validation rollouts have a two-hour wall-clock limit. OSWorld V2 full evaluation retains the API-call timeout and 300-step budget without a per-task wall-clock limit. ScienceBoard uses a 60-minute wall-clock limit in training, initial validation, validation re-evaluations, and full evaluation. The meta-agent has a separate two-hour wall-clock limit for each repository construction. Infrastructure failures may trigger recovery runs.

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows the repository lineage for the 30-step OSWorld V2 population run with a builder scratch VM. Starting from the seed, construction alternates between mutation of one parent and crossover of two distinct parents. Binary tournaments based on mean partial validation score select parents from the eligible population; after step 10, the five lowest-scoring variants lose parent eligibility. The resulting graph branches from earlier repositories and combines branches through crossover, allowing prior variants to contribute beyond the next construction step. Validation performance does not improve monotonically. At step 24, crossover combines repositories from steps 2 and 6 to obtain the highest mean partial score, 50.2 % 50.2\% , compared with 35.8 % 35.8\% for the seed. Its binary success rate is 26.7 % 26.7\% , tying steps 5, 25, and 29, compared with 6.7 % 6.7\% for the seed. Thus, earlier branches remain useful well beyond their construction step, and the two validation metrics distinguish different aspects of repository performance.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 展示了使用构建者空白虚拟机运行的 30 步 OSWorld V2 种群中仓库的谱系。 从种子开始，构建过程在单个父代的变异和两个不同父代的交叉之间交替进行。 基于平均部分验证分数的二进制锦标赛从合格种群中选择父代；在第 10 步之后，得分最低的五个变体将失去作为父代的资格。 由此产生的图从早期仓库分支出来，并通过交叉组合各分支，使先前变体的贡献能够延续到后续构建步骤之外。 验证性能并非单调提升。 在第 24 步，交叉操作结合了第 2 步和第 6 步的仓库，获得了最高的平均部分分数 50.2 % 50.2\% ，而种子的平均分数为 35.8 % 35.8\% 。 其二进制成功率为 26.7 % 26.7\% ，与第 5、25 和 29 步并列，而种子的成功率为 6.7 % 6.7\% 。 因此，早期分支在其构建步骤之后很长一段时间内仍然有用，且这两种验证指标能够区分仓库性能的不同方面。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 shows the corresponding 30-step ScienceBoard run with a 60-minute episode limit. Parent selection uses validation success averaged over the initial evaluation and any repeated evaluations, with denoising every five construction steps as described in Section 7.3 . The highest mean belongs to if-016 , a crossover of if-014 and if-009 : it achieves 71.7 % 71.7\% success over four evaluations of the 15 validation tasks, compared with the seed’s initial 53.3 % 53.3\% . Its parents have mean scores of 66.7 % 66.7\% and 60.0 % 60.0\% , respectively. Later variants continue to draw on earlier branches, but none exceeds if-016 ’s mean within the 30 steps. The lineage illustrates how crossover can combine branches with different validation histories while repeated evaluation informs which repositories remain promising.
paragraphs.zh: 图8展示了在每轮运行限制为60分钟的情况下，对应的30步ScienceBoard运行过程。 父智能体的选择基于初始评估及任何重复评估的平均验证成功率，并且如第7.3节所述，每五个构建步骤进行一次去噪处理。 最高的平均得分属于if-016，它是if-014和if-009的交叉产物：在15项验证任务的四次评估中，其成功率为71.7%（71.7\%），而初始智能体的成功率仅为53.3%（53.3\%）。 它的两个父智能体的平均得分分别为66.7%（66.7\%）和60.0%（60.0\%）。 后续变体仍然会利用早期的分支，但在30步内，没有任何一个变体的平均得分超过if-016。 该谱系展示了交叉操作如何将具有不同验证历史的分支进行结合，而重复评估则有助于判断哪些知识库仍有希望。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 compares the seed and evolved repository across 108 OSWorld V2 tasks. On each repository’s full-credit tasks, the evolved agent uses 7.1 % 7.1\% fewer tool calls on average while receiving full credit on more tasks. Together with the CDP case in Appendix B.4 , this suggests a useful role for helper functions: reusable operations can reduce repeated setup and combine multiple low-level interactions within a single tool call. Such savings can free steps for task-specific reasoning and execution.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 比较了初始代码库和演化后的代码库在 108 个 OSWorld V2 任务上的表现。 在每个代码库的全部分值任务中，演化后的智能体平均使用的工具调用次数减少了 7.1%（7.1\%），同时获得了更多任务的全部分值。 结合附录 B.4 中的 CDP 案例，这表明辅助函数具有实用价值：可重用的操作可以减少重复的准备工作，并将多个底层交互整合到单个工具调用中。 这种节省可以为任务特定的推理和执行释放步骤。

paragraphs.en: The aggregate comparison also shows why helper-level improvements need not shorten every trajectory. Across all tasks, mean call counts remain nearly unchanged. The full-credit subsets differ, and on the 11 tasks where both repositories receive full credit, the mean rises from 87.8 to 103.2 calls. Excluding the interrupted evolved attempt likewise leaves similar all-task means (163.2 for the seed and 163.4 for the evolved repository). Thus, the shorter full-credit average describes each repository’s successful trajectories rather than a uniform speedup on matched tasks. The CDP trace supplies concrete evidence of reduced setup and bulk-reading overhead; the aggregate results show that these local savings coexist with other sources of task-level variation.
paragraphs.zh: 总体比较也说明了为何辅助层级的改进并不一定缩短所有轨迹。 在所有任务中，平均调用次数几乎保持不变。 全得分子集存在差异；在两个仓库均获得全得分的 11 项任务中，平均值从 87.8 次上升到 103.2 次。 排除被中断的演化尝试后，所有任务的平均值也基本相同（种子仓库为 163.2 次，演化仓库为 163.4 次）。 因此，较短的全得分平均值反映的是每个仓库的成功轨迹，而非在匹配任务上的统一加速。 CDP 追踪提供了设置和批量读取开销降低的具体证据；总体结果表明，这些局部节省与任务层级的其他变异性来源共存。

paragraphs.en: We examine how a reusable Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) interface changes browser interaction in a client photo-delivery task. The agent must read instructions in TeamChat, reconcile invoices with payments in VaultBank, and prepare and email either finished photos or watermarked previews. We compare the seed repository with evolved variant if-011 on the same task. The seed provides browser target discovery but lacks a page-evaluation helper, whereas the evolved repository exposes browser.page_eval and browser.page_text for executing JavaScript and retrieving page text through CDP.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了可重用的 Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) 接口如何改变客户端照片交付任务中的浏览器交互方式。 智能体必须阅读 TeamChat 中的说明，在 VaultBank 中核对发票与付款情况，并准备通过电子邮件发送最终照片或带水印的预览图。 我们在同一任务上比较了初始仓库与演化后的变体 if-011。 初始仓库提供了浏览器目标发现功能，但缺少页面评估辅助工具；而演化后的仓库则通过 CDP 暴露了 browser.page_eval 和 browser.page_text，用于执行 JavaScript 并获取页面文本。

paragraphs.en: The seed agent implements its own CDP client during the task, encountering missing dependencies, an incorrect target identifier, and connection and message-handling failures before obtaining the requested direct message. The evolved interface encapsulates target selection and WebSocket communication, allowing the agent to navigate and read the message using existing helpers. The same message is retrieved by tool cell 11 with the evolved repository, compared with cell 37 for the seed. This illustrates how repository evolution can move browser setup and debugging out of the task trajectory and into reusable code.
paragraphs.zh: 种子智能体在任务过程中自行实现了 CDP 客户端，但在获取所请求的直接消息之前，遇到了依赖项缺失、目标标识符错误以及连接和消息处理失败等问题。 演化后的接口封装了目标选择和 WebSocket 通信，使智能体能够借助现有辅助工具进行导航和读取消息。 使用演化后的仓库时，工具单元格 11 获取了相同的消息，而种子智能体的工具单元格 37 则进行了对比。 这展示了仓库演化如何将浏览器设置和调试从任务轨迹中分离出来，并转化为可重用的代码。

paragraphs.en: The evolved agent also uses JavaScript to load additional bank transactions and extract 81 table rows from the page DOM. It then aggregates payments by client name in Python. Returning page text and structured records lets the agent process multiple entries in one operation, reducing the need for repeated visual inspection and transcription. The resulting interface supports both navigation and bulk reading through the same browser session.
paragraphs.zh: 进化后的智能体还使用 JavaScript 加载额外的银行交易记录，并从页面 DOM 中提取 81 行表格数据。 接着，它在 Python 中按客户名称汇总付款信息。 返回页面文本和结构化记录使智能体能够一次处理多个条目，从而减少了重复进行视觉检查和转录的需求。 由此生成的界面支持在同一浏览器会话中实现导航和批量阅读。

sents.en: The evolved agent also uses JavaScript to load additional bank transactions and extract 81 table rows from the page DOM.
sents.zh: 进化后的智能体还使用 JavaScript 加载额外的银行交易记录，并从页面 DOM 中提取 81 行表格数据。

sents.en: It then aggregates payments by client name in Python.
sents.zh: 接着，它在 Python 中按客户名称汇总付款信息。

sents.en: Returning page text and structured records lets the agent process multiple entries in one operation, reducing the need for repeated visual inspection and transcription.

sents.zh: 由此生成的界面支持在同一浏览器会话中实现导航和批量阅读。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 shows a shorter trajectory with fewer tool calls and image-bearing results, alongside a higher task score. The clearest mechanism is reduced browser setup overhead and direct access to page content. Both agents eventually use CDP, so the benefit illustrated here is making that capability readily reusable. The full task also includes file, image, and email operations, and the repositories differ in other interfaces; the overall duration difference is therefore an observed case outcome rather than an isolated estimate of CDP’s effect.
paragraphs.zh: 表8展示了一条更短的路径，其中工具调用次数更少，图像生成结果更多，同时任务得分也更高。 最明确的机制是浏览器设置开销的减少以及对页面内容的直接访问。 两种智能体最终都会使用CDP，因此此处所体现的优势在于使这一能力能够被便捷地重复利用。 完整任务还包括文件、图像和电子邮件操作，且各知识库在其他接口上存在差异；因此，整体时长的差异是观察到的结果，而非对CDP效应单独进行的估算。

sents.zh: 最明确的机制是浏览器设置开销的减少以及对页面内容的直接访问。

paragraphs.en: Figures 12 – 16 compare the seed repository with an evolved repository on the same task. The top row of each figure follows the seed episode through the agent’s own screenshots, in order. Red dots mark clicks at the coordinates in the agent’s code, drawn on a screenshot from the calls named under each panel. A stack of frames marks repeated attempts. In the Word case, where the seed agent works almost entirely in code, the later panels quote its code and output. The bottom row shows the evolved episode: the interface documentation the agent read, the call it made, and the output it received. The call and output are quoted from the trajectory, shortened where marked with an ellipsis. The documentation is condensed: function names and signatures are exact, the descriptions paraphrase the docstrings the agent printed, and the functions the agent used are highlighted.

paragraphs.en: Figures 18 – 20 compare the seed repository with the selected evolved repository, if-016 , on the same ScienceBoard tasks using the same task model and evaluation harness. paragraphs.zh: 图 18–20 在相同的 ScienceBoard 任务上，使用相同的任务模型和评估框架，将种子知识库与选定的演化知识库 if-016 进行了比较。 顶部一行（“无界面”）遵循种子集阶段中的 GUI 交互；底部一行（“有界面”）展示了演化后的辅助文档、调用以及返回的观察结果。 在所有情况下，两个阶段都通过了测试。 模型步数统计了助手完成的响应次数，包括重试、失败尝试、验证和最终答案；一个步骤可能包含多个操作。 每个条件下，每个任务都有一个阶段。 这些定性案例旨在说明界面的使用方式，而非估算处理效应或单独评估某个辅助工具带来的益处。

paragraphs.en: We use 30 synthetic tasks to provide construction experience for Agent S4. The set contains 21 tasks that use desktop applications and nine that involve local mock websites, sometimes together with desktop applications. Each task includes an instruction, input materials, and an initial application state. The tasks cover document and spreadsheet work, media editing, 3D modeling, research, file management, and web workflows. Table 9 lists all task IDs, goals, and applications. Section D.1 gives their full task-specific instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 30 个合成任务为智能体 S4 提供构建经验。 该集合包含 21 个使用桌面应用程序的任务，以及 9 个涉及本地模拟网站的任务，有时还会结合使用桌面应用程序。 每个任务都包括一个指令、输入材料和一个初始的应用程序状态。 这些任务涵盖了文档和电子表格操作、媒体编辑、3D 建模、研究、文件管理以及网页工作流程。 表 9 列出了所有任务的 ID、目标和应用程序。 D.1 节提供了它们完整的任务特定指令。

paragraphs.en: We used gpt-6-astra for task authoring and gpt-5.6-sol for independent task review. Author agents created original scenarios and materials from environment and coverage briefs. Independent reviewer agents assessed originality against the benchmark and the accepted synthetic bank, coherence, feasibility, and the challenge supported by the materials. This review assessed task design. It did not label agent attempts or create reference solutions. The training package uses a constant-zero evaluator for compatibility with the runner; this placeholder is not a success label or a training reward. The meta-agent receives the resulting training trajectories, while held-out validation determines selection as described in Section 3.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 gpt-6-astra 进行任务编写，并使用 gpt-5.6-sol 进行独立的任务评审。 编写智能体根据环境信息和覆盖简报创建了原始场景和材料。 独立评审智能体依据基准和已接受的合成数据库，对原创性、连贯性、可行性以及材料所支持的挑战程度进行了评估。 此次评审评估了任务设计。 它并未对智能体的尝试进行标记，也未创建参考解决方案。 该训练包使用一个恒定零的评估器以确保与运行器的兼容性；此占位符并非成功标签或训练奖励。 元智能体接收由此产生的训练轨迹，而预留的验证集则根据第 3.3 节所述的方式决定选择结果。

paragraphs.en: Keep the guide to two landscape A4 pages. Page 1 must contain the map and a compact studio directory. Preserve the map’s orientation, room positions, room codes, physical room names, corridor geometry and doorway gaps. Update each occupied room with the correct current studio name and replace the old directory with each current studio’s name, activity description, room code and room name. Apply the facilities notice to the visitor entrance, staff access, information desk, arrival route and legend. The arrival route must lead to the studio running Pocket notebook, using the current allocation. paragraphs.en: The field and collections leads need to see what is worth pursuing this campaign, what can happen now, what needs evidence first, and what must stay outside trial stock. Replace the departmental organization with three to five short, verb-led decision branches in workflow order, plus a compact evidence/reference branch. Preserve each of the four stand IDs and four lot IDs in one detailed home apiece. Separate source suitability, access/collection permission and lot-release state; do not reduce them to one ready/not-ready flag. For every stand show current evidence, the campaign decision and next action or reason no further action is warranted. For every lot show trial-release or separate-retention state, live prerequisites, and any resolved historical issue. Give each live next action an accountable role using the packet’s role guidance; do not invent dates, permissions or missing measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 领域负责人和收藏负责人需要明确本次行动中哪些事项值得推进、哪些可以立即执行、哪些需要先有证据支持，以及哪些必须排除在试验库存之外。 用三到五个简短的、以动词为导向的决策分支替代部门制组织结构，按工作流程排序，并增设一个紧凑的证据/参考分支。 每个展位 ID 和每个批次 ID 都必须保留在各自的详细主记录中。 将来源适宜性、访问/收集权限和批次释放状态分开处理；不要将它们简化为一个“已准备/未准备”的单一标志。 每个展位都应显示当前证据、行动决策以及下一步行动或无需进一步行动的理由。 每个批次都应显示试验释放或单独保留的状态、实时前提条件，以及任何已解决的历史问题。 为每个实时的下一步行动指定一个负有责任的角色，依据数据包中的角色指南执行；不要自行添加日期、权限或缺失的测量数据。

sents.en: The field and collections leads need to see what is worth pursuing this campaign, what can happen now, what needs evidence first, and what must stay outside trial stock.
sents.zh: 领域负责人和收藏负责人需要明确本次行动中哪些事项值得推进、哪些可以立即执行、哪些需要先有证据支持，以及哪些必须排除在试验库存之外。

sents.zh: 每个展位 ID 和每个批次 ID 都必须保留在各自的详细主记录中。

sents.en: Separate source suitability, access/collection permission and lot-release state; do not reduce them to one ready/not-ready flag.
sents.zh: 将来源适宜性、访问/收集权限和批次释放状态分开处理；不要将它们简化为一个“已准备/未准备”的单一标志。

sents.zh: 每个批次都应显示试验释放或单独保留的状态、实时前提条件，以及任何已解决的历史问题。

sents.en: Give each live next action an accountable role using the packet’s role guidance; do not invent dates, permissions or missing measurements.
sents.zh: 为每个实时的下一步行动指定一个负有责任的角色，依据数据包中的角色指南执行；不要自行添加日期、权限或缺失的测量数据。

paragraphs.en: Keep topic titles short enough to navigate. Use consistent labels for decision facets and place dated evidence, source IDs and reasons for rejecting stale claims in topic notes. Resolve the inherited claims against the correct authority, including count coverage, origin, permission scope, historical collection rights, chain recovery and drying evidence. Make retained demonstration material visibly distinct from trial stock. Add at least three named, directed relationships that expose real dependencies across the decision branches, including the dependence of lot release on its source/collection evidence. Use two meaningful boundaries around sibling action groups sharing an operational gate; their captions should explain the gate, not just say ’group’. Adapt the guide’s method to this packet rather than copying its photo-archive example.
paragraphs.zh: 保持主题标题足够简短，以便导航。 为决策维度使用一致的标签，并将带日期的证据、来源 ID 以及拒绝过时主张的理由置于主题说明中。 针对正确的授权方解决继承的主张，包括计数覆盖范围、来源、权限范围、历史收集权、链式恢复和干燥证据。 使保留的演示材料与试验库存明显区分开来。 添加至少三个有名称且明确指向的关系，以揭示决策分支之间的实际依赖关系，包括批次放行对其来源/收集证据的依赖。 在共享操作闸口的兄弟动作组周围设置两个有意义的边界；其标题应解释该闸口，而不仅仅是说“组”。 根据本数据包调整指南中的方法，而不是照搬其照片存档示例。

paragraphs.en: From: Nila Rao, thermal systems lead Released: 2026-06-19 15:00 / report order OL-63 Subject: Choose the cartridge for the next coolant skid prototype
paragraphs.zh: 发件人：Nila Rao，热系统负责人 发布日期：2026-06-19 15:00 / 报告编号 OL-63 主题：为下一台冷却剂模块原型选择卡匣

paragraphs.en: Use the attached bench records to prepare an editable LabPlot project and a single-page engineering figure. The three product names in the inventory must be the series labels. Our immediate decision is the 3.00 L/min duty point; use valid measurements whose corrected flow falls within 2.95–3.05 L/min, with no interpolation. A cartridge clears this screening only if its pressure-drop mean PLUS its combined standard uncertainty is at most 24.0 kPa AND its heat-transfer mean MINUS its standard uncertainty is at least 135 W. If no valid point remains in that duty window for a cartridge, label it unassessed. This is a conservative one-standard-uncertainty screening convention for this fictional prototype, not a statistical confidence or safety certification.
paragraphs.zh: 使用附带的测试台记录，准备一个可编辑的 LabPlot 项目和一个单页工程图。 库存中的三个产品名称必须作为系列标签。 我们的即时决策是 3.00 L/min 的工作点；使用有效测量值，其修正后的流量必须在 2.95–3.05 L/min 范围内，且不得进行插值计算。 只有当某个滤芯的压力降均值加上其综合标准不确定度最多为 24.0 kPa，并且其传热均值减去其标准不确定度至少为 135 W 时，该滤芯才能通过此筛选。 如果某个滤芯在该工作窗口内没有剩余的有效数据点，则将其标记为未评估。 这是针对该虚构原型的一种保守的单标准不确定度筛选惯例，而非统计置信度或安全认证。

paragraphs.en: Build two vertically aligned Cartesian panels with the same corrected-flow axis range and the same cartridge colors: pressure drop above, heat transfer below. Show all reportable sweep points, their vertical one-standard-uncertainty bars, and readable product legends. Use points with connecting segments only between valid measurements from the same cartridge, in increasing corrected-flow order rather than acquisition order; do not fit a model or interpolate the screening result. Mark the 24.0 kPa and 135 W thresholds and make the duty window understandable without obscuring the data. Axis labels must name quantities and units. Choose ranges that include the entire valid sweep and its uncertainty bars. Provide a compact caption stating the uncertainty convention, handling of invalid/replaced points, and calibration release used. Use marker shape as well as color to distinguish the products. Layout, labels and legends must be legible in a landscape A4 review print, with no overlap or clipping.
paragraphs.zh: 构建两个垂直对齐的笛卡尔坐标图，其修正流量轴范围相同，且产品卡颜色一致：压力降位于上方，传热位于下方。 显示所有可报告的扫描点、其垂直方向的一个标准不确定度棒以及清晰可读的产品图例。 仅使用来自同一产品卡的有效测量值之间的连接线段，按修正流量的升序排列，而非采集顺序；不得拟合模型或对筛选结果进行插值。 标记 24.0 kPa 和 135 W 的阈值，并确保工作区间清晰易读，同时不遮挡数据。 坐标轴标签必须明确标注物理量和单位。 选择能够包含整个有效扫描范围及其不确定度棒的坐标轴范围。 提供一个简洁的图注，说明不确定度约定、无效/替换点的处理方式以及所采用的校准版本。 同时使用标记形状和颜色来区分不同产品。 布局、标签和图例必须在横向 A4 评审打印图中清晰可读，且不得出现重叠或截断。

paragraphs.en: Open the supplied ReviewVault in Obsidian and complete it in place. Reassess all four proposed claim notes; preserve each original proposal, add a scoped judgement using the procedure’s vocabulary, and explain what evidence supports or limits it. Distinguish independent evidence from related analyses and observed associations from causal claims. For Value, show the defensible recurring cost per delivered message, disclose the setup charge, and explain what can or cannot be said about cost per extra attended appointment. Use stable source IDs shared with Zotero, source-section locators, and bidirectional source/claim links. Build source notes for every retained work, a source register/identity ledger mapping every incoming ID, and concept notes that explain the distinctions actually used in your reasoning. Complete Home navigation and an unresolved-questions note with concrete evidence gaps and implications for expansion. No community plugins, live URIs or external links are necessary; plain internal links suffice.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Obsidian 中打开提供的 ReviewVault，并直接完成填写。 重新评估所有四份拟定的索赔说明；保留每份原始提案，使用该流程的术语添加限定性判断，并说明哪些证据支持或限制了这些判断。 区分独立证据与相关分析，以及观察到的关联与因果主张。 在“价值”部分，展示每条已交付消息的可辩护重复成本，披露初始设置费用，并说明关于每次额外预约的成本可以或不可以得出哪些结论。 使用与 Zotero 共享的稳定来源 ID、来源部分定位符以及双向来源/索赔链接。 为所有保留的工作创建来源说明，建立一份来源登记册/身份账本以映射每个传入的 ID，并编写概念说明来解释你在推理中实际使用的区别。 完成“主页”导航，并撰写一份未解决疑问说明，其中包含具体的证据缺失情况及其对扩展的影响。 无需使用社区插件、实时 URI 或外部链接；普通的内部链接即可满足需求。
