paragraphs.en: Prepare Tern Works’ Bay 4 pump-enclosure planning review in Blender. The supplied pack is at /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r008 . Import starter.obj with its MTL, preserve the measured KEEP_ equipment, and replace the stale DRAFT_ guard concept with the currently authorized enclosure. Reconcile the installed module history, module cards and field-level decision register; use their dimensions to lay out the guard, working front gate and service-clearance display. Model and organize the enclosure, visible hinge/latch blocks, closed gate, open-position ghost and clearance geometry through Blender UI editing. Do not generate the requested scene with a script. Give the assembly the specified materials, a simple floor, readable dimensional annotations and suitable lights/cameras. Produce an elevated front-east review render and an orthographic top clearance render following the review requirements in 04_decisions.txt . This is a concept review, with simplified construction details. Save the editable scene as /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r008/output/TW41_review.blend and the two PNGs as TW41_assembly.png and TW41_clearance.png in that output folder; use at least 1400 pixels on the long edge. Add review_notes.txt identifying the active module and accepted revisions, derived service-side location, any cutaway/visibility steps needed to reproduce the views, and any unresolved design issue. Keep named collections and both cameras in the native scene.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Blender 中准备 Tern Works 的 Bay 4 泵房规划评审。 提供的文件包位于 /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r008 。 导入 starter.obj 及其 MTL 文件，保留已测量的 KEEP_ 设备，并用当前批准的泵房结构替换过时的 DRAFT_ 防护概念模型。 核对已安装模块的历史记录、模块卡以及现场决策登记册；利用其尺寸来布局防护结构、工作前门和服务通道显示。 通过 Blender 的界面编辑功能，对泵房、可见的铰链/锁块、关闭的门、开启状态的虚影以及间隙几何体进行建模和组织。 不要使用脚本生成所请求的场景。 为装配体指定所需材质，添加简单的地面、清晰的尺寸标注以及合适的灯光和相机。 根据 04_decisions.txt 中的评审要求，生成一个抬高的前东方向评审渲染图和一个正投影的顶部间隙渲染图。 这是一个概念性评审，包含简化的构造细节。 将可编辑的场景保存为 /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r008/output/TW41_review.blend，并将两个 PNG 图像保存为该输出文件夹中的 TW41_assembly.png 和 TW41_clearance.png；长边像素至少为 1400。 添加 review_notes.txt 文件，注明当前使用的模块和已接受的修订、派生出的服务侧位置、重现视图所需的任何剖面/可见性步骤，以及任何未解决的设计问题。 保留命名好的集合和两个相机在原始场景中。

paragraphs.en: You are Morgan Hale, Operations Coordinator at Northwick Editions. Resolve the NW-46 damaged folio case in MailHub using the correspondence and the records in /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r010 . Bring the supplier to a clear, authorized instruction that restores the required usable stock and requests the correct remedy for the paid invoice. Use your delegated authority and contact the relevant people where needed; keep the case current with incoming correspondence while you work. Send the final supplier instruction if the evidence supports a commitment within your authority, otherwise send the concrete issue for escalation without committing funds. Preserve the correspondence history. Replace or remove the obsolete full-remake draft so it cannot be sent accidentally. Leave one concise Finance handoff email as a draft to Nadia Bell, copied to Lea Moss, explaining the current stock, separate financial movements, evidence, and outstanding owners/actions. Do not treat an unacknowledged order or requested credit as complete. Organize the case with a MailHub label named NW-46 so the handoff and substantive case correspondence are easy to find. All participants are fictional and this is a simulated mailbox.
paragraphs.zh: 你是 Morgan Hale，Northwick Editions 的运营协调员。 在 MailHub 中利用通信记录和 /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r010 中的档案，解决 NW-46 受损书册案。 向供应商发出明确且经授权的指令，以恢复所需的可用库存，并就已付款的发票请求正确的补救措施。 运用你被授予的权限，在必要时联系相关人员；在处理过程中，通过收到的通信保持案件信息的最新状态。 如果证据支持在你的权限范围内作出承诺，则发送最终供应商指令；否则，将具体问题提交升级处理，但不得承诺任何资金。 保留通信历史记录。 替换或删除过时的完全重制草案，以免其被意外发送。 向 Nadia Bell 起草一封简洁的财务交接邮件（抄送 Lea Moss），说明当前库存、独立的财务变动、相关证据以及待处理的责任人/行动项。 不得将未确认的订单或信用申请视为已完成。 为该案添加名为 NW-46 的 MailHub 标签，以便轻松找到交接信息和核心案件通信记录。 所有参与者均为虚构人物，这是一个模拟邮箱。

paragraphs.en: You are Robin Hale at CedarWatch on 19 October 2026. Prepare the Westmere renewal handoff in CloudCRM using the four records in /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r011 . Read 01_operations_brief.txt for our recording conventions and handoff requirements. Reconcile the existing Westmere account and contacts, the base renewal and separate Annex extension opportunities, the two service cases, and their next actions against the filed commercial, directory and service evidence. Correct relationships and stale information without deleting history or creating duplicate accounts, contacts or opportunities. Record annual subscription and first-invoice figures consistently; do not mistake filing, planning or budget acknowledgement for contract acceptance or technical release. Put actionable Finance and Service next steps with the specified owners and due dates into the opportunity nextStep fields and relevant case description. Publish the current "Westmere | 19 October handoff" Chatter post described in the operations brief and leave it visible. Keep work in CloudCRM; no external messages, attachments, reports, exports or local finished document are needed.
paragraphs.zh: 你是 CedarWatch 的 Robin Hale，日期为 2026 年 10 月 19 日。 使用 /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r011 中的四条记录，在 CloudCRM 中准备 Westmere 续约交接工作。 阅读 01_operations_brief.txt，了解我们的记录规范和交接要求。 将现有的 Westmere 账户和联系人、基础续约及独立的附录扩展机会、两个服务工单及其后续行动，与已提交的商业文件、目录和服务证据进行核对。 修正关联关系和过时信息，但不要删除历史记录或创建重复的账户、联系人或机会。 一致地记录年度订阅费和首张发票金额；不要将文件提交、规划或预算确认误认为合同接受或技术放行。 将具有可操作性的财务和服务后续步骤（包括指定负责人和截止日期）填入机会的 nextStep 字段及相关工单描述中。 发布操作简报中描述的当前“Westmere | 10 月 19 日交接”Chatter 帖子，并保持其可见状态。 所有工作均需在 CloudCRM 中完成；无需任何外部消息、附件、报告、导出文件或本地完成的文档。

paragraphs.en: Use LibreOffice Draw to turn /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r012/return-mat-starter.svg into Mend & Lend’s finished kit return mat. Follow /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r012/design-brief.txt for the item geometry, content, layout and print requirements. Substantially edit the supplied vector parts: close the scissors, cap the seam ripper, tuck the tape tail, resize all five silhouettes, and arrange a readable set of item stations with a handling strip and scale check. Keep the working result editable in Draw. Save /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r012/Mend-and-Lend-return-mat.odg and export the matching one-page A3 landscape PDF to /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r012/Mend-and-Lend-return-mat.pdf . paragraphs.en: In CareerLink, update only the company Overview and Specialties so they accurately describe the approved service alongside our existing software. Configure the Message button and inbox topics for the staffed intake routes. Create the single open Migration Support Coordinator role specified in the approved hiring authorization, with a complete, readable description covering terms, work, requirements and the application route. Reply as the company in Mae Porter — Marlow Stage’s existing conversation: address the actual situation in the thread, correct the obsolete claims, give their applicable Bridge total and request what is still needed for manual confirmation. Finally publish one company launch post explaining the approved offer and inquiry route in clear customer-facing prose. Preserve the historical post, existing conversation history and unrelated company details. No scheduling, attachments or external service actions are needed; the company website address is context only. Finish with the changes saved in CareerLink; no separate report is required.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CareerLink 中，仅更新公司概述和专长部分，使其能准确描述已批准的服务以及我们现有的软件。 为有人值守的受理渠道配置消息按钮和收件箱主题。 根据已批准的招聘授权创建唯一开放的迁移支持协调员职位，并提供完整且易于阅读的描述，涵盖相关术语、工作内容、要求及申请流程。 以 Mae Porter — Marlow Stage 现有对话中的公司身份进行回复：在对话线程中说明实际情况，纠正过时说法，提供其适用的 Bridge 总额，并说明手动确认仍需要哪些信息。 最后发布一篇公司启动帖，用清晰易懂的面向客户的语言解释已批准的服务方案及咨询流程。 保留历史帖子、现有对话记录以及与公司无关的其他详细信息。 无需安排日程、添加附件或执行任何外部服务操作；公司网站地址仅用于提供背景信息。 完成所有更改后，在 CareerLink 中保存即可；无需另行生成报告。

paragraphs.en: Use Letter portrait pages for the cover, contents and three prose chapters, with margins of at least 0.7 inches. Keep the cover and contents on separate unnumbered pages. Begin Prepare the session on the next page, numbered 1, with subsequent page-number fields in the footer. Each of the three prose chapters should begin a fresh page; allow prose to flow within its chapter without stranded headings or unnecessary blank pages. Give the final Observation sheet its own Letter landscape page style and continue the body page-number sequence. It must occupy one detachable page, including its title, identification line, instructions, table and two closing prompts. Keep all four table columns in the supplied order. Give the Notice column 1.5–1.8 inches and each writing column at least 2.1 inches, with each of the four body rows at least 0.75 inches tall. Keep the header row readable, body labels intact, rows unsplit and both closing prompts clear of the table and footer. Do not shrink body or form text below 11 pt to force a fit.
paragraphs.zh: 封面、目录和三个散文章节请使用 Letter 竖版页面，页边距至少为 0.7 英寸。 封面和目录应分别置于独立的无编号页面上。 从下一页（编号为 1）开始准备“准备会议”部分，并在页脚中继续添加后续页码字段。 三个散文章节各自应从新页面开始；确保每章内的散文内容连贯流畅，避免标题孤立或出现不必要的空白页。 最后的“观察”表应使用独立的 Letter 横版页面样式，并延续正文部分的页码序列。 该部分必须占据一个可撕下的独立页面，包括其标题、标识行、说明、表格和两个结尾提示。 保持表格全部四列按所提供的顺序排列。 “通知”列的宽度应为 1.5–1.8 英寸，每列写作列的宽度至少为 2.1 英寸，且四行正文内容的高度每行至少为 0.75 英寸。 保持表头行清晰易读，正文标签完整无缺，各行不被拆分，且两个结尾提示均不与表格或页脚重叠。 不得将正文或表格文本缩小至 11 磅以下以强行适应页面空间。

paragraphs.en: Finish Rill Market’s cup circulation planning workbook in LibreOffice Calc. The files are in /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r015 . Start from cup-circulation-starter.xlsx , read operations-spec.txt , and adapt the procedure in calc-reuse-guide.txt to this workbook. Complete one formula-driven six-day model with the specified daily order, previous-day returns, clean and dirty stock carryforward, capacity constraints, and blank-versus-zero wash overrides. Wire the single case selector through the active drivers to all days and the summary. Preserve the supplied inputs and both tabs. Add usable numeric input validity, live shortage/reserve warnings, and accidental-edit protection while keeping the intended inputs editable. Include brief operating notes in the workbook. Exercise both cases and representative input changes, restore the original values, and leave Regular service selected. Save /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r015/cup-circulation.ods and a short /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r015/handoff.txt describing what you changed, the input changes tried, observed behavior and any remaining limitation. Follow the operating specification for all model definitions and handoff details.
paragraphs.zh: 在 LibreOffice Calc 中完成 Rill Market 的杯具周转规划工作簿。 文件位于 /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r015 目录下。 从 cup-circulation-starter.xlsx 开始，阅读 operations-spec.txt，并根据 calc-reuse-guide.txt 中的流程对该工作簿进行调整。 完成一个由公式驱动、为期六天的模型，其中需包含指定的每日订单、前一日退货量、干净与脏污库存的结转、容量限制，以及空白值与零值之间的清洗覆盖规则。 将单个案例选择器通过活跃驱动因子连接到所有日期和摘要部分。 保留所提供的输入数据及两个工作表标签页。 添加可用的数值输入有效性验证、实时的短缺/储备警告以及意外编辑保护，同时保持预期输入的编辑功能。 在工作簿中附上简要的操作说明。 测试两种情况及具有代表性的输入变更，恢复原始值，并保持“常规服务”选项被选中。 将文件保存为 /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r015/cup-circulation.ods，并编写一份简短的 /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r015/handoff.txt 文件，说明你进行了哪些修改、尝试了哪些输入变更、观察到的行为以及任何尚存的限制。 所有模型定义和交接细节均须遵循操作规范。

paragraphs.en: Act as Rowan Ellis, the Rowan Borough case officer for RB-26-104. Read the three local records in /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r016 and the case correspondence in MailHub. Complete and submit the existing FormCraft temporary pedestrian diversion intake through its GUI, requesting the shortest defensible route under the supplied case conditions and within the delegated funding ceiling. paragraphs.en: Synthesize the process rather than pasting the notes. Show the normal route from recording/brief to a public episode, including guest approval tied to a particular cut, the parallel work that becomes possible after locking, the final-audio dependency of transcript review, and the common publication gate. Make it clear who owns the main work and which items the listener actually receives. Page-copy preparation must be visible without implying that it starts only after the audio is locked.
paragraphs.zh: 要综合呈现整个流程，而不是简单粘贴笔记。 展示从录音/简报到公开节目的常规流程，包括与特定剪辑版本挂钩的嘉宾审批、锁定后得以并行开展的工作、文稿审核对最终音频的依赖关系，以及共同的发布节点。 明确说明谁负责主要工作，以及听众实际能获得哪些内容。 页面文本的准备过程必须清晰可见，但不能暗示这项工作仅在音频锁定之后才开始。

paragraphs.en: Show listener reports returning through the producer and distinguish a text-only correction from a change to spoken content. The former should visibly return only through the checks it needs; the latter must return to the appropriate upstream work and rejoin the release gate with replacement audio, transcript and approval. Make the transcript-review revision loop understandable too. Do not invent additional approval bodies, deadlines or episode data.
paragraphs.zh: 展示监听报告如何通过生产者返回，并区分纯文本更正与对口语内容的修改。 前者应仅通过其所需的检查环节可见地返回；后者必须返回至适当的上游工作流，并以替换的音频、文稿和批准结果重新加入发布流程。 同时，要使文稿审核的修订循环易于理解。 不要额外创造审批机构、截止日期或剧集数据。

paragraphs.en: Choose a spatial organization in which native labeled groups, directed labeled connections and card hierarchy explain these relationships. Reserve a clear route for the correction loops so they do not obscure the normal handoffs. Connection labels should communicate the handoff or condition, not just say “next.” Use color consistently with a small legend, but keep meanings readable without relying on color alone. Avoid a single long chain or a departmental tree: parallel work, shared inputs and return routes should be apparent from placement. Aim for roughly 12–16 concise main cards; use supporting notes for detail. At a useful overview zoom, headings and the main route should remain readable; at working zoom, no text, labels or cards should overlap or be clipped, and edge endpoints must be unambiguous.
paragraphs.zh: 选择一种空间组织方式，使带有原生标签的组、有向标签连接和卡片层级能够解释这些关系。 为修正循环预留一条清晰的路径，以免它们遮挡正常的交接流程。 连接标签应传达交接或状态信息，而不仅仅是标注“下一步”。颜色使用需保持一致并附带小型图例，但含义本身无需依赖颜色即可清晰阅读。 避免采用单一的长链结构或部门树状结构：通过布局应能直观看出并行工作、共享输入和返回路径。 尽量使用约 12–16 张简洁的主卡片；细节信息可通过辅助说明补充。 在实用的概览缩放级别下，标题和主路径应保持可读；在工作缩放级别下，任何文本、标签或卡片均不得重叠或被截断，且边缘端点必须清晰明确。

paragraphs.en: You are Neris Calven, the assigned reviewer for Submission 22, “Branch hints improve transferable learning in unfamiliar archive sorting,” in the mock Ledger Learning Workshop 2027. Read the local package beginning at /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r022/00_reading_index.txt and submit one complete official review in ReviewSphere. Assess the central learning claim against the manuscript, deposited plan, assessment specification, workshop counts and analysis memo. Use the venue guidance for review scope. Populate title, review, strengths, weaknesses, questions and limitations with a constructive, sourced assessment, showing the numerical comparisons that materially support your reasoning. Distinguish what existing evidence could resolve from what needs further research. Choose rating and confidence yourself. After submission, reload and confirm that your review remains visible and complete; edit that same review if needed rather than creating duplicates. The assignment is already seeded; do not change assignments, edit the manuscript or contact anyone. All research and identities are fictional. No external reading or separate output document is required.
paragraphs.zh: 你是 Neris Calven，2027 年模拟 Ledger 学习研讨会中编号为 22 的投稿《分支提示可提升在陌生档案排序中的迁移学习能力》的指定评审员。 请阅读位于 /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r022/00_reading_index.txt 的本地包，并在 ReviewSphere 提交一份完整的官方评审意见。 请结合手稿、已提交的计划、评估规范、研讨会统计数据和分析备忘录，对核心学习主张进行评估。 请依据该研讨会的指导方针确定评审范围。 在标题、评审意见、优势、劣势、问题与局限性等部分中，填写具有建设性且引用来源的评估内容，并展示能够实质性支持你论证的数值比较。 请区分哪些内容已有现有证据可以解决，哪些内容仍需进一步研究。 评级和置信度由你自己决定。 提交后，请重新加载并确认你的评审意见仍然可见且完整；如有需要，请编辑同一份评审意见，而非创建重复版本。 该任务已预先分配；请勿更改分配、修改手稿或联系任何人。 所有研究和身份均为虚构。 无需进行外部阅读或生成单独的输出文档。

paragraphs.en: We need a short silent teaching video for a public mechanics display. paragraphs.en: Make an 18–24 second, 1280 × \times 720, 30 fps comparison in Shotcut:
paragraphs.zh: 在 Shotcut 中制作一个时长 18–24 秒、分辨率为 1280 × 720、帧率为 30 fps 的对比视频：

paragraphs.en: •A short opening introduces ‘‘Same release, different damping’’ and identifies the footage as an illustrative simulation. • The central comparison places Damping A in the upper panel and Damping B in the lower panel, playing simultaneously at their original speed. Trim away unnecessary waiting, retain about half a second held before release, synchronize the visible release to within two output frames, and show at least ten seconds after release in both panels. The gray lamp turns green when the release jaw withdraws. Confirm alignment from motion as well as the lamp; do not synchronize the raw file starts. • Match physical scale using the visible 100 MM bars: they should appear equally long to within roughly 5%. Align the two vertical REST datums to the same screen x position to within about 8 pixels. Preserve proportions. Keep the moving carts, spring anchor, rest band and scale bars visible throughout. Crop unused source margins and arrange clean, distinct panels, with no footage spilling into the other panel. Panel labels must remain legible and not cover the moving cart or scale bars. Original corner run labels may be cropped away. • Follow the main comparison with a synchronized half-speed replay of a 2–3 second interval that clearly shows the difference around the first passage through rest and subsequent reversal. Choose the interval by inspecting the footage. Enlarge/reframe this replay around the carts and rest bands; keep the two panels at equal physical scale and their rest datums aligned. The spring anchors and scale bars may fall outside this closer crop, but the cart travel during the chosen interval must remain visible. Label the replay ‘‘Half speed’’. • End by holding an informative comparison image for approximately two seconds with one short, plain-language observation supported by what viewers just saw. Mention both overshoot and settling behavior, without inventing measured settling times or presenting a real engineering certification. Keep this readable at normal display size.
paragraphs.zh: •简短的开场介绍“相同释放，不同阻尼”，并指出该画面为示意性模拟。• 核心对比将阻尼 A 置于上方面板，阻尼 B 置于下方面板，并以原始速度同步播放。 剪除不必要的等待时间，保留释放前约半秒的静止画面，将可见的释放时刻同步到两个输出帧以内，并在两个面板中显示释放后至少十秒的画面。 当释放夹爪收回时，灰色灯会变为绿色。 通过运动以及灯光确认对齐；不要同步原始文件的起始时间。• 利用可见的 100 MM 标尺匹配物理比例：两者长度应大致相同，误差不超过约 5%。 将两个垂直的 REST 基准点对齐到屏幕上的同一 x 位置，误差不超过约 8 像素。保持比例不变。 在整个过程中保持移动小车、弹簧锚点、静止带和标尺可见。 裁切未使用的源画面边缘，安排干净、清晰的面板，确保画面不会溢出到另一面板。 面板标签必须保持清晰可辨，且不能遮挡移动小车或标尺。 原始角落的运行标签可以裁切掉。• 在主要对比之后，同步播放一段 2–3 秒的慢速重播（速度为原速的一半），清晰展示第一次经过静止点时的差异以及随后的反向运动。 通过查看画面选择该时间区间。 围绕小车和静止带放大/重新构图这段重播；保持两个面板的物理比例一致，且其静止基准点对齐。 弹簧锚点和标尺可能超出这一更紧凑的裁切范围，但所选区间内小车的移动必须保持可见。 将重播标记为“半速”。• 最后展示一张信息丰富的对比图像约两秒，并用一句简短、通俗易懂的观察结论加以说明，内容需与观众刚刚看到的内容一致。 提及超调和稳定过程，但不要编造测量出的稳定时间或呈现真实的工程认证。 确保在正常显示尺寸下清晰可读。

paragraphs.zh: 根据所提供的先决条件和完整性规则，解释每位学习者的回应。 构建一个本地 Calc 数据源，保留所有学习者，并记录所选的问题/保留状态、简洁的内部证据原因以及这些信件所需的个性化教学内容。 遵循同意和观察不完整规则。 对每封发出的信件，从活动库中选择一个合适的活动，并提供基于该学习者回应的支持性反馈，不得包含分数或公开的内部标签。

sents.zh: 根据所提供的先决条件和完整性规则，解释每位学习者的回应。

sents.en: Build a local Calc data source that retains all learners and records the chosen issue/hold state, a concise internal evidence reason, and the individualized teaching content needed for the letters.
sents.zh: 构建一个本地 Calc 数据源，保留所有学习者，并记录所选的问题/保留状态、简洁的内部证据原因以及这些信件所需的个性化教学内容。

sents.en: Follow the consent and incomplete-observation rules.
sents.zh: 遵循同意和观察不完整规则。

sents.en: For each issued letter use one appropriate activity from the bank and supportive feedback grounded in that learner’s responses, with no score or public internal labels.
sents.zh: 对每封发出的信件，从活动库中选择一个合适的活动，并提供基于该学习者回应的支持性反馈，不得包含分数或公开的内部标签。

paragraphs.en: Convert the starting letter into one reusable native Writer merge master with genuine database-backed fields. Suppress optional address lines and the kit paragraph using native conditional/address features. Bind to the saved local data, retain any connector needed to reopen the merge, and produce a single combined editable ODT and PDF in LearnerID order. Follow every requirement in production_request.txt , including one A4 page per recipient, at least 11 pt body text, at least 35 mm clear response space, the correct practice and session details, and consistent recipient data. Inspect the full run and regenerate from the master if anything needs correction.
paragraphs.zh: 将起始字母转换为一个可重复使用的原生 Writer 合并主文件，其中包含真正的数据库支持字段。 使用原生条件/地址功能隐藏可选的地址行和套件段落。 绑定到已保存的本地数据，保留重新打开合并操作所需的任何连接器，并以 LearnerID 顺序生成单个合并后的可编辑 ODT 和 PDF 文件。 遵循 production_request.txt 中的每一项要求，包括每位收件人对应一页 A4 纸、至少 11 磅的正文字号、至少 35 毫米的清晰响应空间、正确的实践和会话详细信息，以及一致的收件人数据。 检查整个运行结果，如有任何需要更正之处，则从主文件重新生成。

sents.en: Convert the starting letter into one reusable native Writer merge master with genuine database-backed fields.
sents.zh: 将起始字母转换为一个可重复使用的原生 Writer 合并主文件，其中包含真正的数据库支持字段。

sents.en: Suppress optional address lines and the kit paragraph using native conditional/address features.
sents.zh: 使用原生条件/地址功能隐藏可选的地址行和套件段落。

sents.en: Bind to the saved local data, retain any connector needed to reopen the merge, and produce a single combined editable ODT and PDF in LearnerID order.
sents.zh: 绑定到已保存的本地数据，保留重新打开合并操作所需的任何连接器，并以 LearnerID 顺序生成单个合并后的可编辑 ODT 和 PDF 文件。

sents.en: Follow every requirement in production_request.txt , including one A4 page per recipient, at least 11 pt body text, at least 35 mm clear response space, the correct practice and session details, and consistent recipient data.
sents.zh: 遵循 production_request.txt 中的每一项要求，包括每位收件人对应一页 A4 纸、至少 11 磅的正文字号、至少 35 毫米的清晰响应空间、正确的实践和会话详细信息，以及一致的收件人数据。

sents.en: Inspect the full run and regenerate from the master if anything needs correction.
sents.zh: 检查整个运行结果，如有任何需要更正之处，则从主文件重新生成。

paragraphs.en: Save final files together in /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r030/output/ : home_practice_master.odt , learners.ods , home_practice_letters.odt , home_practice_letters.pdf , any required local database connector, and handoff.txt . The handoff should identify held IDs and reasons and explain the local connection and repeat-run procedure. Do not email, send, or physically print anything.
paragraphs.zh: 将所有最终文件统一保存至 /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r030/output/ 目录中：home_practice_master.odt、learners.ods、home_practice_letters.odt、home_practice_letters.pdf、任何必需的本地数据库连接器以及 handoff.txt。 交接文件中应明确列出保留的 ID 及其原因，说明本地连接方式及重复运行流程。 不得通过电子邮件发送、传输或物理打印任何内容。

sents.en: Save final files together in /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r030/output/ : home_practice_master.odt , learners.ods , home_practice_letters.odt , home_practice_letters.pdf , any required local database connector, and handoff.txt .
sents.zh: 将所有最终文件统一保存至 /home/user/CUESTraining/cues_r030/output/ 目录中：home_practice_master.odt、learners.ods、home_practice_letters.odt、home_practice_letters.pdf、任何必需的本地数据库连接器以及 handoff.txt。

sents.en: The handoff should identify held IDs and reasons and explain the local connection and repeat-run procedure.
sents.zh: 交接文件中应明确列出保留的 ID 及其原因，说明本地连接方式及重复运行流程。

sents.en: Do not email, send, or physically print anything.
sents.zh: 不得通过电子邮件发送、传输或物理打印任何内容。

paragraphs.en: We use 48 synthetic tasks to provide construction experience for Agent S4 on ScienceBoard. They cover the benchmark’s six scientific applications, with 10 for Celestia, 7 for ChimeraX, 9 for GRASS GIS, 10 for KAlgebra, 7 for Lean and 5 for TeXstudio. Each task includes an instruction, an initial application state and, where needed, input materials. The tasks were authored and reviewed as described in Section 4 . Of the 50 authored tasks, we exclude sb_chimerax_006 and sb_grassgis_010 because their initialization fails before the task agent starts. The tasks have no evaluators, so attempts are recorded without success labels. Table 10 lists the tasks, and Section E.1 gives the full instructions as the task agent received them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 48 个合成任务，在 ScienceBoard 上为智能体 S4 提供构建经验。 这些任务涵盖了该基准测试的六个科学应用，其中 Celestia 有 10 个、ChimeraX 有 7 个、GRASS GIS 有 9 个、KAlgebra 有 10 个、Lean 有 7 个，以及 TeXstudio 有 5 个。 每个任务都包含一个指令、一个初始的应用状态，以及在需要时提供的输入材料。 这些任务的编写和评审均遵循第 4 节中所述的方法进行。 在编写的 50 个任务中，我们排除了 sb_chimerax_006 和 sb_grassgis_010，因为它们的初始化在任务智能体启动前就已失败。 这些任务没有评估者，因此尝试记录时不包含成功标签。 表 10 列出了所有任务，而第 E.1 节则提供了任务智能体所接收的完整指令。

sents.zh: 我们使用 48 个合成任务，在 ScienceBoard 上为智能体 S4 提供构建经验。

sents.en: They cover the benchmark’s six scientific applications, with 10 for Celestia, 7 for ChimeraX, 9 for GRASS GIS, 10 for KAlgebra, 7 for Lean and 5 for TeXstudio.
sents.zh: 这些任务涵盖了该基准测试的六个科学应用，其中 Celestia 有 10 个、ChimeraX 有 7 个、GRASS GIS 有 9 个、KAlgebra 有 10 个、Lean 有 7 个，以及 TeXstudio 有 5 个。

sents.en: Each task includes an instruction, an initial application state and, where needed, input materials.
sents.zh: 每个任务都包含一个指令、一个初始的应用状态，以及在需要时提供的输入材料。

sents.en: The tasks were authored and reviewed as described in Section 4 .
sents.zh: 这些任务的编写和评审均遵循第 4 节中所述的方法进行。

sents.en: Of the 50 authored tasks, we exclude sb_chimerax_006 and sb_grassgis_010 because their initialization fails before the task agent starts.
sents.zh: 在编写的 50 个任务中，我们排除了 sb_chimerax_006 和 sb_grassgis_010，因为它们的初始化在任务智能体启动前就已失败。

sents.en: The tasks have no evaluators, so attempts are recorded without success labels.
sents.zh: 这些任务没有评估者，因此尝试记录时不包含成功标签。

sents.en: Table 10 lists the tasks, and Section E.1 gives the full instructions as the task agent received them.
sents.zh: 表 10 列出了所有任务，而第 E.1 节则提供了任务智能体所接收的完整指令。

paragraphs.en: The runner appends the same execution reminder as for the OSWorld V2 synthetic tasks (Section D.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该运行器附加了与 OSWorld V2 合成任务（D.1 节）相同的执行提醒。

paragraphs.en: Use Celestia to prepare a two-panel illustration of how the Moon’s apparent phase depends on the observer’s position. Pause time and show the Moon in two side-by-side views at that same instant. In the left panel, make it clearly crescent: less than half of the disk illuminated. In the right panel, make it clearly gibbous: more than half illuminated, but not full. Change the viewpoints rather than advancing time. Keep the entire lunar disk inside each panel at approximately the same apparent diameter. Leave the comparison open and explain in one sentence why the illuminated fractions differ.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Celestia 制作一幅双图幅插图，展示月球的视相位如何取决于观测者的位置。 暂停时间，在同一时刻以并排的两个视角展示月球。 在左侧图幅中，使其明显呈新月状：被照亮的部分小于圆盘的一半。 在右侧图幅中，使其明显呈凸月状：被照亮的部分超过一半，但未满。 通过改变视角而非推进时间来呈现变化。 确保整个月球圆盘在每幅图幅中都保持大致相同的视直径。 保留对比状态，并用一句话解释为何被照亮的比例存在差异。

sents.zh: 使用 Celestia 制作一幅双图幅插图，展示月球的视相位如何取决于观测者的位置。

sents.zh: 暂停时间，在同一时刻以并排的两个视角展示月球。

sents.en: In the left panel, make it clearly crescent: less than half of the disk illuminated.
sents.zh: 在左侧图幅中，使其明显呈新月状：被照亮的部分小于圆盘的一半。

sents.en: In the right panel, make it clearly gibbous: more than half illuminated, but not full.
sents.zh: 在右侧图幅中，使其明显呈凸月状：被照亮的部分超过一半，但未满。

sents.en: Change the viewpoints rather than advancing time.
sents.zh: 通过改变视角而非推进时间来呈现变化。

sents.en: Keep the entire lunar disk inside each panel at approximately the same apparent diameter.
sents.zh: 确保整个月球圆盘在每幅图幅中都保持大致相同的视直径。

sents.en: Leave the comparison open and explain in one sentence why the illuminated fractions differ.
sents.zh: 保留对比状态，并用一句话解释为何被照亮的比例存在差异。

paragraphs.en: In Celestia, set up a running day/night view of Earth in which the Australian mainland stays in the middle of the disk as simulation time advances. Show the whole Earth disk, turn clouds off, and keep the day/night shading clearly visible. Leave time running forward at 1000 × \times . The coastline must stay in the same position on screen without further camera adjustments while its illumination changes.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Celestia 中，设置一个地球的昼夜运行视图，随着模拟时间的推进，澳大利亚大陆始终保持在视盘中央。 显示整个地球视盘，关闭云层，并确保昼夜明暗对比清晰可见。 让时间以 1000 × \times 的速度持续向前运行。 海岸线必须始终位于屏幕上的同一位置，无需进一步调整摄像头，同时其光照效果会发生变化。

sents.en: In Celestia, set up a running day/night view of Earth in which the Australian mainland stays in the middle of the disk as simulation time advances.
sents.zh: 在 Celestia 中，设置一个地球的昼夜运行视图，随着模拟时间的推进，澳大利亚大陆始终保持在视盘中央。

sents.en: Show the whole Earth disk, turn clouds off, and keep the day/night shading clearly visible.
sents.zh: 显示整个地球视盘，关闭云层，并确保昼夜明暗对比清晰可见。

sents.en: Leave time running forward at 1000 × \times .
sents.zh: 让时间以 1000 × \times 的速度持续向前运行。

sents.en: The coastline must stay in the same position on screen without further camera adjustments while its illumination changes.
sents.zh: 海岸线必须始终位于屏幕上的同一位置，无需进一步调整摄像头，同时其光照效果会发生变化。

paragraphs.en: Create a reusable observing point in Celestia for studying Saturn’s shadow on its rings. Set simulation time to 2021-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and pause it. Compose an oblique view with the whole planet and the outer edges of the rings inside the window, making the dark shadow cast by Saturn onto the rings clearly visible. Save this observer state as a native bookmark named ’Ring-shadow observing point’, with the saved simulation time. To check that it can reproduce the observation, go to Neptune and change simulation time to 2031-01-01 00:00:00 UTC, then use the bookmark to return. Leave the restored Saturn view visible and paused at the saved 2021 time, with the same framing and shadow geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Celestia 中创建一个可重用的观测点，用于研究土星投射在其环上的阴影。 将模拟时间设置为 2021-01-01 00:00:00 UTC，然后暂停模拟。 在窗口内组合一个斜角视图，使整个行星和环的外边缘都包含在内，从而清晰看到土星投射到环上的深色阴影。 将此观测者状态保存为名为「环影观测点」的原生书签，同时保存模拟时间。 为了验证该书签能否重现观测效果，请前往海王星并将模拟时间更改为 2031-01-01 00:00:00 UTC，然后使用此书签返回。 保持恢复后的土星视图可见且暂停在已保存的 2021 年时间点，同时保留相同的构图和阴影几何结构。

sents.en: Create a reusable observing point in Celestia for studying Saturn’s shadow on its rings.
sents.zh: 在 Celestia 中创建一个可重用的观测点，用于研究土星投射在其环上的阴影。

sents.en: Set simulation time to 2021-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and pause it.
sents.zh: 将模拟时间设置为 2021-01-01 00:00:00 UTC，然后暂停模拟。

sents.en: Save this observer state as a native bookmark named ’Ring-shadow observing point’, with the saved simulation time.
sents.zh: 将此观测者状态保存为名为「环影观测点」的原生书签，同时保存模拟时间。

sents.en: To check that it can reproduce the observation, go to Neptune and change simulation time to 2031-01-01 00:00:00 UTC, then use the bookmark to return.
sents.zh: 为了验证该书签能否重现观测效果，请前往海王星并将模拟时间更改为 2031-01-01 00:00:00 UTC，然后使用此书签返回。

sents.en: Leave the restored Saturn view visible and paused at the saved 2021 time, with the same framing and shadow geometry.
sents.zh: 保持恢复后的土星视图可见且暂停在已保存的 2021 年时间点，同时保留相同的构图和阴影几何结构。

paragraphs.en: Use Celestia to compare two ways of making Mars appear larger. Pause time and prepare one centered, mostly sunlit view of Mars with a field of view (FoV) of 45 degrees. Adjust the observer distance so the whole disk is about one quarter of the graphics viewport’s height; this is your baseline. First, keep the observer at that position and change only FoV until the disk is about half the viewport height. Next, restore FoV to 45 degrees and change only the distance to Mars to obtain a half-height disk again. After establishing the baseline, keep simulation time, viewing direction, and window dimensions fixed, with Mars centered throughout. Report the displayed FoV and Mars distance, including units, for the baseline and each of the two enlarged views. Use these readings to explain briefly how the two enlargement procedures differ. Leave the final 45-degree view open with the whole disk and the FoV and distance readouts visible.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Celestia 比较两种让火星看起来更大的方法。 暂停时间，准备一个以火星为中心、大部分被阳光照射的视图，其视场（FoV）为 45 度。 调整观测距离，使整个火星圆盘约占图形视口高度的四分之一；这将是你的基准设置。 首先，保持观测器在该位置不变，仅改变视场，直到火星圆盘约占视口高度的一半。 接下来，将视场恢复为 45 度，仅改变到火星的距离，再次获得一个占视口高度一半的圆盘。 确定基准设置后，保持模拟时间、观察方向和窗口尺寸固定，且在整个过程中让火星始终位于中心。 报告基准设置以及两种放大视图下所显示的视场和火星距离（包括单位）。 利用这些读数简要说明这两种放大方法有何不同。 保留最终的 45 度视图，确保整个火星圆盘以及视场和距离的读数清晰可见。

sents.en: Use Celestia to compare two ways of making Mars appear larger.
sents.zh: 使用 Celestia 比较两种让火星看起来更大的方法。

sents.en: Pause time and prepare one centered, mostly sunlit view of Mars with a field of view (FoV) of 45 degrees.
sents.zh: 暂停时间，准备一个以火星为中心、大部分被阳光照射的视图，其视场（FoV）为 45 度。

sents.en: Adjust the observer distance so the whole disk is about one quarter of the graphics viewport’s height; this is your baseline.
sents.zh: 调整观测距离，使整个火星圆盘约占图形视口高度的四分之一；这将是你的基准设置。

sents.en: First, keep the observer at that position and change only FoV until the disk is about half the viewport height.
sents.zh: 首先，保持观测器在该位置不变，仅改变视场，直到火星圆盘约占视口高度的一半。

sents.en: Next, restore FoV to 45 degrees and change only the distance to Mars to obtain a half-height disk again.
sents.zh: 接下来，将视场恢复为 45 度，仅改变到火星的距离，再次获得一个占视口高度一半的圆盘。

sents.en: After establishing the baseline, keep simulation time, viewing direction, and window dimensions fixed, with Mars centered throughout.
sents.zh: 确定基准设置后，保持模拟时间、观察方向和窗口尺寸固定，且在整个过程中让火星始终位于中心。

sents.en: Report the displayed FoV and Mars distance, including units, for the baseline and each of the two enlarged views.
sents.zh: 报告基准设置以及两种放大视图下所显示的视场和火星距离（包括单位）。

sents.en: Use these readings to explain briefly how the two enlargement procedures differ.
sents.zh: 利用这些读数简要说明这两种放大方法有何不同。

sents.en: Leave the final 45-degree view open with the whole disk and the FoV and distance readouts visible.
sents.zh: 保留最终的 45 度视图，确保整个火星圆盘以及视场和距离的读数清晰可见。

paragraphs.en: Use Celestia’s built-in object information to compare the rotational surface speeds at the equators of Mercury and Venus. Treat each planet as a sphere with Celestia’s displayed radius, and use its displayed sidereal rotation period. Compare speed magnitudes, ignoring the direction of rotation and any motion of clouds. Report the radius and rotation-period readings for both planets with their units, then calculate the dimensionless ratio v_Venus / v_Mercury to two significant figures. Show the relation you used and identify which planet has the faster equatorial surface despite the difference in their sizes. Base the comparison on Celestia’s displayed values. Leave the faster planet selected and in view, with its radius and rotation period visible in the object information.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Celestia 内置的对象信息，比较水星和金星赤道处的自转表面速度。 将每颗行星视为一个球体，其半径以 Celestia 显示的值为准，并使用其显示的恒星日自转周期。 比较速度大小，忽略自转方向和任何云的运动。 报告两颗行星的半径和自转周期读数及其单位，然后计算无量纲比值 v_金星 / v_水星，保留两位有效数字。 展示你所使用的关系式，并指出尽管两颗行星大小不同，哪一颗的赤道表面速度更快。 以 Celestia 显示的值为基础进行比较。 保持较快的那颗行星被选中且处于可见状态，其半径和自转周期应在对象信息中清晰可见。

sents.en: Use Celestia’s built-in object information to compare the rotational surface speeds at the equators of Mercury and Venus.
sents.zh: 使用 Celestia 内置的对象信息，比较水星和金星赤道处的自转表面速度。

sents.en: Treat each planet as a sphere with Celestia’s displayed radius, and use its displayed sidereal rotation period.
sents.zh: 将每颗行星视为一个球体，其半径以 Celestia 显示的值为准，并使用其显示的恒星日自转周期。

sents.en: Compare speed magnitudes, ignoring the direction of rotation and any motion of clouds.
sents.zh: 比较速度大小，忽略自转方向和任何云的运动。

sents.en: Report the radius and rotation-period readings for both planets with their units, then calculate the dimensionless ratio v_Venus / v_Mercury to two significant figures.
sents.zh: 报告两颗行星的半径和自转周期读数及其单位，然后计算无量纲比值 v_金星 / v_水星，保留两位有效数字。

sents.en: Show the relation you used and identify which planet has the faster equatorial surface despite the difference in their sizes.
sents.zh: 展示你所使用的关系式，并指出尽管两颗行星大小不同，哪一颗的赤道表面速度更快。

sents.en: Base the comparison on Celestia’s displayed values.
sents.zh: 以 Celestia 显示的值为基础进行比较。

sents.en: Leave the faster planet selected and in view, with its radius and rotation period visible in the object information.
sents.zh: 保持较快的那颗行星被选中且处于可见状态，其半径和自转周期应在对象信息中清晰可见。

paragraphs.en: Use Celestia to work out when light arriving near Earth just after midnight left Neptune. Set simulation time to 2025-01-01 00:10:00 UTC and pause it. Go to Earth and use that arrival viewpoint as the observing position. Select Neptune without travelling to it, and read Celestia’s light-travel delay from the observer to Neptune. Treat that displayed delay as constant for this exercise. Report the displayed delay with its units and the corresponding light-emission date and time in UTC, rounded to the nearest minute. Briefly explain the relation between the reception and emission times. Set the simulation clock to the emission time you reported and leave Celestia paused with Neptune selected and the UTC date/time readout visible.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Celestia 计算在午夜刚过、抵达地球附近的光线是何时离开海王星的。 将模拟时间设为 2025-01-01 00:10:00 UTC，然后暂停模拟。 前往地球，并使用该到达视角作为观测位置。 无需前往海王星，直接选择海王星，并读取 Celestia 中从观测者到海王星的光传播延迟时间。 在本次练习中，将该显示的延迟时间视为常数。 报告该显示的延迟时间及其单位，以及对应的以 UTC 表示的光发射日期和时间（四舍五入到最近的分钟）。 简要说明接收时间与发射时间之间的关系。 将模拟时钟设置为你报告的发射时间，并保持 Celestia 处于暂停状态，同时选中海王星且显示 UTC 日期/时间读数。

sents.en: Use Celestia to work out when light arriving near Earth just after midnight left Neptune.
sents.zh: 使用 Celestia 计算在午夜刚过、抵达地球附近的光线是何时离开海王星的。

sents.en: Set simulation time to 2025-01-01 00:10:00 UTC and pause it.
sents.zh: 将模拟时间设为 2025-01-01 00:10:00 UTC，然后暂停模拟。

sents.en: Go to Earth and use that arrival viewpoint as the observing position.
sents.zh: 前往地球，并使用该到达视角作为观测位置。

sents.en: Select Neptune without travelling to it, and read Celestia’s light-travel delay from the observer to Neptune.
sents.zh: 无需前往海王星，直接选择海王星，并读取 Celestia 中从观测者到海王星的光传播延迟时间。

sents.en: Treat that displayed delay as constant for this exercise.
sents.zh: 在本次练习中，将该显示的延迟时间视为常数。

sents.en: Report the displayed delay with its units and the corresponding light-emission date and time in UTC, rounded to the nearest minute.
sents.zh: 报告该显示的延迟时间及其单位，以及对应的以 UTC 表示的光发射日期和时间（四舍五入到最近的分钟）。

sents.en: Briefly explain the relation between the reception and emission times.
sents.zh: 简要说明接收时间与发射时间之间的关系。

sents.en: Set the simulation clock to the emission time you reported and leave Celestia paused with Neptune selected and the UTC date/time readout visible.
sents.zh: 将模拟时钟设置为你报告的发射时间，并保持 Celestia 处于暂停状态，同时选中海王星且显示 UTC 日期/时间读数。

paragraphs.en: Use Celestia to investigate whether the Summer Triangle keeps its apparent shape when the observer moves between stars. Its three members are Vega, Deneb, and Altair. Pause time and use Go To Sol to establish the first observing position. Record the displayed distances from there to all three triangle stars, including units. Prepare two equal-sized views at this same paused instant: one at the Sol arrival position and one at the arrival position after Go To Capella. Show all three triangle stars with readable names in both views, using the same field of view. Keep Vega centered in both panels, and orient the Deneb-to-Vega direction the same way on screen in both views. Framing changes must rotate the camera without moving either observing position. Keep constellation diagrams and boundaries off. Compare the triangle’s shape, allowing for an overall rotation or uniform enlargement: does its relative spacing stay the same? Support your answer with a specific comparison of one named star pair’s separation relative to another pair’s separation, then use the three distance readings to explain your observation. A qualitative spacing comparison is sufficient. Leave the two views visible and time paused.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Celestia 调查当观测者在恒星之间移动时，夏季大三角是否保持其表观形状。 它的三个成员星是织女星、牛郎星和天鹰座α星。 暂停时间，并使用“前往太阳”功能确定第一个观测位置。 记录从该位置到三角形三颗恒星的所有显示距离，包括单位。 在同一暂停时刻准备两个大小相等的视图：一个位于到达太阳的位置，另一个位于“前往天琴座α星”后的到达位置。 在两个视图中均以相同的视场显示三角形全部三颗恒星，并带有清晰可读的名称。 保持织女星在两个面板中均位于中心，并确保牛郎星到织女星的连线方向在两个视图中屏幕上的朝向一致。 构图变化必须通过旋转相机实现，而不能移动任一观测位置。 关闭星座图和边界线。 比较三角形的形状，考虑整体旋转或均匀放大的情况：其相对间距是否保持不变？ 用一对命名恒星间距与另一对恒星间距的具体比较来支持你的答案，然后利用三个距离读数解释你的观察结果。 定性的间距比较即可。 保持两个视图可见，时间处于暂停状态。

sents.en: Use Celestia to investigate whether the Summer Triangle keeps its apparent shape when the observer moves between stars.
sents.zh: 使用 Celestia 调查当观测者在恒星之间移动时，夏季大三角是否保持其表观形状。

sents.en: Its three members are Vega, Deneb, and Altair.
sents.zh: 它的三个成员星是织女星、牛郎星和天鹰座α星。

sents.en: Pause time and use Go To Sol to establish the first observing position.
sents.zh: 暂停时间，并使用“前往太阳”功能确定第一个观测位置。

sents.en: Record the displayed distances from there to all three triangle stars, including units.
sents.zh: 记录从该位置到三角形三颗恒星的所有显示距离，包括单位。

sents.en: Prepare two equal-sized views at this same paused instant: one at the Sol arrival position and one at the arrival position after Go To Capella.
sents.zh: 在同一暂停时刻准备两个大小相等的视图：一个位于到达太阳的位置，另一个位于“前往天琴座α星”后的到达位置。

sents.en: Show all three triangle stars with readable names in both views, using the same field of view.
sents.zh: 在两个视图中均以相同的视场显示三角形全部三颗恒星，并带有清晰可读的名称。

sents.en: Keep Vega centered in both panels, and orient the Deneb-to-Vega direction the same way on screen in both views.
sents.zh: 保持织女星在两个面板中均位于中心，并确保牛郎星到织女星的连线方向在两个视图中屏幕上的朝向一致。

sents.en: Framing changes must rotate the camera without moving either observing position.
sents.zh: 构图变化必须通过旋转相机实现，而不能移动任一观测位置。

sents.en: Keep constellation diagrams and boundaries off.
sents.zh: 关闭星座图和边界线。

sents.en: Compare the triangle’s shape, allowing for an overall rotation or uniform enlargement: does its relative spacing stay the same?
sents.zh: 比较三角形的形状，考虑整体旋转或均匀放大的情况：其相对间距是否保持不变？

sents.en: Support your answer with a specific comparison of one named star pair’s separation relative to another pair’s separation, then use the three distance readings to explain your observation.
sents.zh: 用一对命名恒星间距与另一对恒星间距的具体比较来支持你的答案，然后利用三个距离读数解释你的观察结果。

sents.en: A qualitative spacing comparison is sufficient.
sents.zh: 定性的间距比较即可。

sents.en: Leave the two views visible and time paused.
sents.zh: 保持两个视图可见，时间处于暂停状态。

paragraphs.en: Use Celestia to investigate whether a moon’s apparent motion around Mars can be mistaken for a retrograde orbit. Start at 2025-03-01 00:00:00 UTC with time paused. Prepare two equal side-by-side views looking down on Mars’s north pole, with Mars centered and the complete orbits of Phobos and Deimos in view. Use matching initial observer distances and fields of view. Show both moon names, both orbit paths, and Mars’s planetographic grid. In the left panel, make the observer travel with Mars while its camera axes remain fixed relative to distant stars. In the right panel, make the observer rotate with Mars so its longitude grid stays fixed on screen. Do not track either moon. Run the shared simulation time forward at 10000 × \times and watch at least 24 simulated hours without adjusting either camera. For each moon, report its clockwise or counterclockwise motion in each panel, and decide whether its actual orbit is prograde or retrograde relative to Mars’s spin. Explain the observations briefly in terms of the moons’ angular motion relative to the rotating planet. Add a visible object marker only to each moon whose apparent clockwise/counterclockwise sense changes between the two panels. Leave both views visible and running forward at 10000 × \times , with the moon names, orbit paths, and grid still shown.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Celestia 调查：一颗卫星围绕火星的表观运动是否可能被误认为是逆行轨道。 从 2025-03-01 00:00:00 UTC 开始，时间暂停。 准备两个并排的相同视角，俯瞰火星北极，火星位于中心，且火卫一和火卫二的完整轨道均可见。 使用相同的初始观测距离和视场。 显示两颗卫星的名称、两条轨道路径以及火星的行星地形网格。 在左侧面板中，让观测者随火星移动，同时其相机坐标轴相对于遥远恒星保持固定。 在右侧面板中，让观测者与火星一同旋转，使其经度网格在屏幕上保持固定。 不要追踪任何一颗卫星。 以 10000 × \times 的速度推进共享模拟时间，观察至少 24 个模拟小时，期间不调整任一相机。 对每颗卫星，报告其在每个面板中的顺时针或逆时针运动方向，并判断其实际轨道相对于火星自转是顺行还是逆行。 从卫星相对于旋转行星的角运动角度，简要解释这些观测结果。 仅对那颗表观顺时针/逆时针方向在两个面板间发生变化的卫星，添加一个可见物体标记。 保持两个视角同时可见并以 10000 × \times 的速度持续运行，同时保留卫星名称、轨道路径和网格的显示。

sents.en: Use Celestia to investigate whether a moon’s apparent motion around Mars can be mistaken for a retrograde orbit.
sents.zh: 使用 Celestia 调查：一颗卫星围绕火星的表观运动是否可能被误认为是逆行轨道。

sents.en: Start at 2025-03-01 00:00:00 UTC with time paused.
Prepare two equal side-by-side views looking down on Mars’s north pole, with Mars centered and the complete orbits of Phobos and Deimos in view.
sents.zh: 准备两个并排的相同视角，俯瞰火星北极，火星位于中心，且火卫一和火卫二的完整轨道均可见。

sents.en: Use matching initial observer distances and fields of view.
sents.zh: 使用相同的初始观测距离和视场。

sents.en: Show both moon names, both orbit paths, and Mars’s planetographic grid.
sents.zh: 显示两颗卫星的名称、两条轨道路径以及火星的行星地形网格。

sents.en: In the left panel, make the observer travel with Mars while its camera axes remain fixed relative to distant stars.
sents.zh: 在左侧面板中，让观测者随火星移动，同时其相机坐标轴相对于遥远恒星保持固定。

sents.en: In the right panel, make the observer rotate with Mars so its longitude grid stays fixed on screen.
sents.zh: 在右侧面板中，让观测者与火星一同旋转，使其经度网格在屏幕上保持固定。

sents.en: Do not track either moon.
sents.zh: 不要追踪任何一颗卫星。

sents.en: Run the shared simulation time forward at 10000 × \times and watch at least 24 simulated hours without adjusting either camera.
sents.zh: 以 10000 × \times 的速度推进共享模拟时间，观察至少 24 个模拟小时，期间不调整任一相机。

sents.en: For each moon, report its clockwise or counterclockwise motion in each panel, and decide whether its actual orbit is prograde or retrograde relative to Mars’s spin.
sents.zh: 对每颗卫星，报告其在每个面板中的顺时针或逆时针运动方向，并判断其实际轨道相对于火星自转是顺行还是逆行。

sents.en: Explain the observations briefly in terms of the moons’ angular motion relative to the rotating planet.
sents.zh: 从卫星相对于旋转行星的角运动角度，简要解释这些观测结果。

sents.en: Add a visible object marker only to each moon whose apparent clockwise/counterclockwise sense changes between the two panels.
sents.zh: 仅对那颗表观顺时针/逆时针方向在两个面板间发生变化的卫星，添加一个可见物体标记。

sents.en: Leave both views visible and running forward at 10000 × \times , with the moon names, orbit paths, and grid still shown.
sents.zh: 保持两个视角同时可见并以 10000 × \times 的速度持续运行，同时保留卫星名称、轨道路径和网格的显示。

paragraphs.en: Use Celestia to compare two idealized stellar populations whose members have the same absolute magnitude as Altair or Deneb, respectively. A hypothetical all-sky survey detects a star when its apparent magnitude is at most 6.0. Assume the two populations have equal, uniform number densities; ignore extinction and Galactic boundaries, and treat the catalog magnitudes as fixed. Pause time and use Go To Sol to establish the observing position. Keep that position throughout the task. In the Star Browser, obtain Altair’s and Deneb’s distance, apparent magnitude, and absolute magnitude; report all six readings with distance units. Identify which prototype appears brighter from this position. Using the absolute magnitudes, calculate each population’s maximum detection distance in parsecs and the expected detected-number ratio N_Deneb-like / N_Altair-like . Give distances and the ratio to two significant figures, using unrounded intermediate calculations, and state the relations you used. Briefly explain why the ordering by apparent brightness here need not match the ordering by expected survey detections. Leave the Star Browser visible in Brightest mode, sorted by absolute magnitude from brighter to fainter, with the prototype representing the more numerous detected population selected. Keep time paused and the observer at the Sol arrival position.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Celestia 比较两个理想化的恒星族群，这两个族群的成员分别具有与天鹰座 α 星或天琴座 β 星相同的绝对星等。 一个假想的全天巡天在恒星的视星等不超过 6.0 时探测到该恒星。 假设这两个族群具有相等且均匀的数量密度；忽略消光和银河系边界，并将星表中的星等视为固定值。 暂停时间，并使用“前往太阳”功能确定观测位置。 在整个任务过程中保持该位置不变。 在恒星浏览器中获取天鹰座 α 星和天琴座 β 星的距离、视星等和绝对星等；报告所有六个读数，并标注距离单位。 确定从该位置看，哪个原型星更亮。 利用绝对星等计算每个族群的最大探测距离（以秒差距为单位），以及预期探测数量之比 N_类天琴座β / N_类天鹰座α。 将距离和该比值保留两位有效数字，计算过程中使用未经四舍五入的中间值，并说明所用关系式。 简要解释为何此处的视亮度排序不一定与预期巡天探测数量排序一致。 保持恒星浏览器以“最亮”模式显示，按绝对星等从亮到暗排序，并选中代表探测数量较多的原型星。 保持时间暂停，并将观测者置于抵达太阳时的位置。

sents.en: Use Celestia to compare two idealized stellar populations whose members have the same absolute magnitude as Altair or Deneb, respectively.
sents.zh: 使用 Celestia 比较两个理想化的恒星族群，这两个族群的成员分别具有与天鹰座 α 星或天琴座 β 星相同的绝对星等。

sents.en: A hypothetical all-sky survey detects a star when its apparent magnitude is at most 6.0.
sents.zh: 一个假想的全天巡天在恒星的视星等不超过 6.0 时探测到该恒星。

sents.en: Assume the two populations have equal, uniform number densities; ignore extinction and Galactic boundaries, and treat the catalog magnitudes as fixed.
sents.zh: 假设这两个族群具有相等且均匀的数量密度；忽略消光和银河系边界，并将星表中的星等视为固定值。

sents.en: Pause time and use Go To Sol to establish the observing position.
sents.zh: 暂停时间，并使用“前往太阳”功能确定观测位置。

sents.en: Keep that position throughout the task.
sents.zh: 在整个任务过程中保持该位置不变。

sents.en: In the Star Browser, obtain Altair’s and Deneb’s distance, apparent magnitude, and absolute magnitude; report all six readings with distance units.
sents.zh: 在恒星浏览器中获取天鹰座 α 星和天琴座 β 星的距离、视星等和绝对星等；报告所有六个读数，并标注距离单位。

sents.en: Identify which prototype appears brighter from this position.
sents.zh: 确定从该位置看，哪个原型星更亮。

sents.en: Using the absolute magnitudes, calculate each population’s maximum detection distance in parsecs and the expected detected-number ratio N_Deneb-like / N_Altair-like .
sents.zh: 利用绝对星等计算每个族群的最大探测距离（以秒差距为单位），以及预期探测数量之比 N_类天琴座β / N_类天鹰座α。

sents.en: Give distances and the ratio to two significant figures, using unrounded intermediate calculations, and state the relations you used.
sents.zh: 将距离和该比值保留两位有效数字，计算过程中使用未经四舍五入的中间值，并说明所用关系式。

sents.en: Briefly explain why the ordering by apparent brightness here need not match the ordering by expected survey detections.
sents.zh: 简要解释为何此处的视亮度排序不一定与预期巡天探测数量排序一致。

sents.en: Leave the Star Browser visible in Brightest mode, sorted by absolute magnitude from brighter to fainter, with the prototype representing the more numerous detected population selected.
sents.zh: 保持恒星浏览器以“最亮”模式显示，按绝对星等从亮到暗排序，并选中代表探测数量较多的原型星。

sents.en: Keep time paused and the observer at the Sol arrival position.
sents.zh: 保持时间暂停，并将观测者置于抵达太阳时的位置。

paragraphs.en: Use Celestia to determine how far north an observer must be for Capella to become circumpolar: never below the ideal horizon during a daily circuit. Compare two observing sites on Earth’s surface, both at longitude 0 degrees, at latitudes 30 degrees N and 60 degrees N. At each site, inspect Capella throughout the simulated interval from 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC to 2025-01-02 00:00:00 UTC, keeping the observer fixed to that surface location. You may turn the camera in place. Show the horizontal coordinate grid and turn off atmospheres and clouds. Use the grid’s altitude-zero circle as the ideal horizon; ignore refraction and terrain. For each site, report whether Capella crosses below that horizon or stays above it throughout the circuit. At 60 degrees N, estimate its lowest altitude to the nearest 5 degrees. Use that estimate to infer, also to the nearest 5 degrees, the northern latitude where Capella’s daily circle would just graze the ideal horizon, and briefly explain the geometric relation used. Leave Celestia paused near Capella’s lowest altitude during the specified interval at the 60-degree-N site, with Capella selected and named, the northern horizon and horizontal grid readable, and the observer still fixed to Earth.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Celestia 确定观测者必须向北移动多远，才能使毕宿五成为周天极星：在每日视运动中，它绝不会低于理想地平线。 比较地球表面的两个观测点，两者经度均为 0 度，纬度分别为北纬 30 度和北纬 60 度。 在每个观测点，从 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 到 2025-01-02 00:00:00 UTC 的模拟时段内，持续观察毕宿五，并保持观测者固定在该地表位置。 你可以原地旋转摄像头。 显示水平坐标网格，并关闭大气和云层显示。 将网格中高度为零的圆圈作为理想地平线；忽略折射和地形影响。 对每个观测点，报告毕宿五在整个视运动过程中是否低于该地平线，或始终位于其上方。 在北纬 60 度处，估算其最低高度，精确到最近的 5 度。 使用该估算值，同样精确到最近的 5 度，推断出毕宿五的每日视运动圆恰好与理想地平线相切的北纬纬度，并简要说明所采用的几何关系。 在北纬 60 度的观测点处，将 Celestia 暂停在指定时段内毕宿五最低高度的附近位置，此时毕宿五已被选中并命名，北方地平线和水平网格清晰可见，且观测者仍固定于地球表面。

sents.en: Use Celestia to determine how far north an observer must be for Capella to become circumpolar: never below the ideal horizon during a daily circuit.
sents.zh: 使用 Celestia 确定观测者必须向北移动多远，才能使毕宿五成为周天极星：在每日视运动中，它绝不会低于理想地平线。

sents.en: Compare two observing sites on Earth’s surface, both at longitude 0 degrees, at latitudes 30 degrees N and 60 degrees N.
sents.zh: 比较地球表面的两个观测点，两者经度均为 0 度，纬度分别为北纬 30 度和北纬 60 度。

sents.en: At each site, inspect Capella throughout the simulated interval from 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC to 2025-01-02 00:00:00 UTC, keeping the observer fixed to that surface location.
sents.zh: 在每个观测点，从 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 到 2025-01-02 00:00:00 UTC 的模拟时段内，持续观察毕宿五，并保持观测者固定在该地表位置。

sents.en: You may turn the camera in place.
sents.zh: 你可以原地旋转摄像头。

sents.en: Show the horizontal coordinate grid and turn off atmospheres and clouds.
sents.zh: 显示水平坐标网格，并关闭大气和云层显示。

sents.en: Use the grid’s altitude-zero circle as the ideal horizon; ignore refraction and terrain.
sents.zh: 将网格中高度为零的圆圈作为理想地平线；忽略折射和地形影响。

sents.en: For each site, report whether Capella crosses below that horizon or stays above it throughout the circuit.
sents.zh: 对每个观测点，报告毕宿五在整个视运动过程中是否低于该地平线，或始终位于其上方。

sents.en: At 60 degrees N, estimate its lowest altitude to the nearest 5 degrees.
sents.zh: 在北纬 60 度处，估算其最低高度，精确到最近的 5 度。

sents.en: Use that estimate to infer, also to the nearest 5 degrees, the northern latitude where Capella’s daily circle would just graze the ideal horizon, and briefly explain the geometric relation used.
sents.zh: 使用该估算值，同样精确到最近的 5 度，推断出毕宿五的每日视运动圆恰好与理想地平线相切的北纬纬度，并简要说明所采用的几何关系。

sents.en: Leave Celestia paused near Capella’s lowest altitude during the specified interval at the 60-degree-N site, with Capella selected and named, the northern horizon and horizontal grid readable, and the observer still fixed to Earth.
sents.zh: 在北纬 60 度的观测点处，将 Celestia 暂停在指定时段内毕宿五最低高度的附近位置，此时毕宿五已被选中并命名，北方地平线和水平网格清晰可见，且观测者仍固定于地球表面。

paragraphs.en: The two open models, support_reference.pdb and support_moving.pdb , are synthetic C-alpha point scaffolds for a geometry exercise, not real proteins. In both, chain A residues 1-7 form a fixed support; chain B residues 1-5 form a lever whose tip is the CA atom of B:5. Superpose the moving model onto the reference using all seven corresponding chain-A CA atoms only. Apply one rigid transformation to the whole moving model, preserving its internal geometry. Then measure the distance between the two B:5 CA tips in this shared support frame. Report that displacement to the nearest 0.01 Å and briefly explain why the lever atoms were excluded from the fit. Leave both full scaffolds visible in distinct colors, with the two tip atoms shown as spheres and a readable distance monitor between them. Save the comparison as /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_001/hinge_comparison.cxs .
paragraphs.zh: 两个开放模型 support_reference.pdb 和 support_moving.pdb 是用于几何练习的合成 C-α 点支架，并非真实蛋白质。 在这两个模型中，链 A 的残基 1-7 构成一个固定支撑；链 B 的残基 1-5 构成一个杠杆，其末端为 B:5 的 CA 原子。 仅使用全部七个对应的链 A CA 原子，将移动模型叠加到参考模型上。 对整个移动模型应用一次刚性变换，同时保持其内部几何结构不变。 然后测量这两个 B:5 CA 末端在此共享支撑框架中的距离。 将该位移值精确到最近的 0.01 Å，并简要说明为何在拟合时排除了杠杆原子。 让两个完整的支架以不同颜色保持可见，同时显示两个末端原子为球体，并在它们之间添加可读的距离监测器。 将比较结果保存为 /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_001/hinge_comparison.cxs。

sents.zh: 两个开放模型 support_reference.pdb 和 support_moving.pdb 是用于几何练习的合成 C-α 点支架，并非真实蛋白质。

sents.en: Superpose the moving model onto the reference using all seven corresponding chain-A CA atoms only.
sents.zh: 仅使用全部七个对应的链 A CA 原子，将移动模型叠加到参考模型上。

sents.en: Apply one rigid transformation to the whole moving model, preserving its internal geometry.
sents.zh: 对整个移动模型应用一次刚性变换，同时保持其内部几何结构不变。

sents.en: Then measure the distance between the two B:5 CA tips in this shared support frame.
sents.zh: 然后测量这两个 B:5 CA 末端在此共享支撑框架中的距离。

sents.en: Report that displacement to the nearest 0.01 Å and briefly explain why the lever atoms were excluded from the fit.
sents.zh: 将该位移值精确到最近的 0.01 Å，并简要说明为何在拟合时排除了杠杆原子。

sents.en: Leave both full scaffolds visible in distinct colors, with the two tip atoms shown as spheres and a readable distance monitor between them.
sents.zh: 让两个完整的支架以不同颜色保持可见，同时显示两个末端原子为球体，并在它们之间添加可读的距离监测器。

sents.en: Save the comparison as /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_001/hinge_comparison.cxs .
sents.zh: 将比较结果保存为 /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_001/hinge_comparison.cxs。

paragraphs.en: The open alternate_site.pdb contains invented serine and water geometry for an alternate-location exercise, not an experimental structure. For serine A:7, compare alternate locations A and B of OG with the fixed water oxygen W:1@O. In ChimeraX, report each location’s occupancy and its OG-to-water-oxygen distance to the nearest 0.01 Å, then state whether the higher-occupancy location is also the closer one. Leave the closer OG location active in the original model with a readable distance monitor to the water oxygen. Preserve both stored alternate locations and the original coordinates.
paragraphs.zh: 开放的 alternate_site.pdb 文件包含为替代位置练习而设计的丝氨酸和水分子几何结构，而非实验性结构。 对于丝氨酸 A:7，请将 OG 的替代位置 A 和 B 与固定的水氧原子 W:1@O 进行比较。 在 ChimeraX 中，报告每个位置的占据率及其 OG 到水氧原子的距离（精确到最近的 0.01 Å），然后说明占据率较高的位置是否也是距离更近的位置。 在原模型中保留距离更近的 OG 位置，并添加一个可读的距离监测器以显示其到水氧原子的距离。 同时保留两个已存储的替代位置和原始坐标。

sents.zh: 开放的 alternate_site.pdb 文件包含为替代位置练习而设计的丝氨酸和水分子几何结构，而非实验性结构。

sents.zh: 对于丝氨酸 A:7，请将 OG 的替代位置 A 和 B 与固定的水氧原子 W:1@O 进行比较。

sents.en: Preserve both stored alternate locations and the original coordinates.
sents.zh: 同时保留两个已存储的替代位置和原始坐标。

paragraphs.en: The open array_a.pdb and array_b.pdb are invented point arrays for a data-screening exercise, not molecules or experimental structures. Each carbon marker represents one numbered site. Its PDB B-factor stores a synthetic residual magnitude in arbitrary units, and its occupancy stores a sampling-coverage fraction. In ChimeraX, prepare a comparison with all sites shown as spheres and colored by residual using the same continuous scale in both arrays: blue at 0, white at 6, and red at 12, with linear color interpolation between these values. Add a readable matching color key. Select exactly the sites across both arrays whose residual is at least 8 and whose coverage is at least 0.80; high residual alone does not qualify a poorly sampled site. Leave both complete arrays visible with this selection highlighted, preserving their coordinates and stored values.
paragraphs.zh: open 的 array_a.pdb 和 array_b.pdb 是为数据筛选练习而设计的虚拟点阵，并非分子或实验结构。 每个碳标记代表一个编号位点。 其 PDB B 因子以任意单位存储合成残差大小，而其占有率则存储采样覆盖比例。 在 ChimeraX 中，准备一个对比视图，将所有位点显示为球体，并根据残差进行着色；两个阵列使用相同的连续色标：0 时为蓝色，6 时为白色，12 时为红色，并在这些值之间进行线性颜色插值。 添加一个清晰易读的颜色匹配图例。 精确选择两个阵列中所有残差至少为 8 且覆盖度至少为 0.80 的位点；仅凭高残差不足以认定某个位点为采样不足的位点。 保留两个完整的阵列可见，同时突出显示所选位点，并保持其坐标和存储值不变。

sents.zh: 保留两个完整的阵列可见，同时突出显示所选位点，并保持其坐标和存储值不变。

paragraphs.en: The open edge_markers.pdb contains two invented rows of carbon markers, chains A and B, for a geometry exercise; these are not molecules or experimental observations. Each numbered residue is one site. In ChimeraX, find every cross-chain contact using a center-to-center distance of at most 3.50 Å as the sole criterion. Exclude pairs within the same chain and do not use van der Waals overlap as the cutoff. Show all markers as spheres, distinguish the chains by color, and display only the qualifying cross-chain contacts as dashed pseudobonds with readable distance labels. Select all participating sites and leave both complete rows visible without changing coordinates. Report the number of contact pairs and the number of distinct participating sites in each chain; a site with several partners counts only once in its chain’s site total.
paragraphs.zh: 打开 edge_markers.pdb 文件，其中包含两行虚构的碳标记物（链 A 和链 B），用于几何练习；这些并非分子或实验观测结果。 每个编号的残基代表一个位点。 在 ChimeraX 中，以中心间距不超过 3.50 Å 作为唯一标准，找出所有跨链接触。 排除同一链内的配对，且不要将范德华重叠作为截断标准。 将所有标记物显示为球体，用不同颜色区分各链，并仅将符合条件的跨链接触以带可读距离标签的虚线伪键形式显示。 选中所有参与反应的位点，并保持两行完整的标记物可见，同时不改变其坐标。 报告接触对的数量以及每条链中不同参与位点的数量；一个具有多个配体的位点在其所属链的位点总数中仅计一次。

paragraphs.en: In ChimeraX, open /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_005/gate_sweep.pdb as one trajectory with nine coordinate sets. This is invented point geometry, not a molecule, experimental structure, or physical dynamics simulation. The C atoms of chain A residue 1 and chain B residue 1 are the two moving tips; the other four markers are fixed reference points. Inspect the tip-to-tip separation across all nine sampled frames. Report the frame with the smallest sampled separation, its labelled time, and its separation to the nearest 0.01 Å. Also report every sampled frame with separation strictly below 4.50 Å. Frame 1 is labelled 0 ps and successive saved frames are 2 ps apart; do not infer an unsampled minimum or a continuous threshold-crossing time. Export all six markers from only the minimum-separation frame to /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_005/closest_snapshot.pdb . Leave the full trajectory loaded and paused at that frame, with all six markers visible, the frame slider visible, and a readable distance monitor between the two tips. Preserve all input coordinates.
paragraphs.zh: 在 ChimeraX 中，将 /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_005/gate_sweep.pdb 作为包含九个坐标集的单一轨迹打开。 这是虚构的点几何结构，而非分子、实验结构或物理动力学模拟。 A 链第 1 个残基和 B 链第 1 个残基的 C 原子是两个移动端点；其余四个标记为固定参考点。 检查所有九个采样帧中端点之间的间距。 报告采样间距最小的帧、其标注的时间，以及该帧的间距（精确到 0.01 Å）。 同时报告所有间距严格小于 4.50 Å 的采样帧。 第 1 帧标注为 0 ps，后续保存的帧间隔为 2 ps；不要推断未采样的最小值或连续跨越阈值的时间。 仅从间距最小的帧中导出全部六个标记，并保存至 /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_005/closest_snapshot.pdb。 保持整个轨迹加载并暂停在该帧上，确保六个标记全部可见、帧滑块可见，且两个端点之间显示可读的距离监测值。 保留所有输入坐标。

sents.zh: 保持整个轨迹加载并暂停在该帧上，确保六个标记全部可见、帧滑块可见，且两个端点之间显示可读的距离监测值。

paragraphs.en: The open panel_markers.pdb contains invented point geometry, not molecules or experimental observations. Chains A and B each contain nine carbon markers sampling a slightly nonplanar panel; P:1@C is a separate probe. In ChimeraX, create one native fitted plane for each panel using all nine of that chain’s markers with equal weight. Use orthogonal least-squares fitting, minimizing squared perpendicular distances, and exclude the probe from both fits. Report the smaller angle between the two fitted planes in degrees to one decimal place. Measure the unsigned perpendicular distance from P:1@C to each fitted plane, report both to the nearest 0.01 Å, and identify the nearer plane. Treat the planes as infinite for these measurements; the displayed disk rims are not panel boundaries. Leave both fitted plane disks and all 19 markers visible in a useful oblique view, with each panel and its plane sharing a distinct color and the probe visually distinct. Keep the Axes/Planes/Centroids tool open and preserve the input coordinates.
paragraphs.zh: open_panel_markers.pdb 文件包含虚构的点状几何结构，而非分子或实验观测数据。 A 链和 B 链各包含九个碳标记点，用于采样一个轻微非平面的面板；P:1@C 是一个独立的探针。 在 ChimeraX 中，为每个面板创建一个原生拟合平面，使用该链的全部九个标记点并以相等权重处理。 采用正交最小二乘拟合，最小化垂直距离的平方和，并将探针排除在两次拟合之外。 以度为单位，保留一位小数，报告两个拟合平面之间较小的夹角。 测量 P:1@C 到每个拟合平面的无符号垂直距离，将两者精确到最近的 0.01 Å，并确定较近的平面。 在这些测量中，将平面视为无限延伸；显示的圆盘边缘并非面板边界。 在实用的斜视图中保持两个拟合平面圆盘和全部 19 个标记点可见，每个面板及其平面使用不同颜色，探针也需视觉上清晰区分。 保持“轴/平面/质心”工具处于开启状态，并保留输入坐标。

sents.en: The open panel_markers.pdb contains invented point geometry, not molecules or experimental observations.
sents.zh: open_panel_markers.pdb 文件包含虚构的点状几何结构，而非分子或实验观测数据。

sents.en: Chains A and B each contain nine carbon markers sampling a slightly nonplanar panel; P:1@C is a separate probe.
sents.zh: A 链和 B 链各包含九个碳标记点，用于采样一个轻微非平面的面板；P:1@C 是一个独立的探针。

sents.en: In ChimeraX, create one native fitted plane for each panel using all nine of that chain’s markers with equal weight.
sents.zh: 在 ChimeraX 中，为每个面板创建一个原生拟合平面，使用该链的全部九个标记点并以相等权重处理。

sents.en: Use orthogonal least-squares fitting, minimizing squared perpendicular distances, and exclude the probe from both fits.
sents.zh: 采用正交最小二乘拟合，最小化垂直距离的平方和，并将探针排除在两次拟合之外。

sents.en: Report the smaller angle between the two fitted planes in degrees to one decimal place.
sents.zh: 以度为单位，保留一位小数，报告两个拟合平面之间较小的夹角。

sents.en: Measure the unsigned perpendicular distance from P:1@C to each fitted plane, report both to the nearest 0.01 Å, and identify the nearer plane.
sents.zh: 测量 P:1@C 到每个拟合平面的无符号垂直距离，将两者精确到最近的 0.01 Å，并确定较近的平面。

sents.en: Treat the planes as infinite for these measurements; the displayed disk rims are not panel boundaries.
sents.zh: 在这些测量中，将平面视为无限延伸；显示的圆盘边缘并非面板边界。

sents.en: Leave both fitted plane disks and all 19 markers visible in a useful oblique view, with each panel and its plane sharing a distinct color and the probe visually distinct.
sents.zh: 在实用的斜视图中保持两个拟合平面圆盘和全部 19 个标记点可见，每个面板及其平面使用不同颜色，探针也需视觉上清晰区分。

sents.en: Keep the Axes/Planes/Centroids tool open and preserve the input coordinates.
sents.zh: 保持“轴/平面/质心”工具处于开启状态，并保留输入坐标。

paragraphs.en: The open torsion_linker.pdb is an invented seven-carbon heavy-atom linkage for a geometry exercise, not an experimental or energy-minimized molecule. Its single residue A:1 contains the bonded chain C1-C2-C3-C4-C5-C6-C7. In ChimeraX, measure the starting C1-to-C7 distance, then set the ordered C2-C3-C4-C5 dihedral to +75.0 degrees by rotating about C3-C4. Keep C1, C2, and C3 at their original coordinates; rotate the entire C4-C7 side together about that bond axis, preserving all bond lengths, bond angles, and other internal torsions. Keep exactly the seven supplied atoms and the six supplied bonds. Report the starting and final C1-to-C7 distances to the nearest 0.01 Å and state whether this rotation lengthened or shortened the end-to-end separation. Save the edited linkage in its original model coordinate frame as /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_008/linker_75.pdb . Leave the edited linkage fully visible in ball-and-stick style with readable atom-name labels and a C1-to-C7 distance monitor. Keep Build Structure’s Adjust Torsions section open with C3-C4 active, C2 shown as Fixed, C5 shown as Moving, and the final signed angle displayed.
paragraphs.zh: 打开的 torsion_linker.pdb 是一个为几何练习而设计的七碳重原子连接结构，并非实验获得或经过能量最小化的分子。 其单个残基 A:1 包含相连的链 C1-C2-C3-C4-C5-C6-C7。 在 ChimeraX 中，测量初始的 C1 到 C7 距离，然后通过绕 C3-C4 旋转，将有序的 C2-C3-C4-C5 二面角设为 +75.0 度。 保持 C1、C2 和 C3 在原始坐标位置；将整个 C4-C7 侧链围绕该键轴一起旋转，同时保留所有键长、键角和其他内部扭转角。 仅保留所提供的七个原子和六个键。 报告初始和最终的 C1 到 C7 距离（精确到 0.01 Å），并说明此次旋转是使端对端距离变长还是变短。 将编辑后的连接结构保存至其原始模型坐标框架中，路径为 /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_008/linker_75.pdb。 保持编辑后的连接结构以球棍模型形式完全可见，并带有可读的原子名称标签以及 C1 到 C7 距离监测器。 保持“构建结构”中“调整扭转角”部分处于打开状态，其中 C3-C4 为活跃状态，C2 显示为固定，C5 显示为移动，并显示最终的带符号角度值。

sents.en: Keep exactly the seven supplied atoms and the six supplied bonds.
sents.zh: 仅保留所提供的七个原子和六个键。

sents.en: Report the starting and final C1-to-C7 distances to the nearest 0.01 Å and state whether this rotation lengthened or shortened the end-to-end separation.
sents.zh: 报告初始和最终的 C1 到 C7 距离（精确到 0.01 Å），并说明此次旋转是使端对端距离变长还是变短。

sents.en: Save the edited linkage in its original model coordinate frame as /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_008/linker_75.pdb .
sents.zh: 将编辑后的连接结构保存至其原始模型坐标框架中，路径为 /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_chimerax_008/linker_75.pdb。

sents.en: Keep Build Structure’s Adjust Torsions section open with C3-C4 active, C2 shown as Fixed, C5 shown as Moving, and the final signed angle displayed.

paragraphs.en: In this fictional meadow study, equipment can reach ground within 35 metres of the service_track centreline, but must stay inside meadow and outside wet_ground . Using the three existing vector maps, create accessible_meadow containing all qualifying ground, including any disconnected pieces. Use planar distances in the project CRS, with rounded buffer corners and end caps. Save the result in the current work mapset and display it with the meadow outline and service track. Report the total qualifying area in hectares, rounded to two decimal places. The project uses EPSG:32631 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N), with coordinates in metres; all geometry is invented toy data.
paragraphs.zh: 在此虚构的草地研究中，设备可在服务轨道中心线 35 米范围内的地面到达，但必须保持在草地内且位于湿地之外。 使用现有的三张矢量地图，创建一个包含所有符合条件的地面的可进入草地，包括任何不相连的部分。 在项目的坐标系中使用平面距离，缓冲区角和端盖需为圆角处理。 将结果保存至当前工作地图集，并与草地轮廓及服务轨道一同显示。 报告总合格面积（单位：公顷），保留两位小数。 该项目使用 EPSG:32631（WGS 84 / UTM 31N 带），坐标单位为米；所有几何数据均为虚构的示例数据。

sents.zh: 在项目的坐标系中使用平面距离，缓冲区角和端盖需为圆角处理。

paragraphs.en: The existing pad_height raster is an invented survey of a small test pad. Create a floating-point raster named neighbor_relief in the current work mapset: for each cell, subtract the arithmetic mean of its eight immediately surrounding cells (four edge neighbors and four diagonal neighbors) from that cell’s height. Exclude the center cell from the mean. Evaluate a cell only when its height and all eight neighboring heights are known; otherwise write NULL, including at the outer boundary. A valid zero contrast must remain zero. Keep the input’s full extent, alignment, and 2 m cell size. Heights are in metres above an arbitrary local datum, and the resulting signed contrast is in metres; positive contrast means locally raised ground. The horizontal CRS is EPSG:32631, with coordinates in metres. Save neighbor_relief as a native raster and leave it displayed in GRASS GIS.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 pad_height 栅格是对一个小型测试垫层进行的人工测量结果。 在当前工作地图集中创建一个名为 neighbor_relief 的浮点栅格：对于每个单元格，将其高度减去其八个直接相邻单元格（四个边缘相邻单元格和四个对角相邻单元格）的算术平均值。 计算平均值时不包含中心单元格。 仅当某个单元格的高度及其所有八个相邻单元格的高度均已知时，才对该单元格进行计算；否则写入 NULL，包括外部边界处。 有效的零对比度必须保持为零。 保留输入数据的完整范围、对齐方式和 2 米的单元格大小。 高度以米为单位，相对于一个任意的局部基准面；结果中的带符号对比度也以米为单位，正值表示局部地面抬高。 水平坐标系为 EPSG:32631，坐标单位为米。 将 neighbor_relief 保存为原生栅格，并保留其在 GRASS GIS 中的显示状态。

sents.en: The existing pad_height raster is an invented survey of a small test pad.
sents.zh: 现有的 pad_height 栅格是对一个小型测试垫层进行的人工测量结果。

sents.en: Create a floating-point raster named neighbor_relief in the current work mapset: for each cell, subtract the arithmetic mean of its eight immediately surrounding cells (four edge neighbors and four diagonal neighbors) from that cell’s height.

sents.zh: 计算平均值时不包含中心单元格。

sents.zh: 仅当某个单元格的高度及其所有八个相邻单元格的高度均已知时，才对该单元格进行计算；否则写入 NULL，包括外部边界处。

sents.zh: 保留输入数据的完整范围、对齐方式和 2 米的单元格大小。

sents.en: Heights are in metres above an arbitrary local datum, and the resulting signed contrast is in metres; positive contrast means locally raised ground.
sents.zh: 高度以米为单位，相对于一个任意的局部基准面；结果中的带符号对比度也以米为单位，正值表示局部地面抬高。

sents.en: The horizontal CRS is EPSG:32631, with coordinates in metres.
sents.zh: 水平坐标系为 EPSG:32631，坐标单位为米。

sents.en: Save neighbor_relief as a native raster and leave it displayed in GRASS GIS.
sents.zh: 将 neighbor_relief 保存为原生栅格，并保留其在 GRASS GIS 中的显示状态。

paragraphs.en: Import /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_grassgis_003/station_counts.csv into GRASS GIS as 2D station points, then create a native point vector named revisit_stations containing exactly the stations with qc = valid, a strictly positive baseline count, and a repeat count at least 20% lower than the baseline count. Include the 20% boundary. Both pulse counts cover equal 60-second intervals; zero is a recorded value. The CSV lists northing before easting: use easting_m for x and northing_m for y. Coordinates are metres in the current EPSG:32631 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N) project, and all data are invented. Preserve the selected stations’ original coordinates, station identifiers, counts, and quality flags in the output. Save revisit_stations in the current work mapset and leave it displayed with all its points in view.
paragraphs.zh: 将 /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_grassgis_003/station_counts.csv 导入 GRASS GIS，作为二维站点点，然后创建一个名为 revisit_stations 的原生点矢量，其中仅包含 qc = valid、基线计数严格为正且重复计数比基线计数低至少 20% 的站点。 包含 20% 的边界值。 两种脉冲计数均覆盖相等的 60 秒时间间隔；零是一个记录值。 CSV 文件中先列出北坐标，再列出东坐标：使用 easting_m 作为 x，northing_m 作为 y。 坐标以当前 EPSG:32631（WGS 84 / UTM 31N 带）投影的米为单位，且所有数据均为虚构。 在输出中保留所选站点的原始坐标、站点标识符、计数和质量标志。 将 revisit_stations 保存至当前工作地图集，并确保其所有点均显示在视图中。

paragraphs.en: The existing wetting_depth and surface_code rasters describe an invented sprinkler plot on matching 2 m grids. Create native rasters wetting_depth_6m and surface_code_6m on a common 6 m square-cell grid covering exactly the original footprint: west 500001, east 500025, south 5100007, north 5100025. Do not expand or shift the footprint. Each wetting_depth value is water depth in millimetres averaged over its source cell, not a per-cell volume. The coarser depth must represent the mean depth over each target cell and preserve the total represented water volume across the plot, without rounding depths to integers. Each surface_code value is a nominal class: 2 = sand, 5 = turf, 9 = paving. For each target cell, retain the code of the surface occupying the greatest area within it; do not blend the codes. There are no missing cells or tied dominant classes. Save both results in the current work mapset and leave surface_code_6m displayed with the entire plot in view. The project uses EPSG:32631 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N), with horizontal coordinates in metres; use planar cell areas.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 wetting_depth 和 surface_code 栅格描述了在匹配的 2 米网格上构建的一个虚拟喷灌区。 在覆盖原始区域边界的通用 6 米方形单元格网格上创建本地栅格 wetting_depth_6m 和 surface_code_6m，其边界为：西界 500001、东界 500025、南界 5100007、北界 5100025。 不要扩展或移动该区域边界。 每个 wetting_depth 值是以毫米为单位的水深，为对应源单元格的平均值，而非每个单元格的体积。 较粗分辨率的深度必须表示每个目标单元格内的平均深度，并保留整个区域所代表的总水量，同时不得将深度四舍五入为整数。 每个 surface_code 值代表一个名义类别：2 = 沙地，5 = 草坪，9 = 铺装面。 对于每个目标单元格，保留其中面积最大的地表所对应的代码；不要混合不同代码。 不存在缺失单元格或存在并列主导类别的情况。 将两个结果都保存到当前工作地图集中，并保持 surface_code_6m 显示为整个区域视图。 该项目使用 EPSG:32631（WGS 84 / UTM 31N 带），水平坐标单位为米；请使用平面单元格面积。

sents.en: The existing wetting_depth and surface_code rasters describe an invented sprinkler plot on matching 2 m grids.
sents.zh: 现有的 wetting_depth 和 surface_code 栅格描述了在匹配的 2 米网格上构建的一个虚拟喷灌区。

paragraphs.en: The existing training_height_cm raster is an invented earthwork surface, with elevations in centimetres above an arbitrary local datum. The horizontal CRS is EPSG:32631 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N), with coordinates and 2 m cell sizes in metres. Create two native floating-point rasters in the current work mapset using GRASS GIS’s Horn 3-by-3 terrain-derivative method: slope_percent , containing slope as percent rise, and downhill_azimuth , containing the direction of steepest descent in degrees clockwise from north. Account for the different vertical and horizontal units. Azimuths must lie in [0,360), with north = 0, east = 90, south = 180, and west = 270; use -9999 for exactly flat cells, whose slope must be zero. Preserve the input’s full extent, alignment, and 2 m resolution. Leave the outermost cell ring NULL in both outputs, without estimating edge derivatives. Save both rasters and leave slope_percent displayed with the entire plot in view.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 training_height_cm 栅格是一个虚构的地表模型，其高程值表示相对于某个任意局部基准面的厘米高度。 水平坐标系为 EPSG:32631（WGS 84 / UTM 31N 带），坐标单位为米，单元格大小为 2 米。 使用 GRASS GIS 的 Horn 3×3 地形导数方法，在当前工作地图集中创建两个原生浮点栅格：slope_percent（包含坡度百分比）和 downhill_azimuth（包含从正北方向顺时针旋转的最陡下坡方向角度）。 需考虑垂直单位和水平单位的不同。 方位角必须在 [0,360) 范围内，其中正北为 0，正东为 90，正南为 180，正西为 270；对于完全平坦的单元格（坡度必须为零），使用 -9999 表示。 保留输入数据的完整范围、对齐方式和 2 米分辨率。 两个输出栅格的最外层单元格环均设为 NULL，不估算边缘导数。 保存这两个栅格，并确保 slope_percent 显示时整个图幅都在视图中。

paragraphs.en: The existing cell_time and depot rasters describe an invented cart yard on matching 2 m square-cell grids. Create a native raster named reachable_20s marking every cell whose centre can be reached from the centre of the sole non-NULL depot cell with a minimum accumulated travel time of at most 20 seconds. Set qualifying cells to 1 and all other cells to NULL, including barriers and disconnected ground. The depot starts at elapsed time zero and must be included. Each cell_time value is the time in seconds to traverse one whole cell orthogonally, not seconds per metre. Use the standard eight-neighbor movement model: an edge-neighbor move costs the arithmetic mean of its two endpoint values, and a diagonal move costs that mean times sqrt(2). A move is allowed whenever both endpoint cells are non-NULL, including diagonals past barrier corners; do not use knight’s moves. NULL cell_time cells are impassable, and travel must remain within the input footprint. Minimize travel time rather than geometric distance, and apply the inclusive 20-second limit without rounding accumulated times. Preserve the input extent, alignment, and resolution. Save reachable_20s in the current work mapset and leave it displayed with the entire yard in view. The project uses EPSG:32631 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N), with horizontal coordinates in metres; all data are fictional.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 cell_time 和 depot 栅格描述了一个虚构的货场，其网格为匹配的 2 米方形单元格。 创建一个名为 reachable_20s 的原生栅格，标记所有中心点可以从唯一非 NULL 的 depot 单元格中心出发、累计行程时间最多为 20 秒的单元格。 将符合条件的单元格设为 1，其他所有单元格（包括障碍物和未连接的地面）设为 NULL。 depot 从经过时间零开始，且必须被包含在内。 每个 cell_time 值表示正交穿越一个完整单元格所需的时间（秒），而非每米的秒数。 使用标准的八邻域移动模型：边邻域移动的成本为两个端点值的算术平均值，对角线移动的成本为该平均值乘以 sqrt(2)。 只要两个端点单元格均为非 NULL，移动就是允许的（包括穿过障碍物角落的对角线移动）；不要使用马步移动。 cell_time 为 NULL 的单元格无法通过，且行程必须保持在输入范围内部。 应最小化行程时间而非几何距离，并应用包含性的 20 秒限制，对累计时间不进行四舍五入。 保留输入的扩展范围、对齐方式和分辨率。 将 reachable_20s 保存至当前工作地图集，并确保整个货场在视图中显示。 该项目使用 EPSG:32631（WGS 84 / UTM 31N 带），水平坐标单位为米；所有数据均为虚构。

paragraphs.en: The existing land_cover raster represents an invented refuge trial plot on a 2 m square-cell grid. Codes 3 (grass) and 7 (shrubs) both count as habitat; code 0 is bare ground, code 8 is paving, and NULL means unsurveyed. Create a native integer raster named refuge_patches containing only habitat patches with a planar area of at least 48 square metres, including exactly 48. Treat grass and shrubs as one habitat class when deciding connectivity: cells belong to the same patch if linked through habitat cells sharing an edge. Corner contact alone does not connect patches. Give every retained patch its own positive integer ID, with the same ID throughout that patch; the actual ID numbers are your choice. All other cells must be NULL. Count only habitat cells toward patch area, preserve holes and gaps, and remove small patches without expanding or merging them. Keep the input’s full extent, alignment, and 2 m resolution. Save refuge_patches in the current work mapset and leave it displayed with the entire plot in view. The project uses EPSG:32631 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N), with coordinates in metres. All data and the refuge criterion are fictional teaching material.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 land_cover 栅格表示一个在 2 米方形单元网格上构建的虚拟庇护所试验地块。 代码 3（草地）和 7（灌木）均被视为生境；代码 0 为裸露地面，代码 8 为铺装面，而 NULL 表示未调查区域。 创建一个名为 refuge_patches 的原生整数栅格，其中仅包含平面面积至少为 48 平方米的完整生境斑块。 在判断连通性时，将草地和灌木视为同一生境类：若两个单元通过共享边的生境单元相连，则属于同一斑块。 仅通过角点接触无法使斑块相互连通。 为每个保留的斑块分配一个唯一的正整数 ID，且该斑块内的所有单元均使用相同的 ID；具体 ID 编号由你自行决定。 所有其他单元必须设为 NULL。 仅将生境单元计入斑块面积，保留孔洞和间隙，并移除小型斑块，但不得扩展或合并它们。 保持输入数据的完整范围、对齐方式及 2 米分辨率。 将 refuge_patches 保存至当前工作地图集，并确保整个地块在视图中显示。 本项目使用 EPSG:32631（WGS 84 / UTM 31N 带），坐标单位为米。 所有数据和庇护所标准均为虚构的教学材料。

paragraphs.en: The existing before_height and after_height rasters describe an invented earthwork trial. Both give cell-average ground height in metres above the same arbitrary local datum on matching 2 m square-cell grids. Create a native floating-point raster named change_m containing after minus before, retaining a value only where both heights are known. Keep valid zero change as zero and all other cells NULL; preserve the input extent, alignment, and resolution. Then create a native area vector named block_budget with the same three polygons and category IDs as work_blocks . For each block, add numeric attributes surveyed_m2 (the area with both heights known), cut_m3 (positive volume removed where ground became lower), fill_m3 (positive volume added where ground became higher), and net_m3 (signed fill minus cut). Integrate height change over planar cell area, treating each cell average as constant across its cell. The block edges follow grid edges, so include whole cells only. Use the same jointly surveyed cells for all four attributes, including unchanged cells in surveyed_m2 ; do not fill survey gaps or extrapolate to unsurveyed parts of a block. Ignore soil bulking and compaction, and keep full calculation precision in the stored attributes. Save both results in the current work mapset and leave change_m displayed with block outlines and the block_budget attribute table open. The horizontal CRS is EPSG:32631 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N), with coordinates in metres. All data are fictional teaching material.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 before_height 和 after_height 栅格描述了一个虚构的土方工程试验。 两者均给出了以米为单位的单元格平均地面高度，相对于同一任意局部基准面，且位于匹配的 2 米方形单元格栅格上。 创建一个名为 change_m 的原生浮点栅格，其中包含 after 减去 before 的结果，并仅保留两个高度均已知区域的值。 将有效的零变化保留为零，所有其他单元格设为 NULL；同时保持输入的扩展范围、对齐方式和分辨率不变。 然后创建一个名为 block_budget 的原生面积矢量，其三个多边形和类别 ID 与 work_blocks 相同。 对于每个块，添加数值属性 surveyed_m2（两个高度均已知区域的面积）、cut_m3（地面变低时被移除的正体积）、fill_m3（地面变高时增加的正体积）以及 net_m3（有符号的 fill 减去 cut）。 在平面单元格面积上对高度变化进行积分，将每个单元格的平均值视为在整个单元格内恒定。 块的边界沿栅格边缘延伸，因此仅包含完整的单元格。 对所有四个属性均使用相同联合测量的单元格，包括将未变化的单元格计入 surveyed_m2；不要填补测量空白或外推至块内未测量的部分。 忽略土壤的膨胀和压实效应，并在存储的属性中保持完整的计算精度。 将两个结果都保存到目前的工作地图集中，并保持 change_m 与块轮廓以及 block_budget 属性表处于显示和打开状态。 水平坐标系为 EPSG:32631（WGS 84 / UTM 31N 带），坐标单位为米。 所有数据均为虚构的教学材料。

sents.en: Create a native floating-point raster named change_m containing after minus before, retaining a value only where both heights are known.

sents.en: Then create a native area vector named block_budget with the same three polygons and category IDs as work_blocks .
sents.zh: 然后创建一个名为 block_budget 的原生面积矢量，其三个多边形和类别 ID 与 work_blocks 相同。

sents.en: For each block, add numeric attributes surveyed_m2 (the area with both heights known), cut_m3 (positive volume removed where ground became lower), fill_m3 (positive volume added where ground became higher), and net_m3 (signed fill minus cut).
sents.zh: 对于每个块，添加数值属性 surveyed_m2（两个高度均已知区域的面积）、cut_m3（地面变低时被移除的正体积）、fill_m3（地面变高时增加的正体积）以及 net_m3（有符号的 fill 减去 cut）。
