sents.en: Use the same jointly surveyed cells for all four attributes, including unchanged cells in surveyed_m2 ; do not fill survey gaps or extrapolate to unsurveyed parts of a block.

sents.zh: 忽略土壤的膨胀和压实效应，并在存储的属性中保持完整的计算精度。

paragraphs.en: The existing terrain_m raster and observation_posts vector describe a fictional visibility trial. Create a native integer raster named sightline_coverage classifying every terrain cell: 0 = visible from neither post, 1 = from A only, 2 = from B only, and 3 = from both. Use each post’s eye_m attribute as its eye height above local ground, and test a target 0.75 m above local ground at every terrain cell centre. Use GRASS GIS’s native r.viewshed terrain model, looking in all directions with no distance limit; ignore Earth curvature and atmospheric refraction. Terrain is the only obstruction. Keep the DEM’s complete extent, alignment, and 4 m resolution; all terrain heights are known, so keep class 0 as zero rather than NULL. Report the percentage of the full plot’s planar area visible from both posts, to one decimal place. Save sightline_coverage in the current work mapset and leave it displayed with the observation posts overlaid and the coverage classes distinguishable. The horizontal CRS is EPSG:32631 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N), with coordinates in metres; terrain heights are metres above an arbitrary local datum. All inputs are invented teaching data.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 terrain_m 栅格和 observation_posts 矢量描述了虚构的可见性试验。 创建一个名为 sightline_coverage 的原生整数栅格，对每个地形单元进行分类：0 = 从两个观测点均不可见，1 = 仅从 A 点可见，2 = 仅从 B 点可见，3 = 从两个点均可见。 使用每个观测点的 eye_m 属性作为其相对于局部地面的眼高，并在每个地形单元中心测试一个高于局部地面 0.75 米的目标。 使用 GRASS GIS 的原生 r.viewshed 地形模型，在所有方向上无距离限制地进行观察；忽略地球曲率和大气折射。 地形是唯一障碍物。 保留 DEM 的完整范围、对齐方式和 4 米分辨率；所有地形高度均为已知值，因此将类别 0 设为零而非 NULL。 报告整个地块平面面积中从两个观测点均可见的部分所占的百分比，保留一位小数。 将 sightline_coverage 保存至当前工作地图集，并保持其显示状态，叠加显示观测点，且覆盖类别清晰可辨。 水平坐标系为 EPSG:32631（WGS 84 / UTM 31N 带），坐标单位为米；地形高度为相对于任意局部基准面的米数。 所有输入均为虚构的教学数据。

paragraphs.en: An idealized open-top channel has a rectangular internal cross-section with area 3.6 cm 2 . Its width w and wall height h are both positive. For each unit length of channel, coating the bottom costs three times as much per unit area as coating either side wall. Ignore wall thickness and end walls. Use KAlgebra to express the coating cost as a function of width alone, normalized by the side-wall coating price per unit area and by channel length. Find the width and wall height that minimize this cost, and report both to the nearest 0.01 cm with a brief explanation of why your choice is a minimum. Keep the numerical dimension calculations in the calculator history. Leave the 2D Graph tab visible with the cost curve and its positive-width minimum clearly in view.
paragraphs.zh: 一个理想化的开口顶通道具有矩形内部横截面，其面积为 3.6 cm²。 其宽度 w 和壁高 h 均为正值。 对于每单位长度的通道，涂覆底部每单位面积的成本是涂覆任意一侧壁成本的三倍。 忽略壁厚和端壁。 使用 KAlgebra 将涂覆成本表示为仅与宽度相关的函数，并以单位面积侧壁涂覆价格和通道长度进行归一化。 找出能使该成本最小化的宽度和壁高，并将两者精确到最近的 0.01 cm，同时简要说明为何该选择对应最小值。 将数值维度的计算过程保留在计算器历史记录中。 保持 2D 图表标签页可见，确保成本曲线及其正宽度处的最小值清晰可见。

paragraphs.en: Use KAlgebra to plot two command profiles for a toy actuator model. The horizontal coordinate x is time in seconds and the vertical coordinate is command level in arbitrary units. The first profile is zero through x = 1, rises linearly to level 4 at x = 3, stays at level 4 through x = 5, falls linearly to zero at x = 8, and stays zero thereafter. The second profile has exactly the same shape, delayed by 1.5 seconds and with every command level multiplied by 0.7. Represent each complete profile as one piecewise function, including its zero portions. Leave the 2D Graph tab visible with both profiles enabled in different colors and the viewport set to x from -1 to 11 and y from -0.5 to 4.5.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 KAlgebra 为一个简化执行器模型绘制两个指令轮廓图。 横坐标 x 表示时间（单位：秒），纵坐标表示指令水平（单位：任意单位）。 第一个轮廓在 x = 0 到 x = 1 时为零，在 x = 3 处线性上升至水平 4，在 x = 0 到 x = 5 期间保持水平 4，在 x = 8 处线性下降至零，之后保持为零。 第二个轮廓的形状完全相同，但延迟了 1.5 秒，且每个指令水平都乘以 0.7。 将每个完整的轮廓表示为一个分段函数，包括其为零的部分。 保持 2D 图形标签页可见，同时启用两种不同颜色的轮廓图，并将视口设置为 x 从 -1 到 11，y 从 -0.5 到 4.5。

paragraphs.en: Use KAlgebra to model an idealized corrugated sheet as a height surface z = f(x,y), with x, y and z measured in centimetres. The corrugation is sinusoidal about z = 0, with amplitude 0.6 cm. Its straight, parallel crest lines run in the direction (3,4) in the xy plane, and the perpendicular distance between neighboring crest lines is 4 cm. The sheet passes through the origin, and its height initially increases when moving from the origin along positive x. Construct and plot the height function in 3D. Leave the 3D Graph tab visible in Lines style at an oblique angle that clearly shows the parallel crests and troughs and their height variation. State the height function you used.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 KAlgebra 将理想化的波纹板建模为高度函数 z = f(x,y)，其中 x、y 和 z 的单位均为厘米。 波纹围绕 z = 0 呈正弦分布，振幅为 0.6 厘米。 其笔直且平行的波峰线在 xy 平面内沿方向 (3,4) 延伸，相邻波峰线之间的垂直距离为 4 厘米。 该波纹板经过原点，并且从原点沿正 x 方向移动时，其高度最初会升高。 构建并绘制该高度函数的三维图像。 保持 3D 图表标签页可见，使用线条样式，并以倾斜角度显示，以便清晰呈现平行的波峰与波谷及其高度变化。 说明你所使用的高度函数。

paragraphs.en: A toy instrument uses the calibration r = ((x-1)*(x-5))^(1/2), where x is restricted to the interval [0,6] and the exponent denotes the nonnegative real square root. Use KAlgebra to find every admissible input x that produces the reading r = 2. Report the inputs to three decimal places, identify exactly which parts of [0,6] yield a real calibration output, and state whether this reading determines x uniquely. Keep numerical substitution checks for every returned input, using unrounded values, in the Calculator history. Leave the 2D Graph tab visible with the calibration curve plotted in a viewport of x from 0 to 6 and y from 0 to 3, so the real-domain branches can be inspected. Both x and r are dimensionless.
paragraphs.zh: 一种玩具乐器使用校准公式 r = ((x-1)*(x-5))^(1/2)，其中 x 被限制在区间 [0,6] 内，指数表示非负实数平方根。 使用 KAlgebra 找出所有能产生读数 r = 2 的容许输入值 x。 将输入值精确到小数点后三位报告，明确说明 [0,6] 中哪些部分能产生实数校准输出，并说明该读数是否能唯一确定 x。 对每个返回的输入值，在计算器历史记录中保留使用未舍入数值进行的数值代入验证。 保持 2D 图形标签页可见，并在视图中绘制校准曲线，x 范围从 0 到 6，y 范围从 0 到 3，以便检查实数域分支。 x 和 r 均为无量纲量。

sents.zh: x 和 r 均为无量纲量。

paragraphs.en: An invented motion-tracking sample has instantaneous velocity v = (4, -1, 3) mm/s in fixed orthogonal x, y, z axes. Its intended travel line has direction d = (2, 3, 1); d is dimensionless and is not a unit vector. Use KAlgebra to decompose v into a velocity vector parallel to this line and a perpendicular drift velocity vector whose sum is v. Report both vectors in x, y, z order and the magnitude of the drift velocity, all to three decimal places in mm/s. Keep the calculations in the Calculator history, including checks with unrounded values that the two vectors reconstruct v and that the drift vector has zero scalar product with d. Vector notation or component-by-component arithmetic is acceptable. Leave the Calculator tab visible with the decomposition and checks available in its history.
paragraphs.zh: 一个虚构的运动跟踪样本在固定的正交 x、y、z 轴上具有瞬时速度 v = (4, -1, 3) mm/s。 其预定运动轨迹的方向为 d = (2, 3, 1)；d 是无量纲的，且不是单位向量。 使用 KAlgebra 将 v 分解为一个平行于该直线的速度向量和一个垂直的漂移速度向量，二者之和为 v。 以 x、y、z 顺序报告这两个向量以及漂移速度的大小，所有数值均保留三位小数，单位为 mm/s。 将计算过程保留在计算器历史记录中，包括使用未舍入值进行的验证：两个向量应能重构出 v，且漂移向量与 d 的标量积为零。 使用向量表示法或逐分量计算均可接受。 保持计算器标签页可见，以便查看分解结果和历史记录中的验证过程。

sents.zh: 保持计算器标签页可见，以便查看分解结果和历史记录中的验证过程。

paragraphs.en: In an invented mixing experiment, a well-mixed vessel initially holds 12 L of water containing 18 mg of a conserved tracer. Each cycle drains 3 L, refills with tracer-free water to 12 L, and then adds 1.2 mg of tracer in negligible volume, mixing fully before the next cycle. No other tracer loss occurs. Use KAlgebra to find the smallest whole number of completed cycles after which the tracer concentration is strictly below 0.55 mg/L. Cycle 0 means the initial vessel; evaluate concentration only after complete cycles, including the added dose. State the recurrence or equivalent expression you used, and report the cycle number and the concentrations after that cycle and the immediately preceding cycle. Give concentrations to three decimal places, but use unrounded values to decide the strict inequality. Keep the calculations and both threshold comparisons in the Calculator history, and leave the Calculator tab visible.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个虚构的混合实验中，一个充分混合的容器最初装有 12 L 水，其中含有 18 mg 的一种守恒示踪剂。 每个循环都会排出 3 L 液体，用不含示踪剂的水重新填充至 12 L，然后加入体积可忽略不计的 1.2 mg 示踪剂，并在下一个循环开始前充分混合。 没有其他示踪剂的损失发生。 使用 KAlgebra 求出完成的最少整数个循环数，使得此后示踪剂浓度严格低于 0.55 mg/L。 第 0 个循环表示初始状态；仅在完整循环结束后评估浓度，包括所添加的剂量。 说明你使用的递推关系或等效表达式，并报告该循环的编号、该循环结束时的浓度以及前一个循环结束时的浓度。 浓度保留三位小数，但判断严格不等式时请使用未经四舍五入的值。 将计算过程和两次阈值比较都保留在计算器历史记录中，并保持计算器标签页可见。

paragraphs.en: An invented bead stream has four possible speeds: 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, and 2.0 m/s. Their incoming population proportions are given by the relative weights 7, 9, 5, and 3, respectively. Every bead has mass 4.0 g. A detector records an incoming bead with probability 0.10, 0.35, 0.80, or 0.95, respectively, conditional on its speed; recording does not change the bead’s speed. Treat all supplied values as exact for this toy model. Use KAlgebra to calculate the expected translational kinetic energy of a randomly selected recorded bead. Use K = m*v^2/2 with consistent units. Report the expected energy in millijoules to three significant figures and briefly explain how you weighted the four speed classes after recording. Keep the weighting and energy calculations in the Calculator history, and leave the Calculator tab visible.
paragraphs.zh: 一个虚构的珠流有四种可能的速度：0.5、1.0、1.5 和 2.0 m/s。 它们的入射种群比例分别由相对权重 7、9、5 和 3 给出。 每颗珠子的质量为 4.0 g。 探测器记录一颗入射珠子的概率分别为 0.10、0.35、0.80 或 0.95，具体取决于其速度；记录过程不会改变珠子的速度。 在此简化模型中，将所有提供的数值视为精确值。 使用 KAlgebra 计算随机选中的一颗被记录珠子的预期平动动能。 使用公式 K = m*v^2/2，并确保单位一致。 以三位有效数字报告预期能量，并简要说明在记录后如何对四种速度类别进行加权。 将权值分配和能量计算保留在计算器历史记录中，并保持计算器标签页可见。

paragraphs.en: In a toy two-dimensional optical geometry, a reflector cross-section consists of all points whose Euclidean distance from the focus F = (-2, 1) cm equals their perpendicular distance from the vertical directrix x = 4 cm. Use KAlgebra to construct this locus as one native 2D graph giving x as a function of y, with x horizontal and y vertical. Include both the upper and lower parts of the reflector. Overlay the directrix as a second graph in a different color. Report the vertex coordinates and the vertex-to-focus distance in centimetres, and briefly explain how the equal-distance condition determines which way the reflector opens. Leave the 2D Graph tab visible with the viewport set to x from -8 to 5 and y from -9 to 11.

paragraphs.en: Use KAlgebra to calibrate an invented colorimeter from five teaching measurements. The standard concentrations c are 0, 2, 4, 6, and 8 mmol/L; their corresponding dimensionless absorbances A are 0.035, 0.210, 0.401, 0.562, and 0.758. Treat the standard concentrations as exact. Fit the affine model A = a + b*c by ordinary least squares, minimizing the sum of squared absorbance residuals with equal weight for all five standards. Fit the intercept a as well as the slope b. Then use this fitted model to estimate the concentration of an unknown sample whose absorbance is 0.487. Report the fitted intercept and slope to four decimal places, with units where applicable, and the unknown concentration to three significant figures in mmol/L. Use unrounded fitted coefficients for the concentration calculation. Keep the fitting and concentration calculations in the Calculator history, and leave the Calculator tab visible.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 KAlgebra 根据五个教学测量值对一种自制的比色计进行校准。 标准浓度 c 分别为 0、2、4、6 和 8 mmol/L；其对应的无量纲吸光度 A 分别为 0.035、0.210、0.401、0.562 和 0.758。 将标准浓度视为精确值。 通过普通最小二乘法拟合线性模型 A = a + b*c，使五个标准样本的吸光度残差平方和最小化，且所有样本的权重相等。 同时拟合截距 a 和斜率 b。 然后使用此拟合模型估算一个未知样品的浓度，其吸光度为 0.487。 将拟合得到的截距和斜率保留至小数点后四位（如有单位需一并注明），并将未知浓度以 mmol/L 为单位、保留三位有效数字报告。 浓度计算时请使用未经四舍五入的拟合系数。 将拟合和浓度计算过程保留在计算器历史记录中，并保持计算器标签页可见。

paragraphs.en: Use KAlgebra to investigate a toy square-wave reconstruction. The ideal voltage has period T = 2.4 s: it is +1.5 V for 0 < < t < < T/2 and -1.5 V for T/2 < < t < < T, repeated periodically. An N-term reconstruction adds the first N odd sine harmonics. For k = 1,…,N, harmonic k has frequency (2*k-1)/T Hz, amplitude 4*1.5/(pi*(2*k-1)) V, and zero phase. Construct the reconstructions for N = 4 and N = 12. For each reconstruction, calculate the signed percentage error relative to +1.5 V at two locations: the fixed interior time t = T/4, and the near-transition time t = T/(4*N), using that reconstruction’s own N. Define this error as 100*(reconstructed voltage - 1.5)/1.5. Report all four signed errors to one decimal place, identifying the reconstruction and sampling location, and briefly compare how the interior and near-transition errors change when more harmonics are included. Use unrounded intermediate values and keep the reconstruction evaluations and error calculations in the Calculator history. Leave the 2D Graph tab visible with both reconstructions and the +1.5 V reference line enabled in three distinct colors. Use the horizontal coordinate x for time in seconds and set the viewport to x from 0 to 1.2 and y from -0.2 to 2.0 V.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 KAlgebra 研究一个简化版的方波重构。 理想电压的周期为 T = 2.4 秒：在 0 < t < T/2 期间为 +1.5 V，在 T/2 < t < T 期间为 -1.5 V，并周期性重复。 N 项重构会叠加前 N 个奇数阶正弦谐波。 对于 k = 1,…,N，第 k 次谐波的频率为 (2*k-1)/T Hz，振幅为 4*1.5/(pi*(2*k-1)) V，相位为零。 构建 N = 4 和 N = 12 时的重构波形。 对每次重构，在两个位置计算相对于 +1.5 V 的带符号百分比误差：固定的内部时刻 t = T/4，以及接近跳变点的时刻 t = T/(4*N)，并使用该重构自身的 N 值进行计算。 将此误差定义为 100*(重构电压 - 1.5)/1.5。 报告所有四个带符号误差，保留一位小数，并说明对应的重构和采样位置；简要比较当增加更多谐波时，内部时刻与跳变点附近的误差变化。 使用未经四舍五入的中间值，并将重构计算结果和误差计算过程保留在计算器历史记录中。 保持 2D 图形标签页可见，同时显示两种重构波形和 +1.5 V 参考线，并使用三种不同颜色区分。 使用水平坐标 x 表示时间（单位：秒），并将视图范围设置为 x 从 0 到 1.2，y 从 -0.2 到 2.0 V。

paragraphs.zh: 在 /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_texstudio_002/torsion_note.tex 中，使用 ChimeraX 中已从 four_carbon.pdb 打开的原始玩具四碳链，完成单幅插图及其图注。 该模型是省略了氢原子的教学几何模型，而非实验结构。 在 ChimeraX 中，按 C1-C2-C3-C4 的原子顺序测量带符号的 C1-C2-C3-C4 扭转角，且不得更改坐标。 准备一个球棍模型视图，要求所有四个原子名称清晰可读，且三条键均可见；选择一个斜视角度，使链的三维排列清晰呈现。 将图形视图导出为 chain_view.png，保存至同一文件夹，并用该图像替换 TeX 中的插图占位符，同时保持其宽高比。 用简洁的描述替换待填写的图注，说明该玩具模型的特征，报告测量得到的带符号扭转角（精确到度），并指出其最接近的理想参考构象：重叠式（0 度）、 gauche 式（+60 或 -60 度）或对位式（180 度，等价于 -180 度）。 循环比较各角度。 保存 torsion_note.tex，并在 TeXstudio 中生成 torsion_note.pdf，确保无编译错误。 将说明控制在单页内，并确保 PDF 显示时图像和图注清晰可读。

sents.zh: 在 /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_texstudio_002/torsion_note.tex 中，使用 ChimeraX 中已从 four_carbon.pdb 打开的原始玩具四碳链，完成单幅插图及其图注。

sents.en: The model is educational geometry with hydrogens omitted, not an experimental structure.
sents.zh: 该模型是省略了氢原子的教学几何模型，而非实验结构。

sents.en: In ChimeraX, measure the signed C1-C2-C3-C4 torsion in that atom order without changing the coordinates.
sents.zh: 在 ChimeraX 中，按 C1-C2-C3-C4 的原子顺序测量带符号的 C1-C2-C3-C4 扭转角，且不得更改坐标。

sents.en: Prepare one ball-and-stick view with all four atom names readable and all three bonds visible; choose an oblique view that makes the chain’s three-dimensional arrangement clear.
sents.zh: 准备一个球棍模型视图，要求所有四个原子名称清晰可读，且三条键均可见；选择一个斜视角度，使链的三维排列清晰呈现。

sents.en: Export the graphics view as chain_view.png in the same folder and replace the TeX figure placeholder with that image, preserving its aspect ratio.
sents.zh: 将图形视图导出为 chain_view.png，保存至同一文件夹，并用该图像替换 TeX 中的插图占位符，同时保持其宽高比。

sents.en: Replace the pending caption with a concise description that identifies the toy model, reports the measured signed torsion to the nearest degree, and says which ideal reference it is closest to: eclipsed (0 degrees), gauche (+60 or -60 degrees), or anti (180 degrees, equivalent to -180 degrees).
sents.zh: 用简洁的描述替换待填写的图注，说明该玩具模型的特征，报告测量得到的带符号扭转角（精确到度），并指出其最接近的理想参考构象：重叠式（0 度）、 gauche 式（+60 或 -60 度）或对位式（180 度，等价于 -180 度）。

sents.en: Compare angles cyclically.
sents.zh: 循环比较各角度。

sents.en: Save torsion_note.tex and build torsion_note.pdf in TeXstudio without compilation errors.
sents.zh: 保存 torsion_note.tex，并在 TeXstudio 中生成 torsion_note.pdf，确保无编译错误。

sents.en: Keep the note to one page and leave the PDF visible with the image and caption readable.
sents.zh: 将说明控制在单页内，并确保 PDF 显示时图像和图注清晰可读。

paragraphs.en: Complete the one-page measurement note in /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_texstudio_003/density_note.tex using its invented cylinder measurements and stated uncertainty assumptions. Preserve the raw data and assumptions. Replace the pending content with a coherent density model, the uncertainty expression for each mean length, and the first-order relative standard-uncertainty formula for density. Fill the summary table with each dimension’s mean, sample standard deviation, and combined standard uncertainty of its mean, all in millimetres. Give means to three decimal places and both standard deviations and standard uncertainties to two significant figures. Use unrounded intermediate values for propagation. Report density as a value plus or minus its standard uncertainty in kg/m^3, with uncertainty to two significant figures and density rounded to the same decimal place; label this as a standard uncertainty (k = 1). State the unit conversion, identify which of mass, mean diameter, or mean height has the largest propagated uncertainty contribution, and explain briefly why averaging does not reduce the calibration terms. KAlgebra is optional for numerical checks: cylinder_readings.kal contains only the raw assignments (lengths and b values in mm; mass and um in g) and can be loaded with Calculator > > Load Script. The task may be completed without KAlgebra; no calculator history or export is required. Save density_note.tex and build density_note.pdf in the same folder using TeXstudio without compilation errors. Keep the completed note to one readable page and leave its PDF visible.
paragraphs.zh: 在 /home/user/ScienceBoardSynthetic/sb_texstudio_003/density_note.tex 中完成这份一页测量说明，使用其虚构的圆柱体测量数据及已声明的不确定度假设。 保留原始数据和假设条件。 用连贯的密度模型、各平均长度的不确定度表达式以及密度的第一阶相对标准不确定度公式替换待填充内容。 在总结表中填写每个维度的平均值、样本标准差及其平均值的标准合并不确定度，所有数值均以毫米为单位。 平均值保留三位小数，标准差和标准不确定度均保留两位有效数字。 传播计算时使用未经四舍五入的中间值。 以“数值 ± 标准不确定度（单位：kg/m^3）”的形式报告密度，其中不确定度保留两位有效数字，密度四舍五入至相同小数位；明确标注此为 k = 1 的标准不确定度。 说明单位换算过程，指出质量、平均直径或平均高度中哪一个对传播不确定度的贡献最大，并简要解释为何取平均值不会减小校准项的影响。 数值验证时可选用 KAlgebra：cylinder_readings.kal 仅包含原始赋值（长度和 b 值的单位为毫米；质量和 um 的单位为克），可通过“计算器 > > 加载脚本”打开。 无需使用 KAlgebra 也能完成任务，不需要保留计算器历史记录或导出任何内容。 保存 density_note.tex，并在同一文件夹中使用 TeXstudio 生成 density_note.pdf，确保无编译错误。 保持说明文档最终呈现为一页清晰可读的内容，并保留生成的 PDF 文件可见。
